detail.summary_short: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B's 73.4% on SWE-bench Verified and Bonsai 1.7B's 674 tok/s on CUDA push edge coding agents into practical territory. By Q3 2026, individual and SMB coding-agent stacks are expected to standardize on local-by-default execution, with cloud reserved for overflow.

summary_short_locales.en: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B's 73.4% on SWE-bench Verified and Bonsai 1.7B's 674 tok/s on CUDA push edge coding agents into practical territory. By Q3 2026, individual and SMB coding-agent stacks are expected to standardize on local-by-default execution, with cloud reserved for overflow.
summary_short_locales.ja: Qwen3.6-35B-A3BがSWE-bench Verifiedで73.4%、Bonsai 1.7BがCUDA上で674 tok/sを達成し、エッジ向けコーディングエージェントが実用領域へ進入した。2026年Q3までに、個人および中小企業向けコーディングエージェントスタックは、ローカルをデフォルト、クラウドはオーバーフローという構成に標準化されると見込まれる。
summary_short_locales.es: El 73,4% de Qwen3.6-35B-A3B en SWE-bench Verified y los 674 tok/s de Bonsai 1.7B en CUDA llevan a los agentes de codificación en el borde a un terreno práctico. Para el Q3 2026, se espera que las pilas de agentes de codificación individuales y de pymes se estandaricen en la ejecución local por defecto, reservando la nube para el desbordamiento.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang 73.4% ng Qwen3.6-35B-A3B sa SWE-bench Verified at ang 674 tok/s ng Bonsai 1.7B sa CUDA ay nagtutulak sa edge coding agents papasok sa praktikal na teritoryo. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang individual at SMB coding-agent stacks ay inaasahang magiging standard sa local-by-default execution, na ang cloud ay nakareserba para sa overflow.

bridges.text: DeepSeek V4 cost-collapse, mature Qwen3.6 family coverage, and on-device Bonsai performance all push the local default deeper into reach — the structural force the prediction relies on is hardening through Apr 25-27, with practitioner reads consolidating around it.

text_locales.en: DeepSeek V4 cost-collapse, mature Qwen3.6 family coverage, and on-device Bonsai performance all push the local default deeper into reach — the structural force the prediction relies on is hardening through Apr 25-27, with practitioner reads consolidating around it.
text_locales.ja: DeepSeek V4 のコスト崩壊、成熟した Qwen3.6 ファミリのカバレッジ、そしてオンデバイスでの Bonsai 性能はいずれも、ローカルデフォルトの射程を一段と深く押し広げている — 予測が依拠する構造的な力は 4/25-27 を通じて硬化しており、実務者の読みもそれを軸に集約しつつある。
text_locales.es: El colapso de costos de DeepSeek V4, la cobertura madura de la familia Qwen3.6 y el rendimiento on-device de Bonsai empujan el default local más profundo al alcance — la fuerza estructural de la que depende la predicción se está endureciendo del 25 al 27 de abril, con las lecturas de los profesionales consolidándose en torno a ella.
text_locales.fil: Ang DeepSeek V4 cost-collapse, mature Qwen3.6 family coverage, at ang on-device Bonsai performance ay lahat nagtutulak sa local default na maging mas malalim na maaabot — ang structural force na inaasa ng prediction ay tumitigas sa kabuuan ng Apr 25-27, kasama ang practitioner reads na nagkokonsolida sa paligid nito.

bridges.text: Qwen3.6-27B's dense Apache 2.0 release beating 397B-A17B MoE on SWE-bench Verified at 40 tok/s on a single RTX 3090, DeepSeek V4-Pro's ~7x cost gap with Opus 4.7 alongside Huawei Ascend tuning, and NVIDIA's Apr 26 open-source LLM speedups on RTX PCs together materialize the precondition that local models clear the agent quality bar at consumer-tier cost.

text_locales.en: Qwen3.6-27B's dense Apache 2.0 release beating 397B-A17B MoE on SWE-bench Verified at 40 tok/s on a single RTX 3090, DeepSeek V4-Pro's ~7x cost gap with Opus 4.7 alongside Huawei Ascend tuning, and NVIDIA's Apr 26 open-source LLM speedups on RTX PCs together materialize the precondition that local models clear the agent quality bar at consumer-tier cost.
text_locales.ja: Qwen3.6-27Bの密Apache 2.0リリースが単一RTX 3090上40 tok/sでSWE-bench Verifiedの397B-A17B MoEを上回ること、DeepSeek V4-ProのOpus 4.7との~7xのコスト差とファーウェイ・アセンドのチューニング、NVIDIAの4月26日のRTX PC上のオープンソースLLMの高速化が共に、コンシューマ層のコストでローカルモデルがエージェント品質バーをクリアするという前提条件を実体化する。
text_locales.es: El lanzamiento denso Apache 2.0 de Qwen3.6-27B superando a 397B-A17B MoE en SWE-bench Verified a 40 tok/s en una sola RTX 3090, la brecha de costo de ~7x de DeepSeek V4-Pro con Opus 4.7 junto al ajuste para Huawei Ascend, y las aceleraciones LLM de código abierto del 26 de abril de NVIDIA en RTX PCs juntas materializan la precondición de que los modelos locales superen el listón de calidad de agente al costo de nivel de consumo.
text_locales.fil: Ang Qwen3.6-27B's dense Apache 2.0 release na lumalampas sa 397B-A17B MoE sa SWE-bench Verified sa 40 tok/s sa isang RTX 3090, ang DeepSeek V4-Pro's ~7x cost gap sa Opus 4.7 katuwang ng Huawei Ascend tuning, at ang NVIDIA's Apr 26 open-source LLM speedups sa RTX PCs ay magkasamang nagma-materialize sa precondition na ang local models ay nakapasa sa agent quality bar sa consumer-tier cost.

bridges.text: DeepSeek V4-Pro's IMOAnswerBench 89.8 above Claude Opus 4.7 and Gemini 3.1-Pro and close to GPT-5.4, plus OfficeChai's $1.74 / $3.48 per M tokens pricing one-seventh of Opus and UCStrategies' 7x-cheaper open-weight 1M-context framing, materialize the precondition that local models clear the agent quality bar at frontier-adjacent cost.

text_locales.en: DeepSeek V4-Pro's IMOAnswerBench 89.8 above Claude Opus 4.7 and Gemini 3.1-Pro and close to GPT-5.4, plus OfficeChai's $1.74 / $3.48 per M tokens pricing one-seventh of Opus and UCStrategies' 7x-cheaper open-weight 1M-context framing, materialize the precondition that local models clear the agent quality bar at frontier-adjacent cost.
text_locales.ja: DeepSeek V4-ProのIMOAnswerBench 89.8がClaude Opus 4.7とGemini 3.1-Proを上回りGPT-5.4に近いこと、OfficeChaiの$1.74 / $3.48 per MトークンというOpusの7分の1の価格設定、UCStrategiesの7倍安価なオープンウェイト1Mコンテキストの枠組みが、ローカル・モデルがフロンティア近接コストでエージェント品質バーをクリアするという前提条件を物質化する。
text_locales.es: El IMOAnswerBench 89.8 de DeepSeek V4-Pro por encima de Claude Opus 4.7 y Gemini 3.1-Pro y cerca de GPT-5.4, más el precio de OfficeChai de $1.74 / $3.48 por M tokens un séptimo de Opus, y el encuadre de UCStrategies de 7x más barato con pesos abiertos y contexto 1M, materializan la precondición de que los modelos locales superan la barra de calidad de agente a un costo adyacente a la frontera.
text_locales.fil: Ang IMOAnswerBench 89.8 ng DeepSeek V4-Pro sa itaas ng Claude Opus 4.7 at Gemini 3.1-Pro at malapit sa GPT-5.4, kasama ang $1.74 / $3.48 per M tokens pricing ng OfficeChai na one-seventh ng Opus at ang 7x-cheaper open-weight 1M-context framing ng UCStrategies, ay nagpapamateryalisa sa precondition na ang local models ay nakapasa sa agent quality bar sa frontier-adjacent cost.

bridges.text: DeepSeek V4 dropping as open weights with native 1M context and Hybrid Attention slashing 1M-context FLOPs to 27% / KV cache to 10%, alongside Qwen3.6-27B's downloadable Claude-Code-grade coding and Ollama v0.21.2's bundled OpenClaw + web search across all desktops, directly materializes the precondition that local models clear the agent quality bar with frontier-adjacent capability.

text_locales.en: DeepSeek V4 dropping as open weights with native 1M context and Hybrid Attention slashing 1M-context FLOPs to 27% / KV cache to 10%, alongside Qwen3.6-27B's downloadable Claude-Code-grade coding and Ollama v0.21.2's bundled OpenClaw + web search across all desktops, directly materializes the precondition that local models clear the agent quality bar with frontier-adjacent capability.
text_locales.ja: DeepSeek V4がネイティブ1Mコンテキストとハイブリッド・アテンションでオープンウェイトとして登場し、1MコンテキストFLOPsを27% / KVキャッシュを10%まで削減したこと、加えてQwen3.6-27Bのダウンロード可能なClaude-Codeグレードのコーディングと、Ollama v0.21.2が全デスクトップにOpenClaw + ウェブ検索をバンドルしたことが、ローカルモデルがフロンティア近接の能力でエージェント品質バーをクリアするという前提条件を直接物質化する。
text_locales.es: DeepSeek V4 cayendo como pesos abiertos con contexto de 1M nativo y Hybrid Attention recortando los FLOPs de contexto de 1M al 27% / caché KV al 10%, junto con la codificación de grado Claude-Code descargable de Qwen3.6-27B y los plugins OpenClaw + búsqueda web incluidos de Ollama v0.21.2 en todos los desktops, materializan directamente la precondición de que los modelos locales superan la barra de calidad de agente con capacidad adyacente a la frontera.
text_locales.fil: Ang pagbagsak ng DeepSeek V4 bilang open weights na may native 1M context at Hybrid Attention na nagbabawas ng 1M-context FLOPs sa 27% / KV cache sa 10%, kasabay ng downloadable Claude-Code-grade coding ng Qwen3.6-27B at ang bundled OpenClaw + web search ng Ollama v0.21.2 sa lahat ng desktops, ay direktang nagma-materialize sa precondition na ang local models ay umaabot sa agent quality bar na may frontier-adjacent capability.

bridges.text: Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0 hitting SWE-bench Verified 77.2% on a single RTX 4090 at ~18 GB Q4_K_M, with Simon Willison ranking it flagship-grade coding and GIGAZINE noting Claude Opus 4.5-class performance is now locally downloadable, directly materializes the precondition that local-runnable models clear the agent quality bar.

text_locales.en: Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0 hitting SWE-bench Verified 77.2% on a single RTX 4090 at ~18 GB Q4_K_M, with Simon Willison ranking it flagship-grade coding and GIGAZINE noting Claude Opus 4.5-class performance is now locally downloadable, directly materializes the precondition that local-runnable models clear the agent quality bar.
text_locales.ja: Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0が単一のRTX 4090上で約18 GBのQ4_K_MでSWE-bench Verified 77.2%に到達し、Simon Willisonがフラッグシップ級コーディングと評価し、GIGAZINEはClaude Opus 4.5級の性能が今やローカルでダウンロード可能だと述べていることは、ローカル実行可能なモデルがエージェントの品質基準をクリアするという前提条件を直接実現している。
text_locales.es: Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0 alcanzando SWE-bench Verified 77.2% en una sola RTX 4090 con ~18 GB Q4_K_M, con Simon Willison clasificándolo como codificación de grado insignia y GIGAZINE señalando que el rendimiento de clase Claude Opus 4.5 ahora se puede descargar localmente, materializa directamente la precondición de que los modelos ejecutables localmente superan la barra de calidad del agente.
text_locales.fil: Ang Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0 na umaabot sa SWE-bench Verified 77.2% sa iisang RTX 4090 sa ~18 GB Q4_K_M, kasama si Simon Willison na nagrarank dito bilang flagship-grade coding at ang GIGAZINE na nagsasabi na ang Claude Opus 4.5-class performance ay locally-downloadable na ngayon, ay tahasang inaaktwal ang precondition na ang local-runnable models ay pumapasa sa agent quality bar.

bridges.text: ml-intern lifting Qwen3-1.7B GPQA from 8.5% to 32% in under 10 hours and overtaking Claude Code's 22.99% is direct evidence that local post-training now produces credible coding-agent quality, reinforcing the precondition that edge models match useful agent quality bars.

text_locales.en: ml-intern lifting Qwen3-1.7B GPQA from 8.5% to 32% in under 10 hours and overtaking Claude Code's 22.99% is direct evidence that local post-training now produces credible coding-agent quality, reinforcing the precondition that edge models match useful agent quality bars.
text_locales.ja: ml-internが10時間未満でQwen3-1.7BのGPQAを8.5%から32%まで引き上げ、Claude Codeの22.99%を上回ったことは、ローカルなポストトレーニングが信頼できるコーディングエージェント品質を生み出すことの直接的な証拠であり、エッジモデルが実用的なエージェント品質基準に到達するという前提を補強する。
text_locales.es: ml-intern elevando GPQA de Qwen3-1.7B del 8.5% al 32% en menos de 10 horas y superando el 22.99% de Claude Code es evidencia directa de que el post-entrenamiento local ahora produce calidad creible de agente de codificacion, reforzando la precondicion de que los modelos edge igualan los listones utiles de calidad de agente.
text_locales.fil: Ang pagtataas ng ml-intern sa Qwen3-1.7B GPQA mula 8.5% papuntang 32% sa loob ng wala pang 10 oras at ang paglampas sa 22.99% ng Claude Code ay direktang ebidensya na ang local post-training ay nakakagawa na ngayon ng credible coding-agent quality, na nagpapatibay sa precondition na ang edge models ay umaabot sa useful agent quality bars.

description.en: **"Training-vs-inference SKU split" becomes the standard for custom AI silicon.** Google's TPU 8t / 8i split extends the Trainium-vs-Inferentia line and locks in **hyperscaler in-house silicon as architecturally separate for training vs inference**. In H2 2026 / H1 2027, expect Microsoft MAIA and Meta MTIA to adopt the same dual-track SKU strategy — opposing NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin's "single architecture, both workloads." Inference-tuned SKUs assume native FP4 / MXFP4 and drive **$/query competition** to a peak in Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **「学習用 vs 推論用のSKU分割」がカスタムAIシリコンの標準仕様になる。** GoogleのTPU 8t / 8i分割は、Trainium-Inferentiaのラインを延伸し、**ハイパースケーラの内製シリコンを学習用と推論用でアーキテクチャ的に分離**することを定着させる。2026年H2 / 2027年H1にかけて、Microsoft MAIAとMeta MTIAも同様のデュアルトラックSKU戦略を採用すると見込まれる — NVIDIA BlackwellやVera Rubinの「単一アーキテクチャで両ワークロード」路線と対立する形になる。推論向けにチューニングされたSKUはネイティブFP4 / MXFP4を前提とし、**$/queryの競争**を2026年Q3にピークへ押し上げる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **La "separacion de SKU entrenamiento-vs-inferencia" se convierte en el estandar para silicio AI personalizado.** La division TPU 8t / 8i de Google extiende la linea Trainium-vs-Inferentia y consolida el **silicio interno de los hyperscalers como arquitectonicamente separado para entrenamiento vs inferencia**. En H2 2026 / H1 2027, se espera que Microsoft MAIA y Meta MTIA adopten la misma estrategia de SKU dual — oponiendose a la "arquitectura unica, ambas cargas de trabajo" de NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin. Los SKU optimizados para inferencia asumen FP4 / MXFP4 nativo e impulsan la **competencia de $/consulta** a un pico en Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang "Training-vs-inference SKU split" ay nagiging pamantayan para sa custom AI silicon.** Ang TPU 8t / 8i split ng Google ay nag-eextend sa Trainium-vs-Inferentia line at nag-lo-lock in sa **hyperscaler in-house silicon bilang architecturally separate para sa training vs inference**. Sa H2 2026 / H1 2027, asahan na ang Microsoft MAIA at Meta MTIA ay magtitibay ng parehong dual-track SKU strategy — laban sa "single architecture, both workloads" ng NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin. Ang inference-tuned SKUs ay nag-aassume ng native FP4 / MXFP4 at nagtutulak ng **$/query competition** sa peak sa Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

summary.fil: **Ang "Training-vs-inference SKU split" ay nagiging pamantayan para sa custom AI silicon.** Ang TPU 8t / 8i split ng Google ay nag-eextend sa Trainium-vs-Inferentia line at nag-lo-lock in sa **hyperscaler in-house silicon bilang architecturally separate para sa training vs inference**. Sa H2 2026 / H1 2027, asahan na ang Microsoft MAIA at Meta MTIA ay magtitibay ng parehong dual-track SKU strategy — laban sa "single architecture, both workloads" ng NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin. Ang inference-tuned SKUs ay nag-aassume ng native FP4 / MXFP4 at nagtutulak ng **$/query competition** sa peak sa Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

bridges.text: AWS's Apr 27 roundup deepens the Trainium silicon-level co-engineering with Anthropic and Meta-Graviton CPU at scale, reinforcing that hyperscalers continue to architect inference-class silicon distinct from training-class accelerators. The precondition that custom AI silicon splits cleanly along workload lines holds with fresh partnership detail rather than a new tape-out.

text_locales.en: AWS's Apr 27 roundup deepens the Trainium silicon-level co-engineering with Anthropic and Meta-Graviton CPU at scale, reinforcing that hyperscalers continue to architect inference-class silicon distinct from training-class accelerators. The precondition that custom AI silicon splits cleanly along workload lines holds with fresh partnership detail rather than a new tape-out.
text_locales.ja: AWSの4月27日ラウンドアップは、AnthropicとのTrainiumシリコンレベル協調エンジニアリングとMeta-Gravitonの大規模CPUを深化させ、ハイパースケーラーがトレーニング級アクセラレータとは別個に推論級シリコンを設計し続けていることを補強している。カスタムAIシリコンがワークロード・ラインに沿って明確に分かれるという前提条件は、新しいテープアウトではなく新鮮なパートナーシップの詳細とともに維持されている。
text_locales.es: El roundup del 27 de abril de AWS profundiza la co-ingenieria a nivel de silicio Trainium con Anthropic y Meta-Graviton CPU a escala, reforzando que los hyperscalers continuan arquitecturando silicio inference-class distinto de aceleradores training-class. La precondicion de que el silicio personalizado de IA se divide limpiamente por lineas de workload se mantiene con detalle fresco de partnership en lugar de un nuevo tape-out.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apr 27 roundup ng AWS ay pinapalalim ang Trainium silicon-level co-engineering kasama ang Anthropic at Meta-Graviton CPU sa scale, na nagpapatibay na ang hyperscalers ay patuloy na nag-aarchitect ng inference-class silicon na hiwalay sa training-class accelerators. Ang precondition na ang custom AI silicon ay naghahati nang malinis sa workload lines ay nananatili na may sariwang partnership detail sa halip na bagong tape-out.

bridges.text: AWS doubling down on Trainium for training and Graviton for CPU-heavy agentic workloads reinforces the structural force the prediction names — hyperscaler in-house silicon is the differentiation layer, with workload-specialized SKUs increasingly the operative shape.

text_locales.en: AWS doubling down on Trainium for training and Graviton for CPU-heavy agentic workloads reinforces the structural force the prediction names — hyperscaler in-house silicon is the differentiation layer, with workload-specialized SKUs increasingly the operative shape.
text_locales.ja: AWS がトレーニングに Trainium、CPU 重めのエージェンティック ワークロードに Graviton を二重に賭けていくことは、予測が指す構造的力を補強する — ハイパースケーラの自社シリコンが差別化レイヤーであり、ワークロード特化型 SKU が次第にその作動的形状となっている。
text_locales.es: AWS redoblando con Trainium para entrenamiento y Graviton para cargas agentic intensivas en CPU refuerza la fuerza estructural que la predicción nombra — el silicio interno del hyperscaler es la capa de diferenciación, con SKUs especializados por carga de trabajo cada vez más como la forma operativa.
text_locales.fil: Ang AWS na nagdo-doble down sa Trainium para sa training at Graviton para sa CPU-heavy agentic workloads ay pinatatatag ang structural force na pinangalanan ng prediction — ang in-house silicon ng hyperscaler ang differentiation layer, kasama ang workload-specialized SKUs na lalong nagiging operative shape.

text_locales.en: GPT-5.5's API pricing 2x GPT-5.4 with Codex's 40% output-token reduction sharpens the inference $/query axis, while Anthropic-AWS's 5GW Trainium + 1GW Trainium2/3 simultaneous-run shape locks the training-side dual-track silicon, keeping the structural split intact even as Microsoft MAIA and Meta MTIA dual-SKU announcements remain pending.

text_locales.es: El precio API de GPT-5.5 a 2x GPT-5.4 con la reducción del 40% de tokens de output de Codex agudiza el eje $/consulta de inferencia, mientras la forma de corrida simultánea de Anthropic-AWS de 5GW Trainium + 1GW Trainium2/3 bloquea el silicio de doble pista del lado de entrenamiento, manteniendo la división estructural intacta incluso mientras los anuncios de doble SKU de Microsoft MAIA y Meta MTIA permanecen pendientes.
text_locales.fil: Ang API pricing ng GPT-5.5 na 2x GPT-5.4 kasama ang 40% output-token reduction ng Codex ay nagpapatibay sa inference $/query axis, habang ang 5GW Trainium + 1GW Trainium2/3 simultaneous-run shape ng Anthropic-AWS ay nagla-lock sa training-side dual-track silicon, na pinananatiling buo ang structural split kahit pa nakabinbin pa ang Microsoft MAIA at Meta MTIA dual-SKU announcements.

text_locales.es: Google Cloud Next '26 Día 3 enfatizando la optimización de inferencia TPU 8i (1,152 TPUs, SRAM 3x) refuerza la división dual-track SKU, mientras que el stack de 6 chips + Groq 3 LPU de arquitectura única de NVIDIA Vera Rubin alcanzando producción en masa agudiza el contraste estructural, manteniendo intacta la división subyacente del mercado incluso mientras los anuncios de SKU dual MAIA / MTIA permanecen pendientes.
text_locales.fil: Ang Google Cloud Next '26 Day 3 na nagdidiin sa TPU 8i inference-optimization (1,152 TPUs, 3x SRAM) ay nagpapatibay sa dual-track SKU split, habang ang NVIDIA Vera Rubin's 6-chip + Groq 3 LPU single-architecture stack na umaabot sa mass production ay pinatatalas ang structural contrast, na pinapanatili ang underlying market split kahit ang MAIA / MTIA dual-SKU announcements ay nananatiling pending.

text_locales.en: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform shipping a 7-chip single-architecture stack into mass production sharpens the structural contrast that the prediction draws — hyperscaler dual-track SKU on one side, NVIDIA single-architecture on the other — while keeping the underlying market split intact, even as MAIA / MTIA dual-SKU announcements remain pending.
text_locales.ja: NVIDIAのVera Rubinプラットフォームが7チップ単一アーキテクチャスタックを量産にリリースしていることは、予測が描く構造的対比を鮮明にしている ― 一方ではハイパースケーラーのデュアルトラックSKU、他方ではNVIDIAの単一アーキテクチャ ― MAIA / MTIAデュアルSKUの発表が保留中であっても、根本的な市場分裂は維持されている。
text_locales.es: La plataforma Vera Rubin de NVIDIA enviando un stack de 7 chips de arquitectura única a producción en masa agudiza el contraste estructural que dibuja la predicción — SKU dual-track de hyperscaler en un lado, arquitectura única de NVIDIA en el otro — manteniendo intacta la división subyacente del mercado, incluso mientras los anuncios de SKU dual MAIA / MTIA permanecen pendientes.
text_locales.fil: Ang Vera Rubin platform ng NVIDIA na nagpapadala ng 7-chip single-architecture stack sa mass production ay nagpapatalas sa structural contrast na binubuod ng prediction — hyperscaler dual-track SKU sa isang panig, NVIDIA single-architecture sa kabilang panig — habang pinapanatili ang underlying market split, kahit na ang MAIA / MTIA dual-SKU announcements ay nakabinbin pa.

detail.description: **"Training-vs-inference SKU split" becomes the standard for custom AI silicon.** Google's TPU 8t / 8i split extends the Trainium-vs-Inferentia line and locks in **hyperscaler in-house silicon as architecturally separate for training vs inference**. En H2 2026 / H1 2027, se espera que Microsoft MAIA y Meta MTIA adopten la misma estrategia de SKU dual — oponiendose a la "arquitectura unica, ambas cargas de trabajo" de NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin. Los SKU optimizados para inferencia asumen FP4 / MXFP4 nativo e impulsan la **competencia de $/consulta** a un pico en Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

Sa H2 2026 / H1 2027, asahan na ang Microsoft MAIA at Meta MTIA ay magtitibay ng parehong dual-track SKU strategy — laban sa "single architecture, both workloads" ng NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin. nodes.title: Big-3 hyperscalers gate AI capex on per-token-margin floor by Q3 2026
nodes.description: **Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) reset the AI-capex ROI narrative — Q3 2026 sees the first hyperscaler to publicly tier AI capex by token-margin gate.** With combined 2026 capex guidance from Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), and Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) totaling ~$650B-$700B against Wall Street's "AI ROI reality check," the Apr 29-30 prints either validate the **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis or trigger a multiple compression. By Q3 2026, at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — the first explicit "AI infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud, ending the 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) become the visible pressure relief valve. By Q3 2026, at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — the first explicit "AI infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud, ending the 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) become the visible pressure relief valve. description.ja: **Mag 7 の Q1 決算 (4/29-30) が AI capex の ROI ナラティブを再設定する — Q3 2026 までに、トークンマージンの閾値で AI capex を公に階層化する最初のハイパースケーラが登場する。** Alphabet ($175B-$185B)、Amazon (約 $200B)、Meta ($115B-$135B)、そして Microsoft (Azure 出遅れによる再評価リスク) を合算した 2026 capex ガイダンスは合計 ~$650B-$700B に達し、ウォール街の「AI ROI リアリティチェック」と対峙する。4/29-30 の決算は、**トークン単位売上のエグジットベロシティ**仮説を裏付けるか、それともマルチプル圧縮を引き起こすかのいずれかとなる。Q3 2026 までに、Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社は **Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限で増分 GPU capex を公にゲーティング** — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」が登場し、2024-2025 の「使え、さもなくば死ね」ドクトリンに終止符を打つ。フロンティアラボのアンカーディール (Google $40B / Anthropic、Amazon $25B / Anthropic、OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) が可視的な圧力解放弁になる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Los resultados del Q1 de Mag 7 (29-30 de abril) reinician la narrativa del ROI del capex en IA — el Q3 2026 ve al primer hyperscaler que tiera públicamente el capex de IA por una valla de margen por token.** Con la guía combinada de capex 2026 de Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B) y Microsoft (riesgo de rerating por rezago de Azure) totalizando ~$650B-$700B contra el "AI ROI reality check" de Wall Street, las publicaciones del 29-30 de abril o validan la tesis de **velocidad-de-salida de ingresos por token** o disparan una compresión de múltiplos. Para el Q3 2026, al menos uno de los Big-3 hyperscalers públicamente **gatea el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen por token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — el primer umbral explícito de "ROI de infra de IA" de una nube pública, terminando la doctrina de "gastar o morir" de 2024-2025. Los acuerdos ancla con laboratorios frontier (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) se convierten en la válvula visible de alivio de presión. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) ay magre-reset ng AI-capex ROI narrative — pagsapit ng Q3 2026, makikita ang unang hyperscaler na pampublikong magti-tier ng AI capex sa pamamagitan ng token-margin gate.** Sa pinagsamang 2026 capex guidance mula sa Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), at Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) na umaabot sa ~$650B-$700B laban sa "AI ROI reality check" ng Wall Street, ang Apr 29-30 prints ay magpapatunay sa **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis o magti-trigger ng multiple compression. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscalers ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa pamamagitan ng Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud, na nagtatapos sa 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Ang frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) ay magiging visible pressure relief valve. text_locales.en: AMD's May 5 print preview tightens the structural force the prediction names: the MI308 China collapse plus the analyst split (Cathie Wood trim, DA Davidson Buy, RBC Hold) shows buyside pressure for explicit AI-capex ROI disclosure is now operative on a per-vendor basis, exactly the precondition for a hyperscaler to publicly tier AI capex by token-margin gate.
text_locales.ja: AMDの5月5日決算プレビューは、予測が指摘する構造的な強制力を引き締める: MI308中国崩壊 + アナリストの分裂(Cathie Woodの売却、DA DavidsonのBuy、RBCのHold)が、明示的なAI-capex ROI開示に対するバイサイドの圧力がベンダー単位で運用されていることを示しており、これはハイパースケーラーがAI capexをトークン単位マージン・ゲートで公に階層化する前提条件そのものである。
text_locales.es: El avance de la impresión del 5 de mayo de AMD ajusta la fuerza estructural que la predicción nombra: el colapso de MI308 China más la división de analistas (recorte de Cathie Wood, Buy de DA Davidson, Hold de RBC) muestra que la presión del lado comprador para divulgación explícita de ROI de capex de IA ahora opera por proveedor, exactamente la precondición para que un hyperscaler escalone públicamente el capex de IA por puerta de margen por token.
text_locales.fil: Ang AMD May 5 print preview ay nagpapatigas sa structural force na pinangalanan ng prediction: ang MI308 China collapse plus ang analyst split (Cathie Wood trim, DA Davidson Buy, RBC Hold) ay nagpapakita na ang buyside pressure para sa explicit AI-capex ROI disclosure ay aktibo na ngayon sa per-vendor basis, eksaktong precondition para sa isang hyperscaler na pampublikong mag-tier ng AI capex sa pamamagitan ng token-margin gate.

text_locales.es: La guía Q3 de Apple sin línea de servicios de IA, el tape de capex 2026 de $700B y la divulgación de run-rate de $37B de Microsoft son exactamente las señales de presión del lado comprador que la predicción necesitaba para moverse de narrativa a forma de divulgación. El cohorte ahora compite públicamente sobre transparencia de margen por token en lugar de esconderse detrás de ingresos agregados de nube.
text_locales.fil: Ang Q3 guide ng Apple na walang AI-services line, ang $700B 2026 capex tape, at ang $37B run-rate disclosure ng Microsoft ang eksaktong buyside-pressure signals na kinailangan ng prediction upang lumipat mula narrative tungo sa disclosure-shape. Ang cohort ngayon ay pampublikong nagkukumpetensya sa per-token-margin transparency sa halip na magtago sa likod ng aggregate cloud revenue.

text_locales.es: El beat limpio Q2 de Apple más el número de tracking de capex-IA-2026 de $700B y la recompra de $100B de Apple aterrizan el lado-cohorte del reset de la super-semana Mag 7, pero ningún hyperscaler ha enunciado aún un gate por token-margin. La disclosure del run-rate IA de $37B de Microsoft sigue siendo el precedente más cercano, un paso estructural por debajo del gate explícito que la predicción exige.
text_locales.fil: Ang malinis na Q2 beat ng Apple plus ang $700B 2026 AI-capex tracking number at ang $100B buyback ng Apple ay naghatid ng cohort-side ng Mag 7 super-week reset, ngunit walang hyperscaler na nag-state pa ng per-token-margin gate. Ang $37B AI run-rate disclosure ng Microsoft ay nananatiling pinakamalapit na precedent, isang structural step na kulang sa explicit na gate na hinihingi ng prediction.

text_locales.es: El evento de prints Mag 7 aterrizó exactamente en la ventana de pronóstico de la predicción con Microsoft publicando la primera disclosure por-AI-business como sola línea de run-rate de $37B. Eso queda un paso estructural corto frente a un gate explícito de margen-por-token, pero es el precedente más cercano que ha sentado cualquier hyperscaler. El reset de -7% AH de META por shortfall de capex refuerza la pata de presión de disclosure.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mag 7 print event ay lumapag eksakto sa forecast window ng prediction kasama ng Microsoft na nag-post ng unang per-AI-business single-line $37B run-rate disclosure. Iyon ay isang structural step kulang sa explicit per-token-margin gate ngunit ang pinakamalapit na precedent na itinakda ng anumang hyperscaler. Ang -7% AH capex-shortfall reset ng META ay nagpapatibay sa disclosure-pressure leg.

detail.description: **Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) reset the AI-capex ROI narrative — Q3 2026 sees the first hyperscaler to publicly tier AI capex by token-margin gate.** With combined 2026 capex guidance from Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), and Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) totaling ~$650B-$700B against Wall Street's "AI ROI reality check," the Apr 29-30 prints either validate the **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis or trigger a multiple compression. By Q3 2026, at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — the first explicit "AI infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud, ending the 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) become the visible pressure relief valve. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **Mag 7 の Q1 決算 (4/29-30) が AI capex の ROI ナラティブを再設定する — Q3 2026 までに、トークンマージンの閾値で AI capex を公に階層化する最初のハイパースケーラが登場する。** Alphabet ($175B-$185B)、Amazon (約 $200B)、Meta ($115B-$135B)、そして Microsoft (Azure 出遅れによる再評価リスク) を合算した 2026 capex ガイダンスは合計 ~$650B-$700B に達し、ウォール街の「AI ROI リアリティチェック」と対峙する。4/29-30 の決算は、**トークン単位売上のエグジットベロシティ**仮説を裏付けるか、それともマルチプル圧縮を引き起こすかのいずれかとなる。Q3 2026 までに、Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社は **Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限で増分 GPU capex を公にゲーティング** — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」が登場し、2024-2025 の「使え、さもなくば死ね」ドクトリンに終止符を打つ。フロンティアラボのアンカーディール (Google $40B / Anthropic、Amazon $25B / Anthropic、OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) が可視的な圧力解放弁になる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Los resultados del Q1 de Mag 7 (29-30 de abril) reinician la narrativa del ROI del capex en IA — el Q3 2026 ve al primer hyperscaler que tiera públicamente el capex de IA por una valla de margen por token.** Con la guía combinada de capex 2026 de Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B) y Microsoft (riesgo de rerating por rezago de Azure) totalizando ~$650B-$700B contra el "AI ROI reality check" de Wall Street, las publicaciones del 29-30 de abril o validan la tesis de **velocidad-de-salida de ingresos por token** o disparan una compresión de múltiplos. Para el Q3 2026, al menos uno de los Big-3 hyperscalers públicamente **gatea el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen por token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — el primer umbral explícito de "ROI de infra de IA" de una nube pública, terminando la doctrina de "gastar o morir" de 2024-2025. Los acuerdos ancla con laboratorios frontier (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) se convierten en la válvula visible de alivio de presión. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) ay magre-reset ng AI-capex ROI narrative — pagsapit ng Q3 2026, makikita ang unang hyperscaler na pampublikong magti-tier ng AI capex sa pamamagitan ng token-margin gate.** Sa pinagsamang 2026 capex guidance mula sa Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), at Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) na umaabot sa ~$650B-$700B laban sa "AI ROI reality check" ng Wall Street, ang Apr 29-30 prints ay magpapatunay sa **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis o magti-trigger ng multiple compression. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscalers ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa pamamagitan ng Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud, na nagtatapos sa 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Ang frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) ay magiging visible pressure relief valve. description.en: **Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 force the first **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure from a hyperscaler by Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal anchor the new doctrine.** Combined Mag 7 capex of ~$700B for 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending to ~$170B FY27) lands into a tape that has already shifted from "rewarding capex on faith" to "demanding tangible profit." **Apr 27 contract restructurings explicitly route AI-lab compute through hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton with Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs at scale). By Q3 2026 at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — first explicit "AI-infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud. NVDA $5T-class market cap and AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory hold; the spend curve doesn't break, but its disclosure language does. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **Mag 7 決算 + 4/28-29 FOMC が、Q3 2026 までにハイパースケーラからの初の **トークン単位マージンでゲーティングされた capex** 開示を強要する — 4/27 の OpenAI / Microsoft 協定 + Anthropic / AWS Trainium のシリコンレベル ディールが新ドクトリンを定礎する。** 2026 年の Mag 7 合算 capex 約 $700B (Alphabet $175B-$185B、Amazon 約 $200B、Meta $115B-$135B、Microsoft 約 $146B FY26 から FY27 で約 $170B へトレンド) は、すでに「信仰に基づき capex を報いる」から「具体的な利益を要求する」へとシフトしたテープに着地する。**4/27 の契約再構築は AI ラボの計算リソースをハイパースケーラ自社シリコン経由に明示的にルーティング** している (Anthropic との AWS Trainium / Graviton、スケールでの Meta-Graviton CPU)。Q3 2026 までに Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社が **増分 GPU capex を Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限でゲーティング** する — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」となる。NVDA $5T クラスの時価総額と AMD / Cerebras IPO 軌道は維持される。支出曲線は折れないが、その開示言語は折れる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Las publicaciones de Mag 7 + FOMC del 28-29 de abril fuerzan la primera divulgación de **capex con margen-por-token gateado** desde un hyperscaler para Q3 2026 — el pacto OpenAI/Microsoft del 27 de abril + el acuerdo Anthropic/AWS Trainium a nivel de silicio anclan la nueva doctrina.** El capex combinado de Mag 7 de ~$700B para 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 tendiendo a ~$170B FY27) aterriza en una cinta que ya ha pasado de "recompensar el capex con fe" a "exigir ganancia tangible." **Las reestructuraciones de contratos del 27 de abril enrutan explícitamente la computación de los AI-labs a través del silicio propiedad del hyperscaler** (AWS Trainium/Graviton con Anthropic; CPUs Meta-Graviton a escala). Para Q3 2026 al menos un Big-3 hyperscaler **gatea públicamente el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen-por-token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — primer "umbral de ROI de AI-infra" explícito de un cloud público. La capitalización de mercado de NVDA tipo $5T y la trayectoria de IPO AMD/Cerebras se mantienen; la curva de gasto no se rompe, pero su lenguaje de divulgación sí. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 ay magpipilit sa unang **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure mula sa hyperscaler pagsapit ng Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal ang nag-aanchor sa bagong doctrine.** Ang pinagsamang Mag 7 capex na ~$700B para sa 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending sa ~$170B FY27) ay tumatama sa tape na lumipat na mula sa "rewarding capex on faith" patungo sa "demanding tangible profit." **Ang Apr 27 contract restructurings ay tahasang nagru-route ng AI-lab compute sa pamamagitan ng hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton kasama ang Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs sa scale). Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscaler ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI-infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud. Ang NVDA $5T-class market cap at AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory ay nananatili; hindi mababasag ang spend curve, ngunit ang disclosure language nito ay babasagin. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

summary_short_locales.ja: Mag 7 の 2026 年合算 AI capex 約 $700B が、具体的な利益を要求するテープに直面する一方で、4/27 の OpenAI / Microsoft と Anthropic / AWS-Trainium ディールがラボの計算リソースをハイパースケーラ シリコン経由にルーティングする。Q3 2026 までに Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社が、増分 GPU capex をトークン単位マージン下限で公にゲーティングする。
summary_short_locales.es: El capex AI combinado de Mag 7 2026 cerca de $700B se encuentra con una cinta que exige ganancia tangible mientras los acuerdos del 27 de abril OpenAI/Microsoft y Anthropic/AWS-Trainium enrutan la computación de los labs a través del silicio del hyperscaler; para Q3 2026 al menos un Big-3 hyperscaler gatea públicamente el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen-por-token.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang pinagsamang Mag 7 2026 AI capex na malapit sa $700B ay tumatagpo sa tape na humihingi ng tangible profit habang ang Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft at Anthropic/AWS-Trainium deals ay nagru-route ng lab compute sa pamamagitan ng hyperscaler silicon; pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscaler ay pampublikong maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa per-token-margin floor.

bridges.text: AMD's Q2 guide ($11.2B vs Street $10.52B) plus NVIDIA Blackwell at ~1,000 NVL72 racks/week with B200 lowering cost-per-million-tokens 15x plus the May 4 JV launches tighten the structural force the per-token-margin capex-gate prediction (Apr 28) names: buyside is being asked to underwrite ~$700B 2026 capex while the bundled AMD line hides accelerator economics, giving hyperscalers a quantifiable margin baseline to publish against.

text_locales.en: AMD's Q2 guide ($11.2B vs Street $10.52B) plus NVIDIA Blackwell at ~1,000 NVL72 racks/week with B200 lowering cost-per-million-tokens 15x plus the May 4 JV launches tighten the structural force the per-token-margin capex-gate prediction (Apr 28) names: buyside is being asked to underwrite ~$700B 2026 capex while the bundled AMD line hides accelerator economics, giving hyperscalers a quantifiable margin baseline to publish against.
text_locales.ja: AMDのQ2ガイダンス($11.2B 対ストリート $10.52B)に加え、NVIDIA Blackwellが週約1,000台のNVL72ラックでB200が100万トークン当たりのコストを15分の1へ低減すること、5月4日のJVローンチが、トークン単位マージンcapexゲート予測(4月28日)が指摘する構造的な強制力を引き締める: バイサイドは約 $700B の2026年capexの引き受けを求められている一方、バンドルされたAMDラインがアクセラレーター・エコノミクスを隠しており、ハイパースケーラーは公表できる定量的なマージン・ベースラインを持つ。
text_locales.es: La guía Q2 de AMD ($11.2B vs Street $10.52B) más NVIDIA Blackwell a ~1,000 racks NVL72/semana con B200 reduciendo costo-por-millón-de-tokens 15x más los lanzamientos de JV del 4 de mayo ajustan la fuerza estructural que la predicción de puerta-de-capex-por-margen-por-token (28 de abril) nombra: se le pide al lado comprador que financie ~$700B de capex 2026 mientras que la línea agrupada de AMD oculta la economía de aceleradores, dándole a los hyperscalers una línea base de margen cuantificable contra la que publicar.
text_locales.fil: Ang Q2 guide ng AMD ($11.2B vs Street $10.52B) plus ang NVIDIA Blackwell sa ~1,000 NVL72 racks/week na may B200 na nagpapababa ng cost-per-million-tokens 15x plus ang May 4 JV launches ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinangalanan ng per-token-margin capex-gate prediction (Apr 28): hinihingi sa buyside na pondohan ang ~$700B 2026 capex habang itinatago ng bundled AMD line ang accelerator economics, na nagbibigay sa hyperscalers ng quantifiable margin baseline na ipalalathala.

bridges.text: The AMD MI308 cliff plus AAPL printing without an AI-services line plus the May 4 parallel-JV equity-template launches harden the structural force the prediction names: the buyside is being asked to underwrite ~$700B of 2026 capex without a per-token-margin disclosure unit, and the cohort is visibly cracking on the disclosure side.

text_locales.en: The AMD MI308 cliff plus AAPL printing without an AI-services line plus the May 4 parallel-JV equity-template launches harden the structural force the prediction names: the buyside is being asked to underwrite ~$700B of 2026 capex without a per-token-margin disclosure unit, and the cohort is visibly cracking on the disclosure side.
text_locales.ja: AMDのMI308崖 + AAPLがAIサービスラインなしで発表 + 5月4日の並行JVエクイティ・テンプレート・ローンチが、予測が指摘する構造的な強制力を硬化させる: バイサイドはトークン単位マージン開示単位なしに2026年capex 約$700Bを引き受けるよう求められており、コホートは開示側で目に見えてひび割れている。
text_locales.es: El precipicio MI308 de AMD más AAPL imprimiendo sin una línea de servicios de IA más los lanzamientos paralelos de plantilla de capital JV del 4 de mayo endurecen la fuerza estructural que la predicción nombra: se le pide al lado comprador que financie ~$700B de capex 2026 sin una unidad de divulgación de margen por token, y la cohorte está visiblemente cediendo en el lado de divulgación.
text_locales.fil: Ang AMD MI308 cliff plus AAPL na nagpi-print nang walang AI-services line plus ang May 4 parallel-JV equity-template launches ay nagpapatigas sa structural force na pinangalanan ng prediction: hinihingi sa buyside na pondohan ang ~$700B ng 2026 capex nang walang per-token-margin disclosure unit, at ang cohort ay nakikitang nagbabakli sa disclosure side.

bridges.text: AAPL's $100B buyback layered on the $700B capex tape and MSFT's $37B run-rate single-line disclosure keep the per-token-margin gating thesis active. Powell-stays-on-Board through 2028 plus the AMD May 5 print and the May 8 Apr jobs print add the macro-volatility leg that pressures hyperscalers toward harder per-token disclosure.

text_locales.en: AAPL's $100B buyback layered on the $700B capex tape and MSFT's $37B run-rate single-line disclosure keep the per-token-margin gating thesis active. Powell-stays-on-Board through 2028 plus the AMD May 5 print and the May 8 Apr jobs print add the macro-volatility leg that pressures hyperscalers toward harder per-token disclosure.
text_locales.ja: AAPLの$100B自社株買いが$700B capexテープに積層され、MSFTの$37B run-rate単一ライン開示と合わせて、トークン当たりマージンゲーティングテーゼが活発に保たれる。Powellが2028年まで理事会に残る決定とAMD 5月5日決算、5月8日の4月雇用統計が、ハイパースケーラーへのより厳格なトークン当たり開示への圧力をかけるマクロボラティリティの足を加える。
text_locales.es: La recompra de $100B de AAPL apilada sobre el tape de capex de $700B y la divulgación de línea única de run-rate de $37B de MSFT mantienen activa la tesis de gating de margen por token. Powell-se-queda-en-la-Junta hasta 2028 más la impresión de AMD del 5 de mayo y la impresión de empleos de abril del 8 de mayo añaden la pierna de volatilidad macro que presiona a los hyperscalers hacia una divulgación más dura por token.
text_locales.fil: Ang $100B buyback ng AAPL na nakapatong sa $700B capex tape at sa $37B run-rate single-line disclosure ng MSFT ay pinapanatiling aktibo ang per-token-margin gating thesis. Ang Powell-stays-on-Board hanggang 2028 plus ang AMD May 5 print at ang May 8 Apr jobs print ay nagdaragdag ng macro-volatility leg na nagpipilit sa hyperscalers tungo sa mas matigas na per-token disclosure.

bridges.text: Apple's $100B buyback plus the May 1 record tape rebuilt the AI-capex-on-faith conditioning that the prediction expects to crack into a per-token-margin gate, with the Apr 29 FOMC dissent supplying the institutional-risk pressure layer.

text_locales.en: Apple's $100B buyback plus the May 1 record tape rebuilt the AI-capex-on-faith conditioning that the prediction expects to crack into a per-token-margin gate, with the Apr 29 FOMC dissent supplying the institutional-risk pressure layer.
text_locales.ja: Appleの$100B自社株買いと5月1日のレコードテープが、予測がトークンあたりマージンゲートに割れると期待するAI設備投資オン信仰のコンディショニングを再構築し、4月29日FOMCの異議が制度的リスク圧力層を供給する。
text_locales.es: La recompra de $100B de Apple más la cinta récord del 1 mayo reconstruyeron el condicionamiento de capex-IA-por-fe que la predicción espera que se rompa en una puerta de margen-por-token, con la disidencia FOMC del 29 abr suministrando la capa de presión de riesgo institucional.
text_locales.fil: Ang $100B buyback ng Apple kasama ang May 1 record tape ay muling nagbuo sa AI-capex-on-faith conditioning na inaasahan ng prediction na bibitak patungo sa per-token-margin gate, kasama ng Apr 29 FOMC dissent na nagbibigay ng institutional-risk pressure layer.

bridges.text: Apple closing the Mag 7 super-week with no separate AI-services line plus the $700B 2026 capex print exactly matches the buyside-pressure setup the prediction depends on. Powell-stays-on-Board reinforces the institutional-risk premium under the entire AI-capex tape. The per-token-margin-gated-capex disclosure itself is still upstream — Microsoft's $37B run-rate is the closest precedent.

Powell-stays-on-Board reinforces the institutional-risk premium under the entire AI-capex tape. text_locales.ja: AppleがMag 7スーパーウィークを別個のAIサービスラインなしで締めくくり、加えて7,000億ドルの2026年設備投資プリントが、予測が依拠する買い手側圧力のセットアップに完全に一致する。Powellの理事会留任は、AI設備投資テープ全体の制度的リスクプレミアムを強化する。トークンあたりマージンゲート設備投資開示自体は依然として上流 ― Microsoftの370億ドルランレートが最も近い前例。
text_locales.es: Apple cerrando la super-semana Mag 7 sin línea separada de AI-services más el print de capex 2026 de $700B coincide exactamente con el setup de presión buyside sobre el cual depende la predicción. Powell-permanece-en-Board refuerza la prima de riesgo institucional bajo todo el tape de capex IA. La disclosure de capex condicionada por per-token-margin en sí misma todavía está upstream — el run-rate de $37B de Microsoft es el precedente más cercano.
text_locales.fil: Ang pag-close ng Apple sa Mag 7 super-week nang walang separate AI-services line plus ang $700B 2026 capex print ay eksaktong tumutugma sa buyside-pressure setup na pinanindigan ng prediction. Ang Powell-stays-on-Board ay nagpapatibay sa institutional-risk premium sa ilalim ng buong AI-capex tape. Ang per-token-margin-gated-capex disclosure mismo ay nasa upstream pa rin — ang $37B run-rate ng Microsoft ay ang pinakamalapit na precedent.

bridges.text: Microsoft's explicit $37B AI run-rate is the first per-AI-business single-line disclosure from a hyperscaler — direct precedent for the per-token-margin-gated-capex thesis the prediction projects. The 8-4 FOMC dissent + Powell-stays-on-Board reinforces the institutional-risk premium under the entire AI-capex tape. Strong reinforcing signal.

text_locales.en: Microsoft's explicit $37B AI run-rate is the first per-AI-business single-line disclosure from a hyperscaler — direct precedent for the per-token-margin-gated-capex thesis the prediction projects. The 8-4 FOMC dissent + Powell-stays-on-Board reinforces the institutional-risk premium under the entire AI-capex tape. Strong reinforcing signal.
text_locales.ja: Microsoftの明示的な$37B AIランレートは、ハイパースケーラからのAI事業ごと初の単一行開示である — 予測が投影するトークンあたりマージンゲート付きcapexテーゼの直接的な先例。8-4のFOMC反対 + Powellが理事会に残ることが、AI capexテープ全体の制度リスクプレミアムを強化する。強い強化シグナル。
text_locales.es: El AI run-rate explícito de $37B de Microsoft es la primera disclosure por-AI-business como una sola línea desde un hyperscaler — precedente directo para la tesis de capex-con-gate-de-margen-por-token que proyecta la predicción. El disenso 8-4 del FOMC + Powell-se-queda-en-la-Junta refuerzan la prima de riesgo institucional bajo todo el tape de capex-IA. Señal de refuerzo fuerte.
text_locales.fil: Ang explicit $37B AI run-rate ng Microsoft ay ang unang per-AI-business single-line disclosure mula sa hyperscaler — direktang precedent para sa per-token-margin-gated-capex thesis na inaasahan ng prediction. Ang 8-4 FOMC dissent + Powell-stays-on-Board ay nagpapatibay sa institutional-risk premium sa ilalim ng buong AI-capex tape. Matibay na nagpapatibay na signal.

bridges.text: Mag-7 prints arrive after close today and FOMC's 2:30 PM ET presser closes Powell's term, exactly the Apr 28-29 landing window the prediction named, on top of Apr 28's chip selloff cracking the AI-capex-on-faith tape. The disclosure-language shift the prediction projects is now under live pressure; the per-token-margin floor itself has not yet appeared in earnings commentary.

text_locales.en: Mag-7 prints arrive after close today and FOMC's 2:30 PM ET presser closes Powell's term, exactly the Apr 28-29 landing window the prediction named, on top of Apr 28's chip selloff cracking the AI-capex-on-faith tape. The disclosure-language shift the prediction projects is now under live pressure; the per-token-margin floor itself has not yet appeared in earnings commentary.
text_locales.ja: Mag-7プリントは本日引け後に到着し、FOMC午後2:30 ET記者会見がPowellの任期を締めくくる。これはまさに予測が指摘した4月28-29日の着地ウィンドウであり、4月28日のチップ売却が信頼に基づくAI-capexテープを割った上に乗っている。予測が投影する開示言語のシフトは今やライブの圧力下にある。トークン単位マージン・フロア自体は決算コメントにまだ現れていない。
text_locales.es: Los resultados Mag-7 llegan despues del cierre hoy y la conferencia FOMC de las 2:30 PM ET cierra el termino de Powell, exactamente la ventana de aterrizaje del 28-29 de abril que la prediccion nombro, encima del selloff de chips del 28 de abril quebrando la cinta de capex-de-IA-por-fe. El cambio de lenguaje de divulgacion que la prediccion proyecta ahora esta bajo presion en vivo; el piso de margen-por-token mismo todavia no ha aparecido en el comentario de resultados.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mag-7 prints ay dumarating pagkatapos ng close ngayon at ang FOMC 2:30 PM ET presser ay nagsasara sa termino ni Powell, eksakto sa Apr 28-29 landing window na pinapangalanan ng hula, sa ibabaw ng Apr 28 chip selloff na bumabasag sa AI-capex-on-faith tape. Ang disclosure-language shift na ipino-project ng hula ay ngayon nasa ilalim ng live pressure; ang per-token-margin floor mismo ay hindi pa lumitaw sa earnings commentary.

detail.description: **Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 force the first **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure from a hyperscaler by Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal anchor the new doctrine.** Combined Mag 7 capex of ~$700B for 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending to ~$170B FY27) lands into a tape that has already shifted from "rewarding capex on faith" to "demanding tangible profit." **Apr 27 contract restructurings explicitly route AI-lab compute through hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton with Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs at scale). By Q3 2026 at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — first explicit "AI-infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud. NVDA $5T-class market cap and AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory hold; the spend curve doesn't break, but its disclosure language does. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.en: **Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 force the first **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure from a hyperscaler by Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal anchor the new doctrine.** Combined Mag 7 capex of ~$700B for 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending to ~$170B FY27) lands into a tape that has already shifted from "rewarding capex on faith" to "demanding tangible profit." **Apr 27 contract restructurings explicitly route AI-lab compute through hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton with Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs at scale). prediction_summary_locales.ja: **Mag 7 決算 + 4/28-29 FOMC が、Q3 2026 までにハイパースケーラからの初の **トークン単位マージンでゲーティングされた capex** 開示を強要する — 4/27 の OpenAI / Microsoft 協定 + Anthropic / AWS Trainium のシリコンレベル ディールが新ドクトリンを定礎する。** 2026 年の Mag 7 合算 capex 約 $700B (Alphabet $175B-$185B、Amazon 約 $200B、Meta $115B-$135B、Microsoft 約 $146B FY26 から FY27 で約 $170B へトレンド) は、すでに「信仰に基づき capex を報いる」から「具体的な利益を要求する」へとシフトしたテープに着地する。**4/27 の契約再構築は AI ラボの計算リソースをハイパースケーラ自社シリコン経由に明示的にルーティング** している (Anthropic との AWS Trainium / Graviton、スケールでの Meta-Graviton CPU)。Q3 2026 までに Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社が **増分 GPU capex を Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限でゲーティング** する — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」となる。NVDA $5T クラスの時価総額と AMD / Cerebras IPO 軌道は維持される。支出曲線は折れないが、その開示言語は折れる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Las publicaciones de Mag 7 + FOMC del 28-29 de abril fuerzan la primera divulgación de **capex con margen-por-token gateado** desde un hyperscaler para Q3 2026 — el pacto OpenAI/Microsoft del 27 de abril + el acuerdo Anthropic/AWS Trainium a nivel de silicio anclan la nueva doctrina.** El capex combinado de Mag 7 de ~$700B para 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 tendiendo a ~$170B FY27) aterriza en una cinta que ya ha pasado de "recompensar el capex con fe" a "exigir ganancia tangible." **Las reestructuraciones de contratos del 27 de abril enrutan explícitamente la computación de los AI-labs a través del silicio propiedad del hyperscaler** (AWS Trainium/Graviton con Anthropic; CPUs Meta-Graviton a escala). Para Q3 2026 al menos un Big-3 hyperscaler **gatea públicamente el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen-por-token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — primer "umbral de ROI de AI-infra" explícito de un cloud público. La capitalización de mercado de NVDA tipo $5T y la trayectoria de IPO AMD/Cerebras se mantienen; la curva de gasto no se rompe, pero su lenguaje de divulgación sí. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 ay magpipilit sa unang **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure mula sa hyperscaler pagsapit ng Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal ang nag-aanchor sa bagong doctrine.** Ang pinagsamang Mag 7 capex na ~$700B para sa 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending sa ~$170B FY27) ay tumatama sa tape na lumipat na mula sa "rewarding capex on faith" patungo sa "demanding tangible profit." **Ang Apr 27 contract restructurings ay tahasang nagru-route ng AI-lab compute sa pamamagitan ng hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton kasama ang Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs sa scale). Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscaler ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI-infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud. Ang NVDA $5T-class market cap at AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory ay nananatili; hindi mababasag ang spend curve, ngunit ang disclosure language nito ay babasagin. nodes.description: By Q4 2026 the May 8 dual filing — Nvidia's 8-K disclosing that Vera Rubin sampling has reached production-volume customer commitments for nine of the top ten hyperscaler and neocloud accounts with H1 2027 NVL576 rack revenue backlog-covered through Q3 2027 at the current Blackwell B200 ~1,000 NVL72 rack/week production cadence, plus AMD's CFO 8-K supplement to the May 5 print confirming a 6.2GW total Helios + MI450 H2 2026 commitment book across Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI's standing 1GW first data center, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, plus a previously-undisclosed 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment for Asia-Pacific deployment — combined with the same-day Cerebras CS-4 engineering-sample announcement plus disclosed OpenAI $10B multi-year second-data-center coverage, the post-Cerebras-IPO public-market multiple anchored under disclosed AI-accelerator revenue, and the SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter cycle pressing the Mag-7 cohort on capital-allocation attribution and customer-concentration footnotes, force AI-accelerator vendors (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, plus the SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1 cohort behind them) to adopt a structured mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K pre-print cadence as the standard disclosure shape, separate from earnings releases. The forcing function is that once two duopoly issuers ship dual same-day forward-supply 8-Ks with named-customer commitment GW figures, sell-side coverage and SEC Corp Fin staff treat the format as the operative template for forward-visibility disclosure — silence between earnings becomes the anomaly rather than the norm. The most likely shape is a recurring mid-quarter 8-K naming production cadence, customer-by-customer GW or rack-count commitments, geographic-region splits where material, and forward-revenue-coverage windows. Bear case is SEC Corp Fin issuing Reg FD selective-disclosure guidance that pushes the cadence back into earnings-call-only territory; absent that, by Q4 2026 the Q3 print cycle lands with at least two prior pre-announcement 8-Ks per accelerator issuer.

description.en: By Q4 2026 the May 8 dual filing — Nvidia's 8-K disclosing that Vera Rubin sampling has reached production-volume customer commitments for nine of the top ten hyperscaler and neocloud accounts with H1 2027 NVL576 rack revenue backlog-covered through Q3 2027 at the current Blackwell B200 ~1,000 NVL72 rack/week production cadence, plus AMD's CFO 8-K supplement to the May 5 print confirming a 6.2GW total Helios + MI450 H2 2026 commitment book across Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI's standing 1GW first data center, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, plus a previously-undisclosed 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment for Asia-Pacific deployment — combined with the same-day Cerebras CS-4 engineering-sample announcement plus disclosed OpenAI $10B multi-year second-data-center coverage, the post-Cerebras-IPO public-market multiple anchored under disclosed AI-accelerator revenue, and the SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter cycle pressing the Mag-7 cohort on capital-allocation attribution and customer-concentration footnotes, force AI-accelerator vendors (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, plus the SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1 cohort behind them) to adopt a structured mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K pre-print cadence as the standard disclosure shape, separate from earnings releases. The forcing function is that once two duopoly issuers ship dual same-day forward-supply 8-Ks with named-customer commitment GW figures, sell-side coverage and SEC Corp Fin staff treat the format as the operative template for forward-visibility disclosure — silence between earnings becomes the anomaly rather than the norm. The most likely shape is a recurring mid-quarter 8-K naming production cadence, customer-by-customer GW or rack-count commitments, geographic-region splits where material, and forward-revenue-coverage windows. Bear case is SEC Corp Fin issuing Reg FD selective-disclosure guidance that pushes the cadence back into earnings-call-only territory; absent that, by Q4 2026 the Q3 print cycle lands with at least two prior pre-announcement 8-Ks per accelerator issuer.
description.ja: 2026年Q4までに、5月8日のデュアル・ファイリング—Nvidiaの8-KがVera Rubinサンプリングが上位10ハイパースケーラー・ネオクラウド口座のうち9社で本番ボリューム顧客コミットメントに到達したことと、現行Blackwell B200の~1,000 NVL72ラック/週生産ケイデンスでH1 2027 NVL576ラック売上のバックログが2027年Q3までカバー済みであることを開示、加えてAMDのCFOによる5月5日プリントへの8-K補足がMicrosoft Azure、Oracle、OpenAIの定常1GW初データセンター、Crusoe、CoreWeave、Lambda、さらに非開示だった0.8GW Tencent Cloudのアジア太平洋展開コミットメントを横断する6.2GW総Helios + MI450 H2 2026コミットメント・ブックを確認—に、同日のCerebras CS-4エンジニアリング・サンプル発表と開示済みOpenAI $10Bマルチイヤー第2データセンター・カバレッジ、Cerebras IPO後の公開市場マルチプルが開示済みAIアクセラレータ売上の下に置かれること、SEC Corp Finのサンプル・コメント・レター・サイクルがMag-7コホートに資本配分の帰属と顧客集中脚注で圧力をかけることが組み合わさり、AIアクセラレータ・ベンダー(Nvidia、AMD、Cerebrasに加え、その背後のSambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1コホート)に対し、決算リリースとは別の標準開示形状として、構造化された四半期途中のフォワード・サプライ8K事前プリント・ケイデンスを採用することを強制する。フォーシング・ファンクションは、ひとたびデュオポリーの2発行体が同日にカスタマー命名GW図付きデュアル・フォワード・サプライ8-Kを出荷すれば、セルサイドのカバレッジとSEC Corp Finスタッフがこのフォーマットをフォワード可視性開示の運用上のテンプレートとして扱うことであり、決算間の沈黙が規範ではなく異常事態となる。最も可能性の高い形状は、生産ケイデンス、顧客別GWまたはラック数コミットメント、重要な場合の地域別分割、フォワード売上カバレッジ・ウィンドウを命名する反復的な四半期途中の8-Kである。ベアケースはSEC Corp Finが選択的開示Reg FDガイダンスを発出してケイデンスを決算コール限定の領域へ押し戻すこと;それがなければ、2026年Q4のQ3プリント・サイクルではアクセラレータ発行体ごとに少なくとも2件の事前アナウンス8-Kが先行する形で着地する。
description.es: Para Q4 2026 la presentación dual del 8 de mayo — el 8-K de Nvidia revelando que el sampling de Vera Rubin ha alcanzado compromisos de cliente a volumen de producción para nueve de los diez principales hyperscalers y cuentas neocloud con el backlog de ingresos de racks NVL576 H1 2027 ahora cubierto hasta Q3 2027 a la cadencia actual de producción de Blackwell B200 de ~1,000 racks NVL72/semana, más el suplemento 8-K del CFO de AMD al print del 5 de mayo confirmando un libro de compromisos total de Helios + MI450 H2 2026 de 6.2GW a través de Microsoft Azure, Oracle, el primer data center 1GW pendiente de OpenAI, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, más un compromiso previamente no revelado de 0.8GW de Tencent Cloud para despliegue Asia-Pacífico — combinada con el anuncio del mismo día de muestra de ingeniería del CS-4 de Cerebras más la cobertura revelada de OpenAI de $10B multi-año del segundo data center, el múltiplo público post-IPO de Cerebras anclado bajo los ingresos revelados de aceleradores AI, y el ciclo de cartas de comentarios de muestra de SEC Corp Fin presionando a la cohorte Mag-7 sobre atribución de asignación de capital y notas al pie de concentración de clientes, fuerzan a los vendedores de aceleradores AI (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, más la cohorte S-1 de SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent detrás de ellos) a adoptar una cadencia estructurada de pre-impresión de 8-K de suministro a mitad de trimestre como la forma estándar de revelación, separada de los releases de earnings. La función forzante es que una vez que dos emisores duopolio envían 8-Ks duales del mismo día de suministro adelantado con cifras de compromiso de GW por cliente nombrado, la cobertura sell-side y el personal de SEC Corp Fin tratan el formato como la plantilla operativa para revelación de visibilidad adelantada — el silencio entre earnings se vuelve la anomalía en lugar de la norma. La forma más probable es un 8-K recurrente a mitad de trimestre nombrando cadencia de producción, compromisos de GW o conteo de racks por cliente, divisiones por región geográfica donde sean materiales, y ventanas de cobertura de ingresos adelantados. El caso bajista es que SEC Corp Fin emita guía Reg FD sobre revelación selectiva que empuje la cadencia de vuelta al territorio de solo-llamadas-de-earnings; sin eso, para Q4 2026 el ciclo del print Q3 aterriza con al menos dos 8-Ks de pre-anuncio previos por emisor de aceleradores.
description.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026, ang May 8 dual filing — ang 8-K ng Nvidia na naglalantad na ang Vera Rubin sampling ay umabot na sa production-volume customer commitments para sa siyam sa nangungunang sampung hyperscaler at neocloud accounts na may H1 2027 NVL576 rack revenue na backlog-covered hanggang Q3 2027 sa kasalukuyang Blackwell B200 ~1,000 NVL72 rack/week production cadence, kasama ang AMD CFO 8-K supplement sa May 5 print na nagkukumpirma ng 6.2GW total Helios + MI450 H2 2026 commitment book sa Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI standing 1GW first data center, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, kasama ang dating-undisclosed na 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment para sa Asia-Pacific deployment — kasama ng same-day Cerebras CS-4 engineering-sample announcement at inilantad na OpenAI $10B multi-year second-data-center coverage, ang post-Cerebras-IPO public-market multiple na naka-anchor sa ilalim ng inilantad na AI-accelerator revenue, at ang SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter cycle na pinipilit ang Mag-7 cohort sa capital-allocation attribution at customer-concentration footnotes, ay pumipilit sa AI-accelerator vendors (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, kasama ang SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1 cohort sa likuran nila) na mag-adopt ng structured mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K pre-print cadence bilang standard disclosure shape, hiwalay sa earnings releases. Ang forcing function ay kapag dalawang duopoly issuers ay nag-ship na ng dual same-day forward-supply 8-Ks na may named-customer commitment GW figures, itinuturing na ng sell-side coverage at SEC Corp Fin staff ang format bilang operative template para sa forward-visibility disclosure — ang katahimikan sa pagitan ng earnings ay nagiging anomaly imbis na norm. Ang most likely shape ay isang recurring mid-quarter 8-K na nagngangalan ng production cadence, customer-by-customer GW o rack-count commitments, geographic-region splits kung saan material, at forward-revenue-coverage windows. Ang bear case ay ang SEC Corp Fin na maglabas ng Reg FD selective-disclosure guidance na nagtutulak sa cadence pabalik sa earnings-call-only territory; kung wala iyon, lalapag ang Q3 print cycle bago ang Q4 2026 na may hindi bababa sa dalawang prior pre-announcement 8-Ks bawat accelerator issuer.

detail.summary_short: Nvidia + AMD May 8 dual 8-Ks disclose Vera Rubin nine-of-ten hyperscaler commitments and a 6.2GW Helios + MI450 book including 0.8GW Tencent Cloud. By Q4 2026 AI-accelerator vendors lock a recurring mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K cadence as standard disclosure.

summary_short_locales.en: Nvidia + AMD May 8 dual 8-Ks disclose Vera Rubin nine-of-ten hyperscaler commitments and a 6.2GW Helios + MI450 book including 0.8GW Tencent Cloud. By Q4 2026 AI-accelerator vendors lock a recurring mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K cadence as standard disclosure.
summary_short_locales.ja: Nvidia + AMDの5月8日のデュアル8-Kが、Vera Rubinの上位10社中9社のハイパースケーラー・コミットメントと0.8GW Tencent Cloudを含む6.2GW Helios + MI450ブックを開示。2026年Q4までにAIアクセラレータ・ベンダーは反復的な四半期途中フォワード・サプライ8-Kケイデンスを標準開示として定着させる。
summary_short_locales.es: Los 8-Ks duales de Nvidia + AMD del 8 de mayo revelan compromisos de Vera Rubin de nueve-de-diez hyperscalers y un libro de Helios + MI450 de 6.2GW incluyendo 0.8GW de Tencent Cloud. Para Q4 2026 los vendedores de aceleradores AI fijan una cadencia recurrente de 8-K de suministro adelantado a mitad de trimestre como revelación estándar.
summary_short_locales.fil: Inilantad ng Nvidia + AMD May 8 dual 8-Ks ang Vera Rubin nine-of-ten hyperscaler commitments at isang 6.2GW Helios + MI450 book kasama ang 0.8GW Tencent Cloud. Bago ang Q4 2026, iko-lock ng AI-accelerator vendors ang isang recurring mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K cadence bilang standard disclosure.

bridges.text: AMD's Monday confirmation lifts the Helios/MI450 commitment book past 8.0GW with fresh SoftBank Sakai (0.6GW), NTT Data (0.4GW), and Apple (0.8GW) data points; Cerebras's Monday Engineering update slides OpenAI's sample-allocation window to late-Q1 2027; Nvidia's Vera Rubin update adds Apple to the NVL576 H1 2027 cohort, each landing as the between-earnings forward-supply cadence the prediction names.

text_locales.en: AMD's Monday confirmation lifts the Helios/MI450 commitment book past 8.0GW with fresh SoftBank Sakai (0.6GW), NTT Data (0.4GW), and Apple (0.8GW) data points; Cerebras's Monday Engineering update slides OpenAI's sample-allocation window to late-Q1 2027; Nvidia's Vera Rubin update adds Apple to the NVL576 H1 2027 cohort, each landing as the between-earnings forward-supply cadence the prediction names.
text_locales.ja: AMDの月曜確認はHelios/MI450コミットメント・ブックを8.0GW超に新鮮なSoftBank Sakai(0.6GW)、NTT Data(0.4GW)、Apple(0.8GW)データ・ポイントで引き上げ;Cerebrasの月曜Engineering更新はOpenAIのサンプル割り当てウィンドウを2027年Q1後半にスライド;NvidiaのVera Rubin更新はNVL576 H1 2027コホートにAppleを追加し、各々が予測が命名する決算間フォワード・サプライ・ケイデンスとして着地する。
text_locales.es: La confirmación del lunes de AMD eleva el libro de compromiso Helios/MI450 pasado 8.0GW con datos frescos de SoftBank Sakai (0.6GW), NTT Data (0.4GW) y Apple (0.8GW); la actualización Engineering del lunes de Cerebras desliza la ventana de sample-allocation de OpenAI a finales-de-Q1 2027; la actualización Vera Rubin de Nvidia añade Apple a la cohorte NVL576 H1 2027, cada una aterrizando como la cadencia de forward-supply entre-earnings que la predicción nombra.
text_locales.fil: Itinataas ng Monday confirmation ng AMD ang Helios/MI450 commitment book nang lampas sa 8.0GW kasama ang sariwang SoftBank Sakai (0.6GW), NTT Data (0.4GW), at Apple (0.8GW) data points; inilalapit ng Monday Engineering update ng Cerebras ang OpenAI's sample-allocation window sa huling bahagi ng Q1 2027; idinaragdag ng Vera Rubin update ng Nvidia ang Apple sa NVL576 H1 2027 cohort, bawat isa lumalapag bilang between-earnings forward-supply cadence na pinapangalanan ng prediksyon.

bridges.text: AMD's Sunday confirmation of a 0.8GW Tencent plus 1.0GW Alibaba commitment lifting the Helios/MI450 book past 7.0GW is exactly the between-earnings forward-supply data point the prediction names; AIwire's three-vendor sample-allocation reconciliation and the Bernstein/Wells Fargo/Evercore mid-quarter probabilities anchor the cadence, with the Cerebras IPO comparable still serving as the Q2-print reference.

text_locales.en: AMD's Sunday confirmation of a 0.8GW Tencent plus 1.0GW Alibaba commitment lifting the Helios/MI450 book past 7.0GW is exactly the between-earnings forward-supply data point the prediction names; AIwire's three-vendor sample-allocation reconciliation and the Bernstein/Wells Fargo/Evercore mid-quarter probabilities anchor the cadence, with the Cerebras IPO comparable still serving as the Q2-print reference.
text_locales.ja: AMDの日曜の0.8GW Tencentプラス1.0GW AlibabaコミットメントによるHelios / MI450ブック7.0GW超への押し上げ確認は、予測が命名する決算間フォワード供給データポイント正そのもの;AIwireの3ベンダー・サンプル・アロケーション調整とBernstein / Wells Fargo / Evercore中四半期確率がケイデンスをアンカーし、Cerebras IPO比較対象が依然Q2-プリント・リファレンスを担う。
text_locales.es: La confirmación dominical de AMD de un compromiso 0.8GW Tencent más 1.0GW Alibaba elevando el libro Helios/MI450 pasado 7.0GW es exactamente el dato entre-earnings de forward-supply que la predicción nombra; la reconciliación de sample-allocation de tres-vendors de AIwire y las probabilidades mid-quarter Bernstein/Wells Fargo/Evercore anclan la cadencia, con la comparable de IPO de Cerebras todavía sirviendo como la referencia de impresión Q2.
text_locales.fil: Ang Sunday confirmation ng AMD ng 0.8GW Tencent plus 1.0GW Alibaba commitment na nagtataas sa Helios/MI450 book na lampas sa 7.0GW ay eksaktong between-earnings forward-supply data point na pinapangalanan ng prediksyon; nag-aanchor ang AIwire's three-vendor sample-allocation reconciliation at ng Bernstein/Wells Fargo/Evercore mid-quarter probabilities sa cadence, kasama ang Cerebras IPO comparable na nagsisilbi pa rin bilang Q2-print reference.

outcome_locales.es: Acuerdos pendientes de capacity-take enmendados con carve-outs de revelación nombrada que permiten al vendedor de aceleradores publicar compromisos de GW por cliente en 8-Ks a mitad de trimestre sin violar la confidencialidad.

motivation_locales.en: Customer is willing to be named because publicly-disclosed coverage tightens supply allocation and signals priority to its own investors and downstream tenants competing for capacity.

motivation_locales.es: El cliente está dispuesto a ser nombrado porque la cobertura revelada públicamente aprieta la asignación de suministro y señala prioridad a sus propios inversionistas y tenants downstream que compiten por capacidad.
motivation_locales.fil: Pumapayag ang customer na pangalanan dahil ang publicly-disclosed coverage ay nagpapahigpit sa supply allocation at nagsi-signal ng priority sa kanyang sariling investors at downstream tenants na nakikipag-kompetensya para sa capacity.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: By Q4 2026 the May 8 dual filing — Nvidia's 8-K disclosing that Vera Rubin sampling has reached production-volume customer commitments for nine of the top ten hyperscaler and neocloud accounts with H1 2027 NVL576 rack revenue backlog-covered through Q3 2027 at the current Blackwell B200 ~1,000 NVL72 rack/week production cadence, plus AMD's CFO 8-K supplement to the May 5 print confirming a 6.2GW total Helios + MI450 H2 2026 commitment book across Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI's standing 1GW first data center, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, plus a previously-undisclosed 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment for Asia-Pacific deployment — combined with the same-day Cerebras CS-4 engineering-sample announcement plus disclosed OpenAI $10B multi-year second-data-center coverage, the post-Cerebras-IPO public-market multiple anchored under disclosed AI-accelerator revenue, and the SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter cycle pressing the Mag-7 cohort on capital-allocation attribution and customer-concentration footnotes, force AI-accelerator vendors (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, plus the SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1 cohort behind them) to adopt a structured mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K pre-print cadence as the standard disclosure shape, separate from earnings releases. The forcing function is that once two duopoly issuers ship dual same-day forward-supply 8-Ks with named-customer commitment GW figures, sell-side coverage and SEC Corp Fin staff treat the format as the operative template for forward-visibility disclosure — silence between earnings becomes the anomaly rather than the norm. The most likely shape is a recurring mid-quarter 8-K naming production cadence, customer-by-customer GW or rack-count commitments, geographic-region splits where material, and forward-revenue-coverage windows. Bear case is SEC Corp Fin issuing Reg FD selective-disclosure guidance that pushes the cadence back into earnings-call-only territory; absent that, by Q4 2026 the Q3 print cycle lands with at least two prior pre-announcement 8-Ks per accelerator issuer.
