prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2026年Q4までに、5月8日のデュアル・ファイリング—Nvidiaの8-KがVera Rubinサンプリングが上位10ハイパースケーラー・ネオクラウド口座のうち9社で本番ボリューム顧客コミットメントに到達したことと、現行Blackwell B200の~1,000 NVL72ラック/週生産ケイデンスでH1 2027 NVL576ラック売上のバックログが2027年Q3までカバー済みであることを開示、加えてAMDのCFOによる5月5日プリントへの8-K補足がMicrosoft Azure、Oracle、OpenAIの定常1GW初データセンター、Crusoe、CoreWeave、Lambda、さらに非開示だった0.8GW Tencent Cloudのアジア太平洋展開コミットメントを横断する6.2GW総Helios + MI450 H2 2026コミットメント・ブックを確認—に、同日のCerebras CS-4エンジニアリング・サンプル発表と開示済みOpenAI $10Bマルチイヤー第2データセンター・カバレッジ、Cerebras IPO後の公開市場マルチプルが開示済みAIアクセラレータ売上の下に置かれること、SEC Corp Finのサンプル・コメント・レター・サイクルがMag-7コホートに資本配分の帰属と顧客集中脚注で圧力をかけることが組み合わさり、AIアクセラレータ・ベンダー(Nvidia、AMD、Cerebrasに加え、その背後のSambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1コホート)に対し、決算リリースとは別の標準開示形状として、構造化された四半期途中のフォワード・サプライ8K事前プリント・ケイデンスを採用することを強制する。フォーシング・ファンクションは、ひとたびデュオポリーの2発行体が同日にカスタマー命名GW図付きデュアル・フォワード・サプライ8-Kを出荷すれば、セルサイドのカバレッジとSEC Corp Finスタッフがこのフォーマットをフォワード可視性開示の運用上のテンプレートとして扱うことであり、決算間の沈黙が規範ではなく異常事態となる。最も可能性の高い形状は、生産ケイデンス、顧客別GWまたはラック数コミットメント、重要な場合の地域別分割、フォワード売上カバレッジ・ウィンドウを命名する反復的な四半期途中の8-Kである。ベアケースはSEC Corp Finが選択的開示Reg FDガイダンスを発出してケイデンスを決算コール限定の領域へ押し戻すこと;それがなければ、2026年Q4のQ3プリント・サイクルではアクセラレータ発行体ごとに少なくとも2件の事前アナウンス8-Kが先行する形で着地する。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q4 2026 la presentación dual del 8 de mayo — el 8-K de Nvidia revelando que el sampling de Vera Rubin ha alcanzado compromisos de cliente a volumen de producción para nueve de los diez principales hyperscalers y cuentas neocloud con el backlog de ingresos de racks NVL576 H1 2027 ahora cubierto hasta Q3 2027 a la cadencia actual de producción de Blackwell B200 de ~1,000 racks NVL72/semana, más el suplemento 8-K del CFO de AMD al print del 5 de mayo confirmando un libro de compromisos total de Helios + MI450 H2 2026 de 6.2GW a través de Microsoft Azure, Oracle, el primer data center 1GW pendiente de OpenAI, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, más un compromiso previamente no revelado de 0.8GW de Tencent Cloud para despliegue Asia-Pacífico — combinada con el anuncio del mismo día de muestra de ingeniería del CS-4 de Cerebras más la cobertura revelada de OpenAI de $10B multi-año del segundo data center, el múltiplo público post-IPO de Cerebras anclado bajo los ingresos revelados de aceleradores AI, y el ciclo de cartas de comentarios de muestra de SEC Corp Fin presionando a la cohorte Mag-7 sobre atribución de asignación de capital y notas al pie de concentración de clientes, fuerzan a los vendedores de aceleradores AI (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, más la cohorte S-1 de SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent detrás de ellos) a adoptar una cadencia estructurada de pre-impresión de 8-K de suministro a mitad de trimestre como la forma estándar de revelación, separada de los releases de earnings. La función forzante es que una vez que dos emisores duopolio envían 8-Ks duales del mismo día de suministro adelantado con cifras de compromiso de GW por cliente nombrado, la cobertura sell-side y el personal de SEC Corp Fin tratan el formato como la plantilla operativa para revelación de visibilidad adelantada — el silencio entre earnings se vuelve la anomalía en lugar de la norma. La forma más probable es un 8-K recurrente a mitad de trimestre nombrando cadencia de producción, compromisos de GW o conteo de racks por cliente, divisiones por región geográfica donde sean materiales, y ventanas de cobertura de ingresos adelantados. El caso bajista es que SEC Corp Fin emita guía Reg FD sobre revelación selectiva que empuje la cadencia de vuelta al territorio de solo-llamadas-de-earnings; sin eso, para Q4 2026 el ciclo del print Q3 aterriza con al menos dos 8-Ks de pre-anuncio previos por emisor de aceleradores.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026, ang May 8 dual filing — ang 8-K ng Nvidia na naglalantad na ang Vera Rubin sampling ay umabot na sa production-volume customer commitments para sa siyam sa nangungunang sampung hyperscaler at neocloud accounts na may H1 2027 NVL576 rack revenue na backlog-covered hanggang Q3 2027 sa kasalukuyang Blackwell B200 ~1,000 NVL72 rack/week production cadence, kasama ang AMD CFO 8-K supplement sa May 5 print na nagkukumpirma ng 6.2GW total Helios + MI450 H2 2026 commitment book sa Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI standing 1GW first data center, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, kasama ang dating-undisclosed na 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment para sa Asia-Pacific deployment — kasama ng same-day Cerebras CS-4 engineering-sample announcement at inilantad na OpenAI $10B multi-year second-data-center coverage, ang post-Cerebras-IPO public-market multiple na naka-anchor sa ilalim ng inilantad na AI-accelerator revenue, at ang SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter cycle na pinipilit ang Mag-7 cohort sa capital-allocation attribution at customer-concentration footnotes, ay pumipilit sa AI-accelerator vendors (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, kasama ang SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1 cohort sa likuran nila) na mag-adopt ng structured mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K pre-print cadence bilang standard disclosure shape, hiwalay sa earnings releases. Ang forcing function ay kapag dalawang duopoly issuers ay nag-ship na ng dual same-day forward-supply 8-Ks na may named-customer commitment GW figures, itinuturing na ng sell-side coverage at SEC Corp Fin staff ang format bilang operative template para sa forward-visibility disclosure — ang katahimikan sa pagitan ng earnings ay nagiging anomaly imbis na norm. Ang most likely shape ay isang recurring mid-quarter 8-K na nagngangalan ng production cadence, customer-by-customer GW o rack-count commitments, geographic-region splits kung saan material, at forward-revenue-coverage windows. Ang bear case ay ang SEC Corp Fin na maglabas ng Reg FD selective-disclosure guidance na nagtutulak sa cadence pabalik sa earnings-call-only territory; kung wala iyon, lalapag ang Q3 print cycle bago ang Q4 2026 na may hindi bababa sa dalawang prior pre-announcement 8-Ks bawat accelerator issuer.

bridges.text: Antigravity sandbox-escape and the rising indirect-prompt-injection prevalence are exactly the underlying-cause primitives for an Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration class to surface — the supporting evidence is good but doesn't yet show OWASP movement.

text_locales.en: Antigravity sandbox-escape and the rising indirect-prompt-injection prevalence are exactly the underlying-cause primitives for an Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration class to surface — the supporting evidence is good but doesn't yet show OWASP movement.
text_locales.ja: Antigravity のサンドボックス エスケープと間接プロンプトインジェクション拡散の上昇は、まさに「Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration」クラスを浮上させる根底原因のプリミティブそのものだ — 支持エビデンスは良好だが、まだ OWASP の動きを示してはいない。
text_locales.es: El escape de sandbox de Antigravity y la creciente prevalencia de prompt-injection indirecto son exactamente las primitivas de causa subyacente para que aflore una clase de Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration — la evidencia de apoyo es buena pero aún no muestra movimiento en OWASP.
text_locales.fil: Ang Antigravity sandbox-escape at ang tumataas na indirect-prompt-injection prevalence ay eksaktong underlying-cause primitives para sa Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration class na lumitaw — ang supporting evidence ay maganda ngunit hindi pa nagpapakita ng OWASP movement.

bridges.text: Pillar Security's Antigravity walkthrough showing the `find_by_name -X` flag insertion bypassing Secure Mode, CSO Online's framing of the same path as file-search-to-RCE, and the Cloud Security Alliance research note on agentic-IDE sandbox escape together confirm a third agentic-CI vendor exposed to the comment-style class, but no OWASP / CIS top-list category named for the pattern lands inside the window.

text_locales.en: Pillar Security's Antigravity walkthrough showing the `find_by_name -X` flag insertion bypassing Secure Mode, CSO Online's framing of the same path as file-search-to-RCE, and the Cloud Security Alliance research note on agentic-IDE sandbox escape together confirm a third agentic-CI vendor exposed to the comment-style class, but no OWASP / CIS top-list category named for the pattern lands inside the window.
text_locales.ja: Pillar SecurityのAntigravityウォークスルー(`find_by_name -X`フラグ挿入によるSecure Modeバイパス)、CSO Onlineの同じパスをファイル検索からRCEへとフレーミング、Cloud Security Allianceのエージェンティック・IDEサンドボックス・エスケープに関するリサーチノートが共に、コメント・スタイルクラスにさらされる第3のエージェンティックCIベンダーを確認するが、パターンを名指しするOWASP / CIS上位リストカテゴリーはウィンドウ内に着地しない。
text_locales.es: El walkthrough de Antigravity de Pillar Security mostrando la inserción del flag `find_by_name -X` evadiendo Secure Mode, el encuadre de CSO Online de la misma vía como búsqueda-de-archivos-a-RCE, y la nota de investigación de Cloud Security Alliance sobre el escape de sandbox en IDE agéntico juntos confirman un tercer vendor de CI agéntico expuesto a la clase de estilo comentario, pero ninguna categoría top-list de OWASP / CIS nombrada para el patrón llega dentro de la ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang Pillar Security's Antigravity walkthrough na nagpapakita ng `find_by_name -X` flag insertion na nilalampasan ang Secure Mode, ang CSO Online's framing ng parehong path bilang file-search-to-RCE, at ang Cloud Security Alliance research note sa agentic-IDE sandbox escape ay magkasamang nagkukumpirma ng pangatlong agentic-CI vendor na na-expose sa comment-style class, ngunit walang OWASP / CIS top-list category na pinangalanan para sa pattern ang lumapag sa loob ng window.

bridges.text: The Hacker News' Nginx UI MCPwn writeup confirming a 2-request takeover via an empty default IP allowlist exposing 12 unauthenticated MCP tool calls reinforces the agent-credential-reachable precondition, but no OWASP / CIS top-list entry naming Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration as a category lands inside the window.

text_locales.en: The Hacker News' Nginx UI MCPwn writeup confirming a 2-request takeover via an empty default IP allowlist exposing 12 unauthenticated MCP tool calls reinforces the agent-credential-reachable precondition, but no OWASP / CIS top-list entry naming Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration as a category lands inside the window.
text_locales.ja: The Hacker NewsのNginx UI MCPwn分析が、12個の認証なしMCPツール・コールを公開する空のデフォルトIPアロウリスト経由の2リクエスト乗っ取りを確認し、エージェント認証情報到達可能の前提条件を補強しているが、ウィンドウ内ではAgent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltrationをカテゴリとして名指しするOWASP / CISトップリスト・エントリは登場していない。
text_locales.es: El writeup MCPwn de Nginx UI de The Hacker News confirmando una toma de control de 2 solicitudes vía una lista de IPs permitidas vacía por defecto exponiendo 12 llamadas a herramientas MCP no autenticadas refuerza la precondición agent-credential-reachable, pero ninguna entrada de top-list OWASP / CIS que nombre Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration como categoría aterriza dentro de la ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang Nginx UI MCPwn writeup ng The Hacker News na nagpapatunay ng 2-request takeover sa pamamagitan ng empty default IP allowlist na naglalantad ng 12 unauthenticated MCP tool calls ay nagpapatibay sa agent-credential-reachable precondition, ngunit walang OWASP / CIS top-list entry na nagpapangalan sa Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration bilang category na lumilitaw sa loob ng window.

bridges.text: Proofpoint's Mercor-to-Mythos connection — 4TB of credentials, biometrics, and API keys leaked through LiteLLM CI/CD becoming the entry path for a frontier-lab breach — plus Exabeam's ABA extension covering all 10 OWASP Agentic Top 10 categories and the formalized AI Insider Threat category across ChatGPT / Copilot / Gemini directly materialize the agent-in-the-loop credential-exfil precondition.

text_locales.en: Proofpoint's Mercor-to-Mythos connection — 4TB of credentials, biometrics, and API keys leaked through LiteLLM CI/CD becoming the entry path for a frontier-lab breach — plus Exabeam's ABA extension covering all 10 OWASP Agentic Top 10 categories and the formalized AI Insider Threat category across ChatGPT / Copilot / Gemini directly materialize the agent-in-the-loop credential-exfil precondition.
text_locales.ja: ProofpointのMercor-Mythos接続 ― LiteLLM CI/CDを通じて流出した4TBのクレデンシャル、バイオメトリクス、APIキーがフロンティア・ラボ侵害の侵入経路となった ― さらにOWASP Agentic Top 10の10カテゴリ全てをカバーするExabeamのABA拡張、ChatGPT / Copilot / Gemini横断で正式化されたAI Insider Threatカテゴリが、エージェント・イン・ザ・ループのクレデンシャル流出の前提条件を直接物質化する。
text_locales.es: La conexión Mercor-a-Mythos de Proofpoint — 4TB de credenciales, biometría y claves API filtrados a través del CI/CD de LiteLLM convirtiéndose en la ruta de entrada para una brecha de laboratorio de frontera — más la extensión de ABA de Exabeam cubriendo las 10 categorías del OWASP Agentic Top 10 y la categoría formalizada de AI Insider Threat en ChatGPT / Copilot / Gemini materializan directamente la precondición de exfil de credenciales agent-in-the-loop.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mercor-to-Mythos connection ng Proofpoint — 4TB ng credentials, biometrics, at API keys na nakaleak sa pamamagitan ng LiteLLM CI/CD na naging entry path para sa frontier-lab breach — kasama ang ABA extension ng Exabeam na sumasaklaw sa lahat ng 10 OWASP Agentic Top 10 categories at ang pormal na AI Insider Threat category sa ChatGPT / Copilot / Gemini ay direktang nagma-materialize sa agent-in-the-loop credential-exfil precondition.

bridges.text: The Mythos Preview day-one breach via contractor credentials + Mercor leak + naming reconstruction, alongside OAuth2 Proxy CVE-2026-40575's X-Forwarded-Uri auth bypass, both materialize the agent-in-the-loop credential-exfil shape with concrete real-world incidents reinforcing the precondition.

text_locales.en: The Mythos Preview day-one breach via contractor credentials + Mercor leak + naming reconstruction, alongside OAuth2 Proxy CVE-2026-40575's X-Forwarded-Uri auth bypass, both materialize the agent-in-the-loop credential-exfil shape with concrete real-world incidents reinforcing the precondition.
text_locales.ja: 契約者の認証情報 + Mercorのリーク + 命名再構築によるMythos Previewの初日侵害と、OAuth2 Proxy CVE-2026-40575のX-Forwarded-Uri認証バイパスは、いずれもエージェント・イン・ザ・ループの認証情報窃取の形を、前提条件を強化する具体的な実世界のインシデントで実現している。
text_locales.es: La brecha del día uno de Mythos Preview vía credenciales de contratista + filtración de Mercor + reconstrucción de nomenclatura, junto con el bypass de autenticación X-Forwarded-Uri de OAuth2 Proxy CVE-2026-40575, ambos materializan la forma de exfiltración de credenciales agent-in-the-loop con incidentes concretos del mundo real reforzando la precondición.
text_locales.fil: Ang day-one breach ng Mythos Preview sa pamamagitan ng contractor credentials + Mercor leak + naming reconstruction, kasama ang X-Forwarded-Uri auth bypass ng OAuth2 Proxy CVE-2026-40575, ay parehong nag-aaktwal sa agent-in-the-loop credential-exfil shape gamit ang konkretong real-world incidents na nagpapatibay sa precondition.

bridges.text: Vercel's confirmed supply-chain breach via Context.ai OAuth tokens — with the CEO pointing to AI-assisted attacker speed — and Antigravity's prompt-injection-to-RCE both materialize the agent-in-the-loop exfil shape, putting concrete real-world breaches behind the precondition that ties CI / agents to leaked secrets.

text_locales.en: Vercel's confirmed supply-chain breach via Context.ai OAuth tokens — with the CEO pointing to AI-assisted attacker speed — and Antigravity's prompt-injection-to-RCE both materialize the agent-in-the-loop exfil shape, putting concrete real-world breaches behind the precondition that ties CI / agents to leaked secrets.
text_locales.ja: Context.aiのOAuthトークン経由でVercelが確認したサプライチェーン侵害 — CEOがAI支援による攻撃者の速度を指摘 — と、AntigravityのプロンプトインジェクションからRCEへの転化のいずれもがagent-in-the-loop型の窃取形を実体化させ、CI / エージェントを漏洩した認証情報に結び付ける前提に具体的な現実世界の侵害事例を与えている。
text_locales.es: La brecha confirmada de cadena de suministro de Vercel via tokens OAuth de Context.ai — con el CEO senalando velocidad de atacante asistida por AI — y la RCE por inyeccion de prompt de Antigravity ambas materializan la forma de exfiltracion agente-en-el-loop, poniendo brechas reales concretas detras de la precondicion que ata CI / agentes a secretos filtrados.
text_locales.fil: Ang confirmed supply-chain breach ng Vercel sa pamamagitan ng Context.ai OAuth tokens — kung saan ang CEO ay tumuturo sa AI-assisted attacker speed — at ang prompt-injection-to-RCE ng Antigravity ay parehong nagma-materialize ng agent-in-the-loop exfil shape, naglalagay ng kongkretong real-world breaches sa likod ng precondition na nag-uugnay sa CI / agents sa leaked secrets.

description.en: **The "consumer-GPU coding agent" displaces the cloud-only coding API for ≥30% of dev workloads by Q3 2026.** Apr 22's Qwen3.6-27B (dense, beats 397B-A17B on SWE-bench Verified, **40 tok/s on RTX 3090 at Q4_K_M ~16.8 GB**) + Apr 23 Ollama MLX preview (1.57x prefill / 1.93x decode on M5 Max for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) + DeepSeek V4-Pro 75%-off API (**effectively ~28x cheaper than Claude Opus 4.7**) compose a **3-corner squeeze** on the proprietary frontier-API SaaS model. By Q3 2026, **enterprise dev tools default to a hybrid harness** — local Qwen 3.6-class for "coding, refactor, lint, test" + remote frontier API only for "long-horizon planning / multi-tool reasoning" — and all Big-3 IDEs (Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro Power) ship a **local-first toggle** by default. "Cloud-only coding agent" becomes a 2024-era artifact. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **「コンシューマGPUコーディング・エージェント」がQ3 2026までに開発者ワークロードの30%以上でクラウド専用コーディングAPIを置き換える。** 4月22日のQwen3.6-27B(密、SWE-bench Verifiedで397B-A17Bに勝利、**RTX 3090上Q4_K_M ~16.8 GBで40 tok/s**) + 4月23日のOllama MLXプレビュー(M5 Max上でQwen3.5-35B-A3Bが1.57x プリフィル / 1.93x デコード) + DeepSeek V4-Pro 75%オフAPI(**実質的にClaude Opus 4.7より~28x安い**)が、プロプライエタリ・フロンティアAPIのSaaSモデルに対する**3角圧搾**を構成する。Q3 2026までに、**企業の開発ツールはハイブリッド・ハーネスをデフォルトとする** ― 「コーディング、リファクタ、リント、テスト」にはローカルのQwen 3.6クラスを、「長期計画 / 多ツール推論」にはリモート・フロンティアAPIのみ ― そしてビッグ3 IDE(Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro Power)はすべて**ローカル・ファースト・トグル**をデフォルトで出荷する。「クラウド専用コーディング・エージェント」は2024年代の遺物となる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **El "agente de codificación con GPU de consumo" desplaza a la API de codificación solo en la nube para ≥30% de las cargas de desarrollo para Q3 2026.** Qwen3.6-27B del 22 de abril (denso, supera a 397B-A17B en SWE-bench Verified, **40 tok/s en RTX 3090 a Q4_K_M ~16.8 GB**) + el preview de Ollama MLX del 23 de abril (1.57x prefill / 1.93x decode en M5 Max para Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) + DeepSeek V4-Pro con API 75% de descuento (**efectivamente ~28x más barato que Claude Opus 4.7**) componen un **apretón de 3 esquinas** sobre el modelo SaaS de API de frontera propietaria. Para Q3 2026, **las herramientas de desarrollo empresariales adoptan por defecto un harness híbrido** — Qwen 3.6-class local para "codificación, refactor, lint, test" + API de frontera remota solo para "planificación de largo horizonte / razonamiento multi-herramienta" — y todos los IDE Big-3 (Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro Power) lanzan un **conmutador local-first** por defecto. "Agente de codificación solo en la nube" se convierte en un artefacto de la era de 2024. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

text_locales.es: El runtime nativo de Windows de Foundry Local, la aceleración de inferencia 20-30% de Unsloth, y la pila open-weight china juntos mantienen el techo de codificación de GPU de consumidor subiendo lo bastante rápido para ratificar el cambio predicho de harness híbrido dentro de los IDE empresariales.
text_locales.fil: Ang Windows-native runtime ng Foundry Local, ang 20-30% inference speedup ng Unsloth, at ang Chinese open-weight stack ay magkakasamang nagpapanatili ng pataas na consumer-GPU coding ceiling nang sapat na bilis upang i-ratify ang hinulang hybrid-harness shift sa loob ng enterprise IDEs.

bridges.text: Bonsai-8B at iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus Foundry Local's WinML execution-provider integration sustains the consumer-GPU-coding-agent thesis on the local side, while Codex CLI 0.128.0's model-provider-owned discovery pulls in the opposite direction by binding tooling more tightly to cloud accounts. Mixed signal — the local stack is densifying but the cloud stack is also defending.

text_locales.en: Bonsai-8B at iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus Foundry Local's WinML execution-provider integration sustains the consumer-GPU-coding-agent thesis on the local side, while Codex CLI 0.128.0's model-provider-owned discovery pulls in the opposite direction by binding tooling more tightly to cloud accounts. Mixed signal — the local stack is densifying but the cloud stack is also defending.
text_locales.ja: Bonsai-8BのiPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090スループットに加え、Foundry LocalのWinML実行プロバイダー統合は、ローカル側でコンシューマーGPUコーディングエージェントテーゼを支えるが、Codex CLI 0.128.0のモデルプロバイダー所有のディスカバリーは、ツールをクラウドアカウントにより緊密に結合することで反対方向に引っ張る。混合シグナル ― ローカルスタックは高密度化しているが、クラウドスタックも防衛している。
text_locales.es: Bonsai-8B con throughput en iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 más la integración del execution-provider WinML de Foundry Local sostiene la tesis de consumer-GPU-coding-agent en el lado local, mientras que el discovery model-provider-owned de Codex CLI 0.128.0 tira en dirección opuesta atando el tooling más fuertemente a las cuentas cloud. Señal mixta — el stack local se está densificando pero el stack cloud también se está defendiendo.
text_locales.fil: Ang Bonsai-8B sa iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus ang WinML execution-provider integration ng Foundry Local ay sumusuporta sa consumer-GPU-coding-agent thesis sa local side, habang ang model-provider-owned discovery ng Codex CLI 0.128.0 ay humahatak sa kabilang direksyon sa pamamagitan ng pagbubuklod ng tooling nang mas mahigpit sa cloud accounts. Mixed signal — ang local stack ay tumitindi ngunit ang cloud stack ay nagde-defend din.

bridges.text: Bonsai-8B 1-bit at iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus Foundry Local's ~20MB native library on WinML execution providers and vLLM v0.19.0 land the consumer-GPU coding-agent stack densely enough to support the 30%-displacement framing the prediction calls for. The cost-per-token squeeze is real and Windows-default integration is now in reach.

text_locales.en: Bonsai-8B 1-bit at iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus Foundry Local's ~20MB native library on WinML execution providers and vLLM v0.19.0 land the consumer-GPU coding-agent stack densely enough to support the 30%-displacement framing the prediction calls for. The cost-per-token squeeze is real and Windows-default integration is now in reach.
text_locales.ja: iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090スループットでのBonsai-8B 1ビットに加え、WinML実行プロバイダ上のFoundry Localの約20MBネイティブライブラリとvLLM v0.19.0は、予測が求める30%置換枠組みを支えるのに十分密に消費者向けGPUコーディングエージェントスタックを着地させる。トークンあたりコストの圧縮は本物であり、Windowsデフォルト統合は今や手の届く範囲にある。
text_locales.es: Bonsai-8B 1-bit a throughput de iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 más la librería nativa de ~20MB de Foundry Local sobre execution providers de WinML y vLLM v0.19.0 aterrizan el stack de coding-agent en GPU-de-consumidor lo suficientemente densamente como para soportar el encuadre de 30%-de-desplazamiento que pide la predicción. La compresión de costo-por-token es real y la integración por defecto en Windows está ahora al alcance.
text_locales.fil: Ang Bonsai-8B 1-bit sa iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput kasama ang ~20MB native library ng Foundry Local sa WinML execution providers at ang vLLM v0.19.0 ay naglalapag ng consumer-GPU coding-agent stack na sapat ang lapot upang suportahan ang 30%-displacement framing na hinihingi ng prediction. Tunay ang cost-per-token squeeze at ang Windows-default integration ay malapit na.

bridges.text: Bonsai-8B's 1.15 GB single-file deployment at 368 tok/s on RTX 4090, Unsloth's Gemma-4-E2B 8 GB VRAM training path, and Multica v0.2.18's vendor-neutral orchestrator deepen the on-device coding-agent stack the prediction stitches together. The 3-corner squeeze on cloud-only coding APIs continues to materialize on consumer hardware.

text_locales.en: Bonsai-8B's 1.15 GB single-file deployment at 368 tok/s on RTX 4090, Unsloth's Gemma-4-E2B 8 GB VRAM training path, and Multica v0.2.18's vendor-neutral orchestrator deepen the on-device coding-agent stack the prediction stitches together. The 3-corner squeeze on cloud-only coding APIs continues to materialize on consumer hardware.
text_locales.ja: Bonsai-8BのRTX 4090上1.15 GBシングルファイル・デプロイメント(368 tok/s)、UnslothのGemma-4-E2B 8 GB VRAMトレーニング・パス、Multica v0.2.18のベンダー中立オーケストレーターが、予測が縫い合わせるオンデバイス・コーディング・エージェント・スタックを深化させる。クラウド限定コーディングAPIに対する3コーナー・スクイーズが、コンシューマー・ハードウェア上で物質化し続けている。
text_locales.es: El despliegue de archivo-unico de 1.15 GB de Bonsai-8B a 368 tok/s en RTX 4090, el path de entrenamiento Gemma-4-E2B 8 GB VRAM de Unsloth, y el orchestrator vendor-neutral de Multica v0.2.18 profundizan el stack de coding-agent on-device que la prediccion une. La presion de 3-esquinas sobre las APIs de codificacion solo-nube continua materializandose en hardware consumer.
text_locales.fil: Ang 1.15 GB single-file deployment ng Bonsai-8B sa 368 tok/s sa RTX 4090, ang Gemma-4-E2B 8 GB VRAM training path ng Unsloth, at ang vendor-neutral orchestrator ng Multica v0.2.18 ay nagpapalalim sa on-device coding-agent stack na pinagsasama-sama ng hula. Ang 3-corner squeeze sa cloud-only coding APIs ay patuloy na nag-mamaterialize sa consumer hardware.

bridges.text: Bonsai-8B's on-device throughput, Unsloth's consumer-GPU fine-tuning maturation, and Multica's vendor-neutral orchestration all reinforce the structural conditions the displacement thesis depends on, with the local stack hardening in the same window the prediction expected.

text_locales.en: Bonsai-8B's on-device throughput, Unsloth's consumer-GPU fine-tuning maturation, and Multica's vendor-neutral orchestration all reinforce the structural conditions the displacement thesis depends on, with the local stack hardening in the same window the prediction expected.
text_locales.ja: Bonsai-8B のオンデバイス スループット、Unsloth のコンシューマ GPU ファインチューニング成熟、Multica のベンダー中立オーケストレーションはいずれも、置換テーゼが依拠する構造的条件を補強する — ローカル スタックは予測が見込んだ同じウィンドウで硬化している。
text_locales.es: El throughput on-device de Bonsai-8B, la maduración de fine-tuning consumer-GPU de Unsloth, y la orquestación vendor-neutral de Multica refuerzan las condiciones estructurales en las que depende la tesis de desplazamiento, con el local stack endureciéndose en la misma ventana que esperaba la predicción.
text_locales.fil: Ang on-device throughput ng Bonsai-8B, ang consumer-GPU fine-tuning maturation ng Unsloth, at ang vendor-neutral orchestration ng Multica ay lahat nagpapatatag sa structural conditions na inaasahan ng displacement thesis, kasama ang local stack na tumitibay sa parehong window na inaasahan ng prediction.

bridges.text: Practitioner momentum (Willison on V4 + SwiftUI), Bonsai's on-device performance, and Foundry Local's developer-path messaging all reinforce the structural conditions the displacement thesis depends on through Apr 25-27.

text_locales.en: Practitioner momentum (Willison on V4 + SwiftUI), Bonsai's on-device performance, and Foundry Local's developer-path messaging all reinforce the structural conditions the displacement thesis depends on through Apr 25-27.
text_locales.ja: 実務者のモメンタム (Willison の V4 + SwiftUI)、Bonsai のオンデバイス性能、そして Foundry Local の開発者パス メッセージングは、いずれも 4/25-27 を通じて置き換え仮説が依存する構造的な条件を補強している。
text_locales.es: El impulso de los profesionales (Willison sobre V4 + SwiftUI), el rendimiento on-device de Bonsai, y el mensaje de camino-de-desarrollador de Foundry Local refuerzan todos las condiciones estructurales de las que depende la tesis del desplazamiento del 25 al 27 de abril.
text_locales.fil: Ang practitioner momentum (Willison sa V4 + SwiftUI), ang on-device performance ng Bonsai, at ang developer-path messaging ng Foundry Local ay lahat nagpapatibay sa structural conditions na inaasa ng displacement thesis sa kabuuan ng Apr 25-27.

detail.description: **The "consumer-GPU coding agent" displaces the cloud-only coding API for ≥30% of dev workloads by Q3 2026.** Apr 22's Qwen3.6-27B (dense, beats 397B-A17B on SWE-bench Verified, **40 tok/s on RTX 3090 at Q4_K_M ~16.8 GB**) + Apr 23 Ollama MLX preview (1.57x prefill / 1.93x decode on M5 Max for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) + DeepSeek V4-Pro 75%-off API (**effectively ~28x cheaper than Claude Opus 4.7**) compose a **3-corner squeeze** on the proprietary frontier-API SaaS model. By Q3 2026, **enterprise dev tools default to a hybrid harness** — local Qwen 3.6-class for "coding, refactor, lint, test" + remote frontier API only for "long-horizon planning / multi-tool reasoning" — and all Big-3 IDEs (Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro Power) ship a **local-first toggle** by default. "Cloud-only coding agent" becomes a 2024-era artifact. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

nodes.title: Multi-cloud frontier-model SLA standardization wave breaks by H2 2026
nodes.description: By H2 2026 the OpenAI-on-AWS-Bedrock + Microsoft-license-non-exclusive reset triggers a multi-cloud frontier-model SLA standardization wave — at least one Big-3 hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP) publishes per-model latency / throughput / availability SLAs as a single comparable disclosure, and at least one non-OpenAI foundation lab (Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI) ships a mirror "frontier on every cloud" deal with parallel SLA disclosure. Apr 27 Microsoft–OpenAI partnership reset removed the cloud-exclusivity clause; Apr 28 OpenAI-on-Bedrock (limited preview) is the first cross-cloud frontier-model deployment in the post-exclusivity world; Apr 30 Codex CLI 0.128.0 model-provider-owned discovery + AWS Bedrock account-state exposure is the developer-side primitive; Apr 28 AWS Bedrock AgentCore Node.js + AgentCore CLI 14-region GA + Managed Harness 4-region preview is the orchestration substrate; Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA + Toolbox preview is the parallel non-Bedrock path. The forcing function is enterprise procurement — once frontier models cross-deploy, the buyer's first comparison stops being "model" and starts being "model+SLA on cloud-of-record". The first SLA-standardization mover is most likely AWS Bedrock (because Bedrock has the broadest model selection and the strongest enterprise compliance posture); the first non-OpenAI mirror is most likely Anthropic given the Apr 27 Microsoft non-exclusive language explicitly applies to "OpenAI products" and creates white-space for parallel deals.

Ang forcing function ay ang enterprise procurement — kapag nag-cross-deploy na ang frontier models, ang unang paghahambing ng buyer ay hindi na "model" lang kundi "model+SLA on cloud-of-record". Ang unang SLA-standardization mover ay malamang AWS Bedrock (dahil ang Bedrock ang may pinakamalawak na model selection at pinakamalakas na enterprise compliance posture); ang unang non-OpenAI mirror ay malamang Anthropic dahil ang Apr 27 Microsoft non-exclusive language ay explicit na nag-aapply sa "OpenAI products" at lumilikha ng white-space para sa parallel deals.

detail.description: By H2 2026 the OpenAI-on-AWS-Bedrock + Microsoft-license-non-exclusive reset triggers a multi-cloud frontier-model SLA standardization wave — at least one Big-3 hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP) publishes per-model latency / throughput / availability SLAs as a single comparable disclosure, and at least one non-OpenAI foundation lab (Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI) ships a mirror "frontier on every cloud" deal with parallel SLA disclosure. Apr 27 Microsoft–OpenAI partnership reset removed the cloud-exclusivity clause; Apr 28 OpenAI-on-Bedrock (limited preview) is the first cross-cloud frontier-model deployment in the post-exclusivity world; Apr 30 Codex CLI 0.128.0 model-provider-owned discovery + AWS Bedrock account-state exposure is the developer-side primitive; Apr 28 AWS Bedrock AgentCore Node.js + AgentCore CLI 14-region GA + Managed Harness 4-region preview is the orchestration substrate; Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA + Toolbox preview is the parallel non-Bedrock path. The forcing function is enterprise procurement — once frontier models cross-deploy, the buyer's first comparison stops being "model" and starts being "model+SLA on cloud-of-record". The first SLA-standardization mover is most likely AWS Bedrock (because Bedrock has the broadest model selection and the strongest enterprise compliance posture); the first non-OpenAI mirror is most likely Anthropic given the Apr 27 Microsoft non-exclusive language explicitly applies to "OpenAI products" and creates white-space for parallel deals.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2026年下半期までに、OpenAI-on-AWS-Bedrock+Microsoftライセンス非排他リセットがマルチクラウドのフロンティアモデルSLA標準化の波を引き起こす ― 少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラー(AWS、Azure、GCP)がモデル別のレイテンシ／スループット／可用性SLAを単一の比較可能な開示として公表し、少なくとも1つの非OpenAIファウンデーションラボ(Anthropic、Google DeepMind、xAI)が並行するSLA開示を伴う「すべてのクラウド上のフロンティア」のミラー契約を出荷する。4月27日のMicrosoft–OpenAIパートナーシップリセットはクラウド排他性条項を取り除き、4月28日のOpenAI-on-Bedrock(限定プレビュー)はポスト排他性世界における最初のクロスクラウドフロンティアモデル展開となり、4月30日のCodex CLI 0.128.0のモデルプロバイダー所有のディスカバリー+AWS Bedrockアカウント状態の公開は開発者側のプリミティブであり、4月28日のAWS Bedrock AgentCore Node.js+AgentCore CLI 14リージョンGA+Managed Harness 4リージョンプレビューはオーケストレーション基盤であり、4月30日のMicrosoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA+Toolboxプレビューは並行する非Bedrockのパスである。強制関数は企業調達である ― フロンティアモデルがクロスデプロイされると、買い手の最初の比較は「モデル」ではなく「記録対象クラウド上のモデル+SLA」になる。最初のSLA標準化の動きはAWS Bedrockの可能性が最も高い(Bedrockは最も広範なモデル選択と最強のエンタープライズコンプライアンス姿勢を持つため)。最初の非OpenAIミラーは、4月27日のMicrosoftの非排他言語が明示的に「OpenAI製品」に適用され、並行契約のためのホワイトスペースを作り出していることから、Anthropicの可能性が最も高い。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para H2 2026 el reset OpenAI-en-AWS-Bedrock + licencia-no-exclusiva de Microsoft dispara una ola de estandarización de SLA multi-cloud para modelos frontera — al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 (AWS, Azure, GCP) publica SLAs por modelo de latencia / throughput / disponibilidad como una sola disclosure comparable, y al menos un foundation lab no-OpenAI (Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI) lanza un deal espejo de "frontera en cada cloud" con disclosure paralelo de SLA. El reset de partnership Microsoft–OpenAI del 27 abr removió la cláusula de cloud-exclusivity; OpenAI-en-Bedrock del 28 abr (preview limitado) es el primer despliegue cross-cloud de modelo frontera en el mundo post-exclusividad; el discovery model-provider-owned de Codex CLI 0.128.0 del 30 abr + la exposición de account-state de AWS Bedrock es la primitiva del lado developer; AgentCore Node.js de AWS Bedrock del 28 abr + AgentCore CLI 14-region GA + Managed Harness 4-region preview es el sustrato de orquestación; Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA del 30 abr + Toolbox preview es la ruta paralela no-Bedrock. La función forzante es la procurement empresarial — una vez que los modelos frontera cross-deploy, la primera comparación del comprador deja de ser "modelo" y empieza a ser "modelo+SLA en cloud-of-record". El primer mover de estandarización de SLA es muy probablemente AWS Bedrock (porque Bedrock tiene la selección de modelos más amplia y la postura de compliance empresarial más fuerte); el primer espejo no-OpenAI es muy probablemente Anthropic dado que el lenguaje no-exclusivo de Microsoft del 27 abr aplica explícitamente a "productos OpenAI" y crea white-space para deals paralelos.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang OpenAI-on-AWS-Bedrock + Microsoft-license-non-exclusive reset ay magti-trigger ng multi-cloud frontier-model SLA standardization wave — hindi bababa sa isang Big-3 hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP) ang maglalathala ng per-model latency / throughput / availability SLAs bilang single comparable disclosure, at hindi bababa sa isang non-OpenAI foundation lab (Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI) ang maglulunsad ng mirror "frontier on every cloud" deal na may parallel SLA disclosure. Ang Apr 27 Microsoft–OpenAI partnership reset ang nag-alis ng cloud-exclusivity clause; ang Apr 28 OpenAI-on-Bedrock (limited preview) ang unang cross-cloud frontier-model deployment sa post-exclusivity world; ang Apr 30 Codex CLI 0.128.0 model-provider-owned discovery + AWS Bedrock account-state exposure ang developer-side primitive; ang Apr 28 AWS Bedrock AgentCore Node.js + AgentCore CLI 14-region GA + Managed Harness 4-region preview ang orchestration substrate; ang Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA + Toolbox preview ang parallel non-Bedrock path. Ang forcing function ay ang enterprise procurement — kapag nag-cross-deploy na ang frontier models, ang unang paghahambing ng buyer ay hindi na "model" lang kundi "model+SLA on cloud-of-record". Ang unang SLA-standardization mover ay malamang AWS Bedrock (dahil ang Bedrock ang may pinakamalawak na model selection at pinakamalakas na enterprise compliance posture); ang unang non-OpenAI mirror ay malamang Anthropic dahil ang Apr 27 Microsoft non-exclusive language ay explicit na nag-aapply sa "OpenAI products" at lumilikha ng white-space para sa parallel deals.

nodes.title: Cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP registry converges into draft RFC by Q3 2026
nodes.description: **By Q3 2026 the Microsoft Agent 365 May 1 GA Registry Sync with AWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform + Anthropic MCP SDK ~97M monthly downloads + the parallel Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore stack converges into a published draft RFC (IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation working group) that formalizes the cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP-server inventory + tool-invocation log schema as a standard interop layer.** Forcing function is enterprise procurement: once Microsoft ships the registry-sync primitive at $15/user/mo with M365 admin-surface integration, AWS + Google must either expose parallel surfaces or be absorbed into the Microsoft schema; CSAI's Apr 29 MITRE-CNA authority + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment) provide the threat-side standardization pressure; the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA already standardize the build/runtime layer so the missing piece is the interop-protocol layer the registry-sync proves works; expect Microsoft + AWS + Google to triangulate on a public draft RFC because vendor-specific schemas would lose the M365 + Bedrock + Vertex installed-base anchor advantage. In plain language: Microsoft just made AI agent IDs work across Microsoft, Amazon, and Google clouds — soon a public spec will lock that in. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

description.en: **By Q3 2026 the Microsoft Agent 365 May 1 GA Registry Sync with AWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform + Anthropic MCP SDK ~97M monthly downloads + the parallel Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore stack converges into a published draft RFC (IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation working group) that formalizes the cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP-server inventory + tool-invocation log schema as a standard interop layer.** Forcing function is enterprise procurement: once Microsoft ships the registry-sync primitive at $15/user/mo with M365 admin-surface integration, AWS + Google must either expose parallel surfaces or be absorbed into the Microsoft schema; CSAI's Apr 29 MITRE-CNA authority + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment) provide the threat-side standardization pressure; the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA already standardize the build/runtime layer so the missing piece is the interop-protocol layer the registry-sync proves works; expect Microsoft + AWS + Google to triangulate on a public draft RFC because vendor-specific schemas would lose the M365 + Bedrock + Vertex installed-base anchor advantage. In plain language: Microsoft just made AI agent IDs work across Microsoft, Amazon, and Google clouds — soon a public spec will lock that in. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **2026年Q3までに、Microsoft Agent 365の5月1日GAでのAWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platformとのレジストリ同期、Anthropic MCP SDKの月間~97Mダウンロード、並行する4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCoreスタックが、クラウド横断のエージェントID + MCPサーバーインベントリ + ツール呼び出しログスキーマを標準的な相互運用層として形式化する公開ドラフトRFC(IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation作業部会)へと収斂する。** 強制力はエンタープライズ調達である。Microsoftが$15/user/moでM365管理画面統合を伴うレジストリ同期プリミティブを出荷すれば、AWS + Googleは並行する画面を露出するか、Microsoftスキーマに吸収されるかを迫られる。CSAIの4月29日のMITRE-CNA権限 + ATT&CK v19の命名済み手法(MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェント配備)が脅威側の標準化圧力を提供する。4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GAは既にビルド/ランタイム層を標準化しているため、欠けているのはレジストリ同期が機能することを証明している相互運用プロトコル層だけだ。Microsoft + AWS + Googleが公開ドラフトRFCで三角測量することが期待される。なぜならベンダー固有のスキーマではM365 + Bedrock + Vertexのインストールベース錨点優位を失うからだ。平易な言葉で言えば: MicrosoftがAIエージェントIDをMicrosoft、Amazon、Googleクラウド間で動作させた — まもなく公開仕様がそれを固定化する。
description.es: **Para Q3 2026, la GA del 1 de mayo de Microsoft Agent 365 con Registry Sync hacia AWS Bedrock + la Plataforma de Agentes Empresariales Gemini de Google Cloud Vertex + el SDK MCP de Anthropic con ~97M de descargas mensuales + la convergencia paralela del 30 de abril del OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore se traduce en un borrador de RFC publicado (grupo de trabajo de IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation) que formaliza el esquema de identidad de agentes multi-nube + inventario de servidores MCP + registro de invocaciones de herramientas como una capa estándar de interoperabilidad.** La función forzante es la contratación empresarial: una vez que Microsoft entrega la primitiva de registry-sync a $15/usuario/mes con integración en la superficie de administración de M365, AWS + Google deben exponer superficies paralelas o ser absorbidos en el esquema de Microsoft; la autoridad MITRE-CNA del 29 de abril de CSAI + las técnicas nombradas de ATT&CK v19 (compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue malicioso de agente) aportan la presión estandarizadora del lado de las amenazas; el OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA del 30 de abril ya estandarizan la capa de build/runtime, así que la pieza faltante es la capa de protocolo de interoperabilidad que el registry-sync demuestra que funciona; se espera que Microsoft + AWS + Google triangulen sobre un borrador público de RFC porque los esquemas vendor-específicos perderían la ventaja del ancla de base instalada de M365 + Bedrock + Vertex. En lenguaje sencillo: Microsoft acaba de hacer que los IDs de agentes de IA funcionen entre las nubes de Microsoft, Amazon y Google — pronto una especificación pública lo afianzará.
description.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang Microsoft Agent 365 May 1 GA Registry Sync sa AWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform + Anthropic MCP SDK na may ~97M monthly downloads + ang parallel na Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore stack ay magsasama-sama sa isang inilathalang draft RFC (IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation working group) na nagbibigay ng pormal na anyo sa cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP-server inventory + tool-invocation log schema bilang standard interop layer.** Ang forcing function ay enterprise procurement: kapag inilabas na ng Microsoft ang registry-sync primitive sa $15/user/mo na may M365 admin-surface integration, kailangang ilabas ng AWS + Google ang katumbas na surfaces o masisipsip sila sa Microsoft schema; ang Apr 29 MITRE-CNA authority ng CSAI + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment) ang nagbibigay ng threat-side standardization pressure; ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA ay nagsa-standardize na sa build/runtime layer kaya ang nawawalang piraso ay ang interop-protocol layer na pinatunayan ng registry-sync na gumagana; inaasahang magta-triangulate ang Microsoft + AWS + Google sa isang pampublikong draft RFC dahil ang vendor-specific schemas ay mawawalan ng M365 + Bedrock + Vertex installed-base anchor advantage. Sa madaling salita: pinagana lang ng Microsoft ang AI agent IDs sa kabuuan ng Microsoft, Amazon, at Google clouds — malapit nang lumabas ang isang public spec na maglo-lock niyan.

reasoning.given: OpenAI Agents SDK + Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 + AgentCore standardize build / runtime, and CSAI MITRE-CNA + ATT&CK v19 add the threat-side pressure.

reasoning.plain_language: Microsoft just made AI agent IDs work across Microsoft, Amazon, and Google clouds; the three of them will soon publish a shared spec instead of fighting over it.

detail.summary_short: Microsoft Agent 365 GA Registry Sync with AWS Bedrock + Google Vertex, the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Foundry Agent Framework 1.0, and CSAI MITRE-CNA pressure converge on a published interop layer. By Q3 2026 an IETF / OpenID / CSAI draft RFC for cross-cloud agent identity + MCP inventory + tool-invocation logs is expected to ship.

summary_short_locales.en: Microsoft Agent 365 GA Registry Sync with AWS Bedrock + Google Vertex, the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Foundry Agent Framework 1.0, and CSAI MITRE-CNA pressure converge on a published interop layer. By Q3 2026 an IETF / OpenID / CSAI draft RFC for cross-cloud agent identity + MCP inventory + tool-invocation logs is expected to ship.
summary_short_locales.ja: Microsoft Agent 365 GAのAWS Bedrock + Google Vertexとのレジストリ同期、4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDK + Foundry Agent Framework 1.0、CSAI MITRE-CNA圧力が、公開された相互運用層へと収斂する。2026年Q3までに、クラウド横断のエージェントID + MCPインベントリ + ツール呼び出しログのためのIETF / OpenID / CSAIドラフトRFCの出荷が見込まれる。
summary_short_locales.es: La GA de Microsoft Agent 365 con Registry Sync hacia AWS Bedrock + Google Vertex, el OpenAI Agents SDK + Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 del 30 de abril, y la presión de CSAI MITRE-CNA convergen en una capa de interoperabilidad publicada. Para Q3 2026 se espera un borrador de RFC de IETF / OpenID / CSAI sobre identidad de agentes multi-nube + inventario MCP + registros de invocación de herramientas.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Microsoft Agent 365 GA Registry Sync sa AWS Bedrock + Google Vertex, ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Foundry Agent Framework 1.0, at ang CSAI MITRE-CNA pressure ay nagsasama-sama tungo sa isang inilathalang interop layer. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, inaasahang ilalabas ang isang IETF / OpenID / CSAI draft RFC para sa cross-cloud agent identity + MCP inventory + tool-invocation logs.

bridges.text: The three-hyperscaler parallel landing converges further Sunday: Bedrock's OpenAI agent registry interop moves to public preview for FedRAMP-Moderate; Vertex adds parallel public-preview interop with the Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry; Foundry adds South Korea PIPC and New Zealand GCSB attestation fields; arxiv 2605.06012 supplies the compositional safety scaffolding the converged RFC would cite, with Microsoft joining the MIT/ETH/Anthropic authorship loop.

text_locales.en: The three-hyperscaler parallel landing converges further Sunday: Bedrock's OpenAI agent registry interop moves to public preview for FedRAMP-Moderate; Vertex adds parallel public-preview interop with the Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry; Foundry adds South Korea PIPC and New Zealand GCSB attestation fields; arxiv 2605.06012 supplies the compositional safety scaffolding the converged RFC would cite, with Microsoft joining the MIT/ETH/Anthropic authorship loop.
text_locales.ja: 3ハイパースケーラー並行着地は日曜にさらに収束する: BedrockのOpenAIエージェント・レジストリ相互運用はFedRAMP-Moderate向けパブリック・プレビューへ移行;VertexはClaude Code 3.0サンドボックス化スキル・レジストリとの並行パブリック・プレビュー相互運用を追加;Foundryは韓国PIPCとニュージーランドGCSBアテステーション・フィールドを追加;arxiv 2605.06012は収束RFCが引用する合成安全性足場を供給し、MicrosoftがMIT / ETH / Anthropic著者ループに合流する。
text_locales.es: El aterrizaje paralelo de tres-hyperscaler converge más el domingo: la interop de registro de agente OpenAI de Bedrock pasa a preview público para FedRAMP-Moderate; Vertex añade interop paralelo de preview público con el registro de skills sandboxeado Claude Code 3.0; Foundry añade campos de atestación South Korea PIPC y New Zealand GCSB; arxiv 2605.06012 suministra el andamiaje de seguridad composicional que el RFC convergido citaría, con Microsoft uniéndose al loop de autoría MIT/ETH/Anthropic.
text_locales.fil: Mas nag-co-converge ang three-hyperscaler parallel landing noong Linggo: lumilipat ang OpenAI agent registry interop ng Bedrock sa public preview para sa FedRAMP-Moderate; nagdaragdag ang Vertex ng parallel public-preview interop sa Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry; nagdaragdag ang Foundry ng South Korea PIPC at New Zealand GCSB attestation fields; nagbibigay ang arxiv 2605.06012 ng compositional safety scaffolding na sisipiin ng converged RFC, kasama ang Microsoft na sumasama sa MIT/ETH/Anthropic authorship loop.

bridges.text: Mistral Workflows landing in EU Tier-1 production with control-plane / data-plane separation plus the Cisco-Astrix NHI carry plus the n8n / Flowise CVE wave tighten the structural force the cross-cloud RFC prediction (May 3) names: the MCP-registry + agent-identity standards gap is operationally visible across both vendor-stack architectures and CVE-class attack patterns.

text_locales.en: Mistral Workflows landing in EU Tier-1 production with control-plane / data-plane separation plus the Cisco-Astrix NHI carry plus the n8n / Flowise CVE wave tighten the structural force the cross-cloud RFC prediction (May 3) names: the MCP-registry + agent-identity standards gap is operationally visible across both vendor-stack architectures and CVE-class attack patterns.
text_locales.ja: Mistral Workflowsがコントロールプレーンとデータプレーンの分離とともにEU Tier-1本番に着地、Cisco-Astrix NHIキャリ、n8n / Flowise CVEウェーブが、クロスクラウドRFC予測(5月3日)が指摘する構造的力を強化する: MCPレジストリ + エージェント・アイデンティティの標準ギャップは、ベンダー・スタック・アーキテクチャとCVEクラス攻撃パターンの両方にわたって運用上可視化されている。
text_locales.es: Mistral Workflows aterrizando en producción Tier-1 UE con separación plano-control / plano-datos más la traída Cisco-Astrix NHI más la ola de CVEs n8n / Flowise tensan la fuerza estructural que nombra la predicción cross-cloud RFC (3 may): la brecha de estándares registro-MCP + agent-identity es operacionalmente visible tanto en arquitecturas vendor-stack como en patrones de ataque clase-CVE.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mistral Workflows na naka-land sa EU Tier-1 production na may control-plane / data-plane separation plus ang Cisco-Astrix NHI carry plus ang n8n / Flowise CVE wave ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinapangalanan ng cross-cloud RFC prediction (Mayo 3): ang MCP-registry + agent-identity standards gap ay operationally visible sa parehong vendor-stack architectures at CVE-class attack patterns.

bridges.text: Cisco's May 4 Astrix acquisition making non-human-identity discovery + governance an M&A primitive, plus the CSA first-pillar framing, plus ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (roughly half with no authorization controls) keep the precondition warm: federal CISO offices and banking regulators now need a published-standard reference above the vendor-specific architecture diagrams.

text_locales.en: Cisco's May 4 Astrix acquisition making non-human-identity discovery + governance an M&A primitive, plus the CSA first-pillar framing, plus ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (roughly half with no authorization controls) keep the precondition warm: federal CISO offices and banking regulators now need a published-standard reference above the vendor-specific architecture diagrams.
text_locales.ja: Ciscoの5月4日 Astrix買収が非人間アイデンティティのディスカバリ + ガバナンスをM&Aプリミティブにすること、CSAの第一の柱フレーミング、約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバー(およそ半数は認可制御なし)が前提条件を温存している: 連邦CISOオフィスと銀行規制当局は現在、ベンダー固有のアーキテクチャ図の上の公表された標準リファレンスを必要とする。
text_locales.es: La adquisición Astrix de Cisco del 4 de mayo haciendo del descubrimiento + gobernanza de identidad no humana una primitiva M&A, más el framing de primer pilar de CSA, más ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet (aproximadamente la mitad sin controles de autorización) mantienen caliente la precondición: las oficinas CISO federales y los reguladores bancarios ahora necesitan una referencia de estándar publicado por encima de los diagramas de arquitectura específicos de proveedores.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 4 Astrix acquisition ng Cisco na ginagawa ang non-human-identity discovery + governance bilang M&A primitive, plus ang first-pillar framing ng CSA, plus ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (humigit-kumulang kalahati ay walang authorization controls) ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang precondition: ang federal CISO offices at banking regulators ngayon ay nangangailangan ng published-standard reference sa ibabaw ng vendor-specific architecture diagrams.

bridges.text: The RSAC-week Microsoft + Cisco + CSA convergence on agent-as-first-class-identity reinforces the structural force the prediction names: the platform-side schema-lock pressure on AWS + Google is now operative, but no working group publishes a public draft RFC in the window.

text_locales.en: The RSAC-week Microsoft + Cisco + CSA convergence on agent-as-first-class-identity reinforces the structural force the prediction names: the platform-side schema-lock pressure on AWS + Google is now operative, but no working group publishes a public draft RFC in the window.
text_locales.ja: RSACウィークのMicrosoft + Cisco + CSAのエージェントをファーストクラス・アイデンティティとして扱うことへの収斂は、予測が指摘する構造的な強制力を強化する: AWS + Googleに対するプラットフォーム側のスキーマロック・プレッシャーは現在運用されているが、ワーキンググループはウィンドウ内で公開草案RFCを公表しない。
text_locales.es: La convergencia de Microsoft + Cisco + CSA durante la semana RSAC sobre agente-como-identidad-de-primera-clase refuerza la fuerza estructural que la predicción nombra: la presión de bloqueo de esquema del lado plataforma sobre AWS + Google ahora es operativa, pero ningún grupo de trabajo publica un borrador RFC público en la ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang RSAC-week Microsoft + Cisco + CSA convergence sa agent-as-first-class-identity ay nagpapatibay sa structural force na pinangalanan ng prediction: ang platform-side schema-lock pressure sa AWS + Google ay aktibo na ngayon, ngunit walang working group na naglalathala ng public draft RFC sa window.

detail.description: **By Q3 2026 the Microsoft Agent 365 May 1 GA Registry Sync with AWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform + Anthropic MCP SDK ~97M monthly downloads + the parallel Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore stack converges into a published draft RFC (IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation working group) that formalizes the cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP-server inventory + tool-invocation log schema as a standard interop layer.** Forcing function is enterprise procurement: once Microsoft ships the registry-sync primitive at $15/user/mo with M365 admin-surface integration, AWS + Google must either expose parallel surfaces or be absorbed into the Microsoft schema; CSAI's Apr 29 MITRE-CNA authority + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment) provide the threat-side standardization pressure; the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA already standardize the build/runtime layer so the missing piece is the interop-protocol layer the registry-sync proves works; expect Microsoft + AWS + Google to triangulate on a public draft RFC because vendor-specific schemas would lose the M365 + Bedrock + Vertex installed-base anchor advantage. In plain language: Microsoft just made AI agent IDs work across Microsoft, Amazon, and Google clouds — soon a public spec will lock that in. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.en: **By Q3 2026 the Microsoft Agent 365 May 1 GA Registry Sync with AWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform + Anthropic MCP SDK ~97M monthly downloads + the parallel Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore stack converges into a published draft RFC (IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation working group) that formalizes the cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP-server inventory + tool-invocation log schema as a standard interop layer.** Forcing function is enterprise procurement: once Microsoft ships the registry-sync primitive at $15/user/mo with M365 admin-surface integration, AWS + Google must either expose parallel surfaces or be absorbed into the Microsoft schema; CSAI's Apr 29 MITRE-CNA authority + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment) provide the threat-side standardization pressure; the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA already standardize the build/runtime layer so the missing piece is the interop-protocol layer the registry-sync proves works; expect Microsoft + AWS + Google to triangulate on a public draft RFC because vendor-specific schemas would lose the M365 + Bedrock + Vertex installed-base anchor advantage. In plain language: Microsoft just made AI agent IDs work across Microsoft, Amazon, and Google clouds — soon a public spec will lock that in. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年Q3までに、Microsoft Agent 365の5月1日GAでのAWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platformとのレジストリ同期、Anthropic MCP SDKの月間~97Mダウンロード、並行する4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCoreスタックが、クラウド横断のエージェントID + MCPサーバーインベントリ + ツール呼び出しログスキーマを標準的な相互運用層として形式化する公開ドラフトRFC(IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation作業部会)へと収斂する。** 強制力はエンタープライズ調達である。Microsoftが$15/user/moでM365管理画面統合を伴うレジストリ同期プリミティブを出荷すれば、AWS + Googleは並行する画面を露出するか、Microsoftスキーマに吸収されるかを迫られる。CSAIの4月29日のMITRE-CNA権限 + ATT&CK v19の命名済み手法(MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェント配備)が脅威側の標準化圧力を提供する。4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GAは既にビルド/ランタイム層を標準化しているため、欠けているのはレジストリ同期が機能することを証明している相互運用プロトコル層だけだ。Microsoft + AWS + Googleが公開ドラフトRFCで三角測量することが期待される。なぜならベンダー固有のスキーマではM365 + Bedrock + Vertexのインストールベース錨点優位を失うからだ。平易な言葉で言えば: MicrosoftがAIエージェントIDをMicrosoft、Amazon、Googleクラウド間で動作させた — まもなく公開仕様がそれを固定化する。
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para Q3 2026, la GA del 1 de mayo de Microsoft Agent 365 con Registry Sync hacia AWS Bedrock + la Plataforma de Agentes Empresariales Gemini de Google Cloud Vertex + el SDK MCP de Anthropic con ~97M de descargas mensuales + la convergencia paralela del 30 de abril del OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore se traduce en un borrador de RFC publicado (grupo de trabajo de IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation) que formaliza el esquema de identidad de agentes multi-nube + inventario de servidores MCP + registro de invocaciones de herramientas como una capa estándar de interoperabilidad.** La función forzante es la contratación empresarial: una vez que Microsoft entrega la primitiva de registry-sync a $15/usuario/mes con integración en la superficie de administración de M365, AWS + Google deben exponer superficies paralelas o ser absorbidos en el esquema de Microsoft; la autoridad MITRE-CNA del 29 de abril de CSAI + las técnicas nombradas de ATT&CK v19 (compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue malicioso de agente) aportan la presión estandarizadora del lado de las amenazas; el OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA del 30 de abril ya estandarizan la capa de build/runtime, así que la pieza faltante es la capa de protocolo de interoperabilidad que el registry-sync demuestra que funciona; se espera que Microsoft + AWS + Google triangulen sobre un borrador público de RFC porque los esquemas vendor-específicos perderían la ventaja del ancla de base instalada de M365 + Bedrock + Vertex. En lenguaje sencillo: Microsoft acaba de hacer que los IDs de agentes de IA funcionen entre las nubes de Microsoft, Amazon y Google — pronto una especificación pública lo afianzará.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang Microsoft Agent 365 May 1 GA Registry Sync sa AWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform + Anthropic MCP SDK na may ~97M monthly downloads + ang parallel na Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore stack ay magsasama-sama sa isang inilathalang draft RFC (IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation working group) na nagbibigay ng pormal na anyo sa cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP-server inventory + tool-invocation log schema bilang standard interop layer.** Ang forcing function ay enterprise procurement: kapag inilabas na ng Microsoft ang registry-sync primitive sa $15/user/mo na may M365 admin-surface integration, kailangang ilabas ng AWS + Google ang katumbas na surfaces o masisipsip sila sa Microsoft schema; ang Apr 29 MITRE-CNA authority ng CSAI + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment) ang nagbibigay ng threat-side standardization pressure; ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA ay nagsa-standardize na sa build/runtime layer kaya ang nawawalang piraso ay ang interop-protocol layer na pinatunayan ng registry-sync na gumagana; inaasahang magta-triangulate ang Microsoft + AWS + Google sa isang pampublikong draft RFC dahil ang vendor-specific schemas ay mawawalan ng M365 + Bedrock + Vertex installed-base anchor advantage. Sa madaling salita: pinagana lang ng Microsoft ang AI agent IDs sa kabuuan ng Microsoft, Amazon, at Google clouds — malapit nang lumabas ang isang public spec na maglo-lock niyan.

nodes.description: By Q1 2027 the May 9 Mistral AI Workflows day-nine sovereign-cloud landing — France's Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) selecting Workflows for tax-return anomaly-detection routing across the central tax-administration estate with the Workflows control-plane separation architecture plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker model explicitly named as procurement deciders over LangGraph self-hosted plus the Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry, paid Workflows tenancy lifting to 296 enterprise customers (vs 290 Friday) with daily-execution count crossing 4.4M, and the parallel Workflows-Codestral integration note showing per-step token-budget bookkeeping interoperates with the OpenAI Codex CLI /agent Plan-Apply mode export format — combined with the May 8 BNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital go-live cohort that lifted tenancy past 290, the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter now extended to South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB inside the May 9 weekend extension, and the NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist naming LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391 as disallowed pre-patch versions — force the next wave of EU central-government and allied-jurisdiction AI-orchestrator RFPs to name a Workflows-shaped sovereign-cloud tenancy clause (control-plane separation between tenant data and orchestrator runtime, sovereign-cloud execution-worker model with named-jurisdiction execution boundary, per-step token-budget bookkeeping interoperable with the OpenAI Codex CLI export format) as a baseline procurement-eligibility requirement rather than a discretionary scoring criterion. The forcing function is that once a flagship central-tax-administration estate cites the architecture by name as the decider against the two leading US alternatives, EU member-state procurement frameworks and Indo-Pacific reciprocity signatories have a defensible reference template they can require without authoring bespoke language. The most likely shape is a four-jurisdiction cohort (France DGFiP-equivalent + Germany BSI-equivalent + at least one Singapore/Japan signatory + at least one Five Eyes ally) treating sovereign-cloud control-plane separation plus execution-worker jurisdiction plus token-budget interop as the paired clauses; sovereign-cloud and FedRAMP-Moderate tenants adopt first because the AISI-administered cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter is already the operative threshold. Bear case is that AWS Bedrock Agent Registry's FedRAMP-Moderate inheritance plus the Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center reciprocity-attestation field add ships a hyperscaler-managed sovereign-cloud equivalent first; absent that, Q1 2027 lands the Workflows-shaped tenancy clause across the cohort.

description.en: By Q1 2027 the May 9 Mistral AI Workflows day-nine sovereign-cloud landing — France's Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) selecting Workflows for tax-return anomaly-detection routing across the central tax-administration estate with the Workflows control-plane separation architecture plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker model explicitly named as procurement deciders over LangGraph self-hosted plus the Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry, paid Workflows tenancy lifting to 296 enterprise customers (vs 290 Friday) with daily-execution count crossing 4.4M, and the parallel Workflows-Codestral integration note showing per-step token-budget bookkeeping interoperates with the OpenAI Codex CLI /agent Plan-Apply mode export format — combined with the May 8 BNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital go-live cohort that lifted tenancy past 290, the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter now extended to South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB inside the May 9 weekend extension, and the NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist naming LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391 as disallowed pre-patch versions — force the next wave of EU central-government and allied-jurisdiction AI-orchestrator RFPs to name a Workflows-shaped sovereign-cloud tenancy clause (control-plane separation between tenant data and orchestrator runtime, sovereign-cloud execution-worker model with named-jurisdiction execution boundary, per-step token-budget bookkeeping interoperable with the OpenAI Codex CLI export format) as a baseline procurement-eligibility requirement rather than a discretionary scoring criterion. The forcing function is that once a flagship central-tax-administration estate cites the architecture by name as the decider against the two leading US alternatives, EU member-state procurement frameworks and Indo-Pacific reciprocity signatories have a defensible reference template they can require without authoring bespoke language. The most likely shape is a four-jurisdiction cohort (France DGFiP-equivalent + Germany BSI-equivalent + at least one Singapore/Japan signatory + at least one Five Eyes ally) treating sovereign-cloud control-plane separation plus execution-worker jurisdiction plus token-budget interop as the paired clauses; sovereign-cloud and FedRAMP-Moderate tenants adopt first because the AISI-administered cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter is already the operative threshold. Bear case is that AWS Bedrock Agent Registry's FedRAMP-Moderate inheritance plus the Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center reciprocity-attestation field add ships a hyperscaler-managed sovereign-cloud equivalent first; absent that, Q1 2027 lands the Workflows-shaped tenancy clause across the cohort.
description.ja: Q1 2027までに、5月9日のMistral AI Workflows 9日目ソブリン・クラウド着地 — フランスのDirection Générale des Finances Publiques(DGFiP)が中央税務行政資産全体での税還付異常検知ルーティングにWorkflowsを選定し、Workflowsのコントロール・プレーン分離アーキテクチャとソブリン・クラウド実行ワーカー・モデルを、LangGraphセルフホストおよびAnthropic Claude Code 3.0レジストリに対する調達決定要因として明示的に指名;有償Workflowsテナンシーが296エンタープライズ顧客(金曜の290社から)に上昇し、日次実行カウントが4.4Mを超え、並行するWorkflows-Codestral統合ノートが、ステップごとのトークン予算記録がOpenAI Codex CLIの/agent Plan-Applyモード・エクスポート形式と相互運用可能であることを示す — に、5月8日のBNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital本番稼働コホート(テナンシーを290超に押し上げた)、5月9日の週末拡張内でSingapore IMDA / Japan AISIサイバー評価レシプロシティ境界が韓国PIPC + ニュージーランドGCSBへ拡張されたこと、NHS Englandエージェンティック AIワークフロー・プラットフォームCVEブロックリストがLangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391を非許可プリパッチ・バージョンとして指名したことが組み合わさり、次のEU中央政府および同盟国管轄AIオーケストレータRFPに、Workflowsの形をしたソブリン・クラウド・テナンシー条項(テナント・データとオーケストレータ・ランタイムの間のコントロール・プレーン分離、名指し管轄実行境界を備えるソブリン・クラウド実行ワーカー・モデル、OpenAI Codex CLIエクスポート形式と相互運用可能なステップごとのトークン予算記録)を、裁量的スコアリング基準ではなくベースラインの調達適格性要件として指名することを強制する。強制機能は、フラッグシップ中央税務行政資産がアーキテクチャを名指しで2つの主要米国代替に対する決定要因として引用するや否や、EU加盟国の調達フレームワークおよびインド太平洋レシプロシティ・シグナトリは、ビスポーク言語を起草せずに要求できる擁護可能な参照テンプレートを持つことである。最も可能性の高い形状は4管轄区域コホート(France DGFiP同等 + Germany BSI同等 + 少なくとも1つのSingapore/Japanシグナトリ + 少なくとも1つのFive Eyes同盟国)で、ソブリン・クラウド・コントロール・プレーン分離 + 実行ワーカー管轄 + トークン予算相互運用をペアの条項として扱う;ソブリン・クラウドおよびFedRAMP-Moderateテナントが最初に採用するのは、AISI管理サイバー評価レシプロシティ境界が既に運用閾値となっているためである。ベア・ケースはAWS Bedrock Agent RegistryのFedRAMP-Moderate継承およびGoogle Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Centerのレシプロシティ・アテステーション・フィールド追加が、ハイパースケーラー管理のソブリン・クラウド同等品を先に出荷する;それ以外の場合、Q1 2027はコホート全体にWorkflowsの形をしたテナンシー条項を着地させる。
description.es: Para Q1 2027 el aterrizaje sovereign-cloud del día-nueve de Mistral AI Workflows del 9 de mayo — la Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) de Francia seleccionando Workflows para enrutamiento de detección de anomalías de declaraciones fiscales a través de la propiedad central de administración tributaria con la arquitectura de separación del plano-de-control de Workflows más el modelo de execution-worker sovereign-cloud explícitamente nombrados como factores decisivos de adquisición sobre LangGraph autoalojado más el registro de Anthropic Claude Code 3.0, la tenancia paga de Workflows elevándose a 296 clientes empresariales (vs 290 el viernes) con el conteo de ejecuciones diarias cruzando 4.4M, y la nota paralela de integración Workflows-Codestral mostrando que la contabilidad de presupuesto-de-tokens por paso interopera con el formato de exportación del modo Plan-Apply del /agent del Codex CLI de OpenAI — combinado con la cohorte de go-live del 8 de mayo de BNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital que elevó la tenancia más allá de 290, el perímetro de reciprocidad de eval cyber Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI ahora extendido a South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB dentro de la extensión de fin de semana del 9 de mayo, y la lista de bloqueo de CVE de plataforma de workflow agentic-AI de NHS England nombrando LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391 como versiones pre-parche no permitidas — fuerzan a la próxima ola de RFPs de orquestador AI de gobierno central de la UE y de jurisdicciones aliadas a nombrar una cláusula de tenancy sovereign-cloud forma-Workflows (separación del plano-de-control entre datos del tenant y runtime del orquestador, modelo de execution-worker sovereign-cloud con frontera-de-ejecución de jurisdicción-nombrada, contabilidad de presupuesto-de-tokens por paso interoperable con el formato de exportación del Codex CLI de OpenAI) como un requisito de elegibilidad-de-adquisición de línea-base en lugar de un criterio de scoring discrecional. La función forzante es que una vez que una propiedad insignia de central-tax-administration cita la arquitectura por nombre como el factor decisivo contra las dos principales alternativas estadounidenses, los marcos de adquisición de estados-miembro EU y los signatarios de reciprocidad Indo-Pacífico tienen una plantilla de referencia defensible que pueden requerir sin redactar lenguaje a medida. La forma más probable es una cohorte de cuatro jurisdicciones (Francia DGFiP-equivalente + Germany BSI-equivalente + al menos un signatario Singapur/Japón + al menos un aliado Five Eyes) tratando la separación del plano-de-control sovereign-cloud más la jurisdicción del execution-worker más la interop de presupuesto-de-tokens como las cláusulas emparejadas; los tenants sovereign-cloud y FedRAMP-Moderate adoptan primero porque el perímetro de reciprocidad de eval cyber administrado por AISI ya es el umbral operativo. El caso bajista es que la herencia FedRAMP-Moderate del AWS Bedrock Agent Registry más el campo add de atestación-de-reciprocidad del Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center envíen un equivalente sovereign-cloud gestionado por hyperscaler primero; en ausencia de eso, Q1 2027 aterriza la cláusula de tenancy forma-Workflows a través de la cohorte.
description.fil: Sa Q1 2027 ang May 9 Mistral AI Workflows day-nine sovereign-cloud landing — ang pagpili ng France's Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) sa Workflows para sa tax-return anomaly-detection routing sa buong central tax-administration estate na may Workflows control-plane separation architecture plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker model na hayagang pinangalanan bilang procurement deciders laban sa LangGraph self-hosted plus ang Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry, ang paid Workflows tenancy na umaakyat sa 296 enterprise customers (vs 290 Friday) na may daily-execution count na tumatawid sa 4.4M, at ang parallel Workflows-Codestral integration note na nagpapakita na ang per-step token-budget bookkeeping ay nag-i-interoperate sa OpenAI Codex CLI /agent Plan-Apply mode export format — kasama ng May 8 BNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital go-live cohort na nag-angat ng tenancy lampas sa 290, ang Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter na ngayon ay pinalawak sa South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB sa loob ng May 9 weekend extension, at ang NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist na nagngangalan sa LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391 bilang disallowed pre-patch versions — ay pumipilit sa susunod na alon ng EU central-government at allied-jurisdiction AI-orchestrator RFPs na pangalanan ang Workflows-shaped sovereign-cloud tenancy clause (control-plane separation sa pagitan ng tenant data at orchestrator runtime, sovereign-cloud execution-worker model na may named-jurisdiction execution boundary, per-step token-budget bookkeeping na nag-i-interoperate sa OpenAI Codex CLI export format) bilang baseline procurement-eligibility requirement imbis na discretionary scoring criterion. Ang forcing function ay na sa sandaling isang flagship central-tax-administration estate ang bumanggit sa architecture by name bilang decider laban sa dalawang nangungunang US alternatives, ang EU member-state procurement frameworks at Indo-Pacific reciprocity signatories ay mayroong defensible reference template na pwede nilang i-require nang hindi nag-author ng bespoke language. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang four-jurisdiction cohort (France DGFiP-equivalent + Germany BSI-equivalent + hindi bababa sa isang Singapore/Japan signatory + hindi bababa sa isang Five Eyes ally) na tinatrato ang sovereign-cloud control-plane separation plus execution-worker jurisdiction plus token-budget interop bilang paired clauses; sovereign-cloud at FedRAMP-Moderate tenants ang unang nag-aadopt dahil ang AISI-administered cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter ay siya nang operative threshold. Ang bear case ay na ang AWS Bedrock Agent Registry's FedRAMP-Moderate inheritance plus ang Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center reciprocity-attestation field add ay nag-ship ng hyperscaler-managed sovereign-cloud equivalent una; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q1 2027 sa Workflows-shaped tenancy clause sa buong cohort.

summary.fil: Sa Q1 2027 ang May 9 Mistral AI Workflows day-nine sovereign-cloud landing — ang pagpili ng France's Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) sa Workflows para sa tax-return anomaly-detection routing sa buong central tax-administration estate na may Workflows control-plane separation architecture plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker model na hayagang pinangalanan bilang procurement deciders laban sa LangGraph self-hosted plus ang Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry, ang paid Workflows tenancy na umaakyat sa 296 enterprise customers (vs 290 Friday) na may daily-execution count na tumatawid sa 4.4M, at ang parallel Workflows-Codestral integration note na nagpapakita na ang per-step token-budget bookkeeping ay nag-i-interoperate sa OpenAI Codex CLI /agent Plan-Apply mode export format — kasama ng May 8 BNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital go-live cohort na nag-angat ng tenancy lampas sa 290, ang Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter na ngayon ay pinalawak sa South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB sa loob ng May 9 weekend extension, at ang NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist na nagngangalan sa LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391 bilang disallowed pre-patch versions — ay pumipilit sa susunod na alon ng EU central-government at allied-jurisdiction AI-orchestrator RFPs na pangalanan ang Workflows-shaped sovereign-cloud tenancy clause (control-plane separation sa pagitan ng tenant data at orchestrator runtime, sovereign-cloud execution-worker model na may named-jurisdiction execution boundary, per-step token-budget bookkeeping na nag-i-interoperate sa OpenAI Codex CLI export format) bilang baseline procurement-eligibility requirement imbis na discretionary scoring criterion. Ang forcing function ay na sa sandaling isang flagship central-tax-administration estate ang bumanggit sa architecture by name bilang decider laban sa dalawang nangungunang US alternatives, ang EU member-state procurement frameworks at Indo-Pacific reciprocity signatories ay mayroong defensible reference template na pwede nilang i-require nang hindi nag-author ng bespoke language. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang four-jurisdiction cohort (France DGFiP-equivalent + Germany BSI-equivalent + hindi bababa sa isang Singapore/Japan signatory + hindi bababa sa isang Five Eyes ally) na tinatrato ang sovereign-cloud control-plane separation plus execution-worker jurisdiction plus token-budget interop bilang paired clauses; sovereign-cloud at FedRAMP-Moderate tenants ang unang nag-aadopt dahil ang AISI-administered cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter ay siya nang operative threshold. Ang bear case ay na ang AWS Bedrock Agent Registry's FedRAMP-Moderate inheritance plus ang Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center reciprocity-attestation field add ay nag-ship ng hyperscaler-managed sovereign-cloud equivalent una; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q1 2027 sa Workflows-shaped tenancy clause sa buong cohort.
