detail.summary_short: ATT&CK v19's named techniques (context poisoning, tool-invocation abuse, MCP compromise, malicious agent deployment) plus ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious skills, Cisco's 36% prompt-injection rate, and a +32% IPI uptick force a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix and an enforced signed + provenance-attested marketplace gate by Q3 2026.

summary_short_locales.en: ATT&CK v19's named techniques (context poisoning, tool-invocation abuse, MCP compromise, malicious agent deployment) plus ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious skills, Cisco's 36% prompt-injection rate, and a +32% IPI uptick force a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix and an enforced signed + provenance-attested marketplace gate by Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.ja: ATT&CK v19の命名された技法(コンテキスト汚染、ツール呼び出しの濫用、MCP侵害、悪意あるエージェントのデプロイ)に加え、ClawHavocの1,184の悪意あるスキル、Ciscoの36%プロンプトインジェクション率、+32%のIPI急増が、2026年Q3までに公開されたエージェントスキル脅威サブマトリクスと強制的な署名+来歴認証マーケットプレイスゲートを強制する。
summary_short_locales.es: Las técnicas nombradas en ATT&CK v19 (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso MCP, despliegue de agentes maliciosos) más los 1.184 skills maliciosos de ClawHavoc, la tasa del 36% de prompt-injection de Cisco y un alza del +32% en IPI fuerzan una sub-matriz publicada de amenazas de agent-skills y un gate obligatorio de firma + provenance en marketplaces para Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang mga pinangalanang technique ng ATT&CK v19 (context poisoning, tool-invocation abuse, MCP compromise, malicious agent deployment) kasama ang 1,184 malicious skills ng ClawHavoc, 36% prompt-injection rate ng Cisco, at +32% IPI uptick ay pumipilit ng nailathalang agent-skills threat sub-matrix at ipinatutupad na signed + provenance-attested marketplace gate pagsapit ng Q3 2026.

bridges.text: The May 7 wave — n8n KEV plus LangGraph SSRF (control-plane to cloud-metadata pivot) plus LiteLLM identity-impersonation plus MCP-server exposure telemetry plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP detection GA — delivers ~5x the empirical corpus the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) baseline assumed, spanning webhook abuse, control-plane SSRF, and identity-impersonation in 24 hours.

text_locales.en: The May 7 wave — n8n KEV plus LangGraph SSRF (control-plane to cloud-metadata pivot) plus LiteLLM identity-impersonation plus MCP-server exposure telemetry plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP detection GA — delivers ~5x the empirical corpus the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) baseline assumed, spanning webhook abuse, control-plane SSRF, and identity-impersonation in 24 hours.
text_locales.ja: 5月7日の波──n8n KEV、LangGraph SSRF(コントロールプレーンからクラウドメタデータへのピボット)、LiteLLMアイデンティティ偽装、MCPサーバー露出テレメトリ、Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP検出GA──は、エージェントスキルMITRE/NIST拡張予測(4月30日)のベースライン想定の約5倍の経験的コーパスを24時間以内に提供し、Webhook濫用、コントロールプレーンSSRF、アイデンティティ偽装に及んでいる。
text_locales.es: La oleada del 7 de mayo — n8n KEV más SSRF de LangGraph (pivote de plano de control a metadatos en la nube) más suplantación de identidad de LiteLLM más telemetría de exposición de servidor MCP más GA de detección MCP de Microsoft Defender for Cloud — entrega ~5x el corpus empírico que la base de la predicción de extensión MITRE/NIST de habilidades de agente (30 de abril) asumió, abarcando abuso de webhook, SSRF de plano de control y suplantación de identidad en 24 horas.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mayo 7 wave — n8n KEV kasama ang LangGraph SSRF (control-plane sa cloud-metadata pivot) kasama ang LiteLLM identity-impersonation kasama ang MCP-server exposure telemetry kasama ang Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP detection GA — ay nagdedeliver ng ~5x ng empirical corpus na inakala ng agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Abr 30) baseline, sumasaklaw sa webhook abuse, control-plane SSRF, at identity-impersonation sa loob ng 24 oras.

bridges.text: The n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVE wave plus the standing SGLang jinja2 SSTI baseline tighten the structural force the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) names: the LLM-platform-specific attack-pattern corpus is now ~5x richer than the prediction baseline assumed, hardening the empirical case for a curated standards-body extension.

text_locales.en: The n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVE wave plus the standing SGLang jinja2 SSTI baseline tighten the structural force the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) names: the LLM-platform-specific attack-pattern corpus is now ~5x richer than the prediction baseline assumed, hardening the empirical case for a curated standards-body extension.
text_locales.ja: n8n + Flowise + LMDeployのCVEウェーブと、標準のSGLang jinja2 SSTIベースラインは、エージェントスキルMITRE/NIST拡張予測(4月30日)が指摘する構造的力を強化する: LLMプラットフォーム固有の攻撃パターン・コーパスは、予測のベースラインが想定したよりも約5倍リッチであり、キュレートされた標準化団体拡張への経験的ケースを硬化させている。
text_locales.es: La ola de CVEs n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy más la línea base estándar SGLang jinja2 SSTI tensan la fuerza estructural que nombra la predicción de extensión agent-skills MITRE/NIST (30 abr): el corpus de patrones de ataque específicos de plataforma LLM es ~5x más rico de lo que asumió la línea base, endureciendo el caso empírico para una extensión curada de cuerpo de estándares.
text_locales.fil: Ang n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVE wave plus ang standing SGLang jinja2 SSTI baseline ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinapangalanan ng agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Abr 30): ang LLM-platform-specific attack-pattern corpus ay ~5x richer kaysa sa inakala ng prediction baseline, na nagpapatibay ng empirical case para sa curated standards-body extension.

bridges.text: The RSAC-week enterprise-platform convergence keeps the doctrine side warm but does not advance the specific MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix the prediction names; the marketplace-signing-gate side stays quiet today.

text_locales.en: The RSAC-week enterprise-platform convergence keeps the doctrine side warm but does not advance the specific MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix the prediction names; the marketplace-signing-gate side stays quiet today.
text_locales.ja: RSACウィークのエンタープライズ・プラットフォーム収斂はドクトリン側を温存するが、予測が指摘する具体的なMITRE ATT&CK拡張やNIST AI-RMF付録を前進させない; マーケットプレイス署名ゲート側は本日も静かなままである。
text_locales.es: La convergencia de plataforma empresarial durante la semana RSAC mantiene caliente el lado doctrina pero no avanza la extensión MITRE ATT&CK específica o el apéndice NIST AI-RMF que la predicción nombra; el lado de puerta de firma de marketplace permanece silencioso hoy.
text_locales.fil: Ang RSAC-week enterprise-platform convergence ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang doctrine side ngunit hindi sumusulong sa specific MITRE ATT&CK extension o NIST AI-RMF appendix na pinangalanan ng prediction; ang marketplace-signing-gate side ay nananatiling tahimik ngayon.

bridges.text: ATT&CK v19's named techniques, CSAI's MITRE-CNA authority, and Microsoft Agent 365's tools-management allow/block primitive supply the regulatory and marketplace levers the prediction's structural force assumes. SAGE and LiveClawBench add the eval substrate that a published sub-matrix can reference.

text_locales.en: ATT&CK v19's named techniques, CSAI's MITRE-CNA authority, and Microsoft Agent 365's tools-management allow/block primitive supply the regulatory and marketplace levers the prediction's structural force assumes. SAGE and LiveClawBench add the eval substrate that a published sub-matrix can reference.
text_locales.ja: ATT&CK v19の命名済み手法、CSAIのMITRE-CNA権限、Microsoft Agent 365のツール管理許可/ブロックプリミティブが、予測の構造的力が想定する規制とマーケットプレイスのレバーを供給する。SAGEとLiveClawBenchが、公開サブマトリクスが参照できる評価基盤を加える。
text_locales.es: Las técnicas nombradas de ATT&CK v19, la autoridad MITRE-CNA de CSAI, y la primitiva allow/block de gestión de herramientas de Microsoft Agent 365 suministran las palancas regulatorias y de marketplace que asume la fuerza estructural de la predicción. SAGE y LiveClawBench añaden el sustrato de evaluación al que una sub-matriz publicada puede referirse.
text_locales.fil: Ang named techniques ng ATT&CK v19, ang MITRE-CNA authority ng CSAI, at ang tools-management allow/block primitive ng Microsoft Agent 365 ay nagbibigay ng regulatory at marketplace levers na ipinapalagay ng structural force ng prediction. Ang SAGE at LiveClawBench ay nagdaragdag ng eval substrate na maaaring sangguniin ng inilathalang sub-matrix.

bridges.text: ATT&CK v19's published technique names, the CSAI MITRE-CNA lane, and Agent 365's tenant-level enforcement primitive line up with the precondition arc that should make a sub-matrix appendix and a publish-time signing gate inevitable inside Q3.

text_locales.en: ATT&CK v19's published technique names, the CSAI MITRE-CNA lane, and Agent 365's tenant-level enforcement primitive line up with the precondition arc that should make a sub-matrix appendix and a publish-time signing gate inevitable inside Q3.
text_locales.ja: ATT&CK v19の公開されたテクニック名、CSAI MITRE-CNAレーン、Agent 365のテナントレベル強制プリミティブが、Q3内でサブマトリックス付録と公開時署名ゲートを必然にする前提条件アークと整合する。
text_locales.es: Los nombres de técnicas publicados de ATT&CK v19, el carril MITRE-CNA de CSAI, y la primitiva de aplicación a nivel de inquilino de Agent 365 se alinean con el arco de precondiciones que debería hacer inevitable un apéndice de sub-matriz y una puerta de firma en tiempo de publicación dentro del Q3.
text_locales.fil: Ang nailathalang technique names ng ATT&CK v19, ang CSAI MITRE-CNA lane, at ang tenant-level enforcement primitive ng Agent 365 ay nakahanay sa precondition arc na dapat gawing inevitable sa loob ng Q3 ang sub-matrix appendix at publish-time signing gate.

bridges.text: CSAI's MITRE-CNA authorization is the cleanest possible institutional precursor to the prediction's ATT&CK-extension / AI-RMF-appendix thesis, with ATT&CK v19's named-techniques wave already populating the technique slots. The forecast and yesterday's evidence are functionally one-day apart and converging. The marketplace-signing-gate half remains the open leg.

text_locales.en: CSAI's MITRE-CNA authorization is the cleanest possible institutional precursor to the prediction's ATT&CK-extension / AI-RMF-appendix thesis, with ATT&CK v19's named-techniques wave already populating the technique slots. The forecast and yesterday's evidence are functionally one-day apart and converging. The marketplace-signing-gate half remains the open leg.
text_locales.ja: CSAIのMITRE-CNA認定は、予測のATT&CK拡張 / AI-RMF付録テーゼに対する最もクリーンな制度的前駆体であり、ATT&CK v19の命名技法の波はすでに技法スロットを埋めている。予測と昨日の証拠は機能的に1日離れて収束している。マーケットプレイス署名ゲートの後半は依然として開いた脚である。
text_locales.es: La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI es el precursor institucional más limpio posible a la tesis de extensión-de-ATT&CK / apéndice-de-AI-RMF de la predicción, con la ola de técnicas-nombradas de ATT&CK v19 ya poblando los slots de técnicas. El forecast y la evidencia de ayer están funcionalmente a un día de distancia y convergiendo. La mitad del marketplace-signing-gate permanece como el leg abierto.
text_locales.fil: Ang MITRE-CNA authorization ng CSAI ay ang pinaka-malinis na posibleng institutional precursor sa ATT&CK-extension / AI-RMF-appendix thesis ng prediction, na may named-techniques wave ng ATT&CK v19 na nagpu-populate na ng technique slots. Ang forecast at evidence ng kahapon ay functionally one-day apart at nagko-converge. Ang marketplace-signing-gate kalahati ay nananatiling bukas na leg.

detail.description: By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. **By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish.** Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 + v5.4 framework already names AI-agent context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, and malicious agent deployment as techniques; Apr 28 Novita Sandbox is the first commercial mitigation product purpose-built for OpenClaw + Hermes runtimes; Apr 28 SuiteCloud Agent Skills (Oracle NetSuite, SuiteConnect SF) is the first major non-foundation-lab vendor shipping skills-as-a-product with signed-distribution as the security frame; Apr 28 arxiv 2604.24026 (SSL representation for skills) + Apr 24 arxiv 2604.23374 NeuroTaint provide the academic scaffolding. The forcing function is the Cisco RSAC 2026 36%-prompt-injection-rate finding + ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious skills + Apr 23-29 Google +32% IPI uptick; combined this is the same governance-gap arc that produced MITRE ATT&CK Mobile in 2017 and MITRE ATLAS in 2021. The first of these mandates likely originates from CISA / NIST or directly from the marketplace operators under enterprise-customer pressure rather than from a foundation lab.

nodes.description: **By H2 2026 every major local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) exposes a unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + at least one alternative — and Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ships native TurboQuant integration tied to Windows ML / WinML execution providers as a Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 evidence: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite hitting 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool for multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress at Decoding-Press maturity; llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread active; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% faster. Foundry Local is the missing enterprise-Windows entry point — Microsoft ships it as a ~20MB native library that bundles local AI into any app with hardware-matched WinML execution providers, and the obvious next step for Q2 2026 is to surface a TurboQuant flag in the Foundry Catalog. The economic forcing function is the same Mag 7 capex tape: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that moves from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x, and Foundry Local makes that switch invisible to end-developers.

description.en: **By H2 2026 every major local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) exposes a unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + at least one alternative — and Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ships native TurboQuant integration tied to Windows ML / WinML execution providers as a Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 evidence: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite hitting 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool for multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress at Decoding-Press maturity; llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread active; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% faster. Foundry Local is the missing enterprise-Windows entry point — Microsoft ships it as a ~20MB native library that bundles local AI into any app with hardware-matched WinML execution providers, and the obvious next step for Q2 2026 is to surface a TurboQuant flag in the Foundry Catalog. The economic forcing function is the same Mag 7 capex tape: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that moves from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x, and Foundry Local makes that switch invisible to end-developers.
description.ja: **2026年下半期までに、すべての主要なローカルLLMエコシステム(vLLM、SGLang、TGI、Ollama、llama.cpp、NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM、Foundry Local)が統一された圧縮KVキャッシュデプロイメントノブ — TurboQuant + 少なくとも1つの代替案 — を公開し、Foundry Local(Microsoft、4月9日GA)はWindows ML / WinML実行プロバイダに紐付いたネイティブTurboQuant統合をWindowsデフォルト最適化として出荷する。** 4月27-29日のエビデンス:SGLang PR #21419がインツリー化、SGLang #23134のfused-Triton-decodeカーネル書き換えがbf16スループットの93–105%に到達、vLLM v0.19.0(4月2日)はtorch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / 非同期スケジューラがデフォルト + Model Runner V2、PolyKV(arxiv 2604.24971、4月27日)はマルチエージェント推論向けの共有非対称KVプール、NVIDIA kvpressはDecoding-Press成熟度、llama.cpp #20969のTurboQuant議論スレッドがアクティブ、Unsloth 2026.4.8の推論が20-30%高速化。Foundry Localは欠けていたエンタープライズWindowsエントリポイントである — Microsoftはこれをハードウェア対応のWinML実行プロバイダで任意のアプリにローカルAIをバンドルする約20MBのネイティブライブラリとして出荷しており、2026年Q2の明らかな次の一歩はFoundry CatalogでTurboQuantフラグを公開することである。経済的な強制要因はMag 7 capexテープと同じである:FP16から3.5ビットに移行するメモリ帯域幅律速の長文脈ワークロードはすべてトークンあたりの実効コストを約5-6倍削減し、Foundry Localはその切替をエンドデベロッパーに対して不可視にする。
description.es: **Para H2 2026 cada ecosistema mayor de LLM local (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) expone un knob unificado de despliegue de KV-cache comprimido — TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa — y Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA 9 abr) lanza integración nativa de TurboQuant atada a los execution providers de Windows ML / WinML como optimización por defecto en Windows.** Evidencia del 27-29 abr: el PR #21419 de SGLang está in-tree; la rescritura de fused-Triton-decode kernel de SGLang #23134 alcanza 93–105% del throughput bf16; vLLM v0.19.0 (2 abr) trae torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler por defecto + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, 27 abr) es un pool compartido asimétrico de KV para inferencia multi-agente; NVIDIA kvpress alcanza madurez en Decoding-Press; el hilo #20969 de discusión de TurboQuant en llama.cpp está activo; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inferencia 20-30% más rápida. Foundry Local es el punto de entrada empresarial-Windows que faltaba — Microsoft lo envía como una librería nativa de ~20MB que empaqueta IA local en cualquier app con execution providers de WinML adaptados al hardware, y el siguiente paso obvio para Q2 2026 es exponer un flag de TurboQuant en el Foundry Catalog. La función forzante económica es el mismo tape de capex Mag 7: cada workload long-context limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pasa de FP16 a 3,5 bits recorta el costo efectivo por token unas 5-6x, y Foundry Local hace ese cambio invisible para los desarrolladores finales. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang bawat pangunahing local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) ay maglalantad ng unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + hindi bababa sa isang alternatibo — at ang Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ay magpapadala ng native TurboQuant integration na nakatali sa Windows ML / WinML execution providers bilang Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 ebidensiya: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite na umabot sa 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool para sa multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress sa Decoding-Press maturity; aktibo ang llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% mas mabilis. Ang Foundry Local ang nawawalang enterprise-Windows entry point — ipinapadala ito ng Microsoft bilang ~20MB native library na nagbubundle ng local AI sa anumang app na may hardware-matched WinML execution providers, at ang malinaw na susunod na hakbang para sa Q2 2026 ay ang paglalantad ng TurboQuant flag sa Foundry Catalog. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag 7 capex tape: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na lumilipat mula FP16 papuntang 3.5-bit ay nagbabawas ng effective per-token cost ng ~5-6x, at ginagawa ng Foundry Local na hindi nakikita ng end-developer ang switch na iyon.

bridges.text: SGLang's measured throughput lead and day-0 model coverage plus Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face joint engineering reinforce the precondition that the local-LLM ecosystem has the kernel-level performance maturity needed before a unified compressed-KV-cache knob lands across the stack.

text_locales.en: SGLang's measured throughput lead and day-0 model coverage plus Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face joint engineering reinforce the precondition that the local-LLM ecosystem has the kernel-level performance maturity needed before a unified compressed-KV-cache knob lands across the stack.
text_locales.ja: SGLangの計測されたスループット優位とday-0モデル・カバレッジ + Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face共同エンジニアリングが、ローカルLLMエコシステムが、統一された圧縮KVキャッシュ・ノブがスタック全体に着地する前に必要なカーネルレベルの性能成熟度を持つという前提条件を強化している。
text_locales.es: La ventaja de rendimiento medida de SGLang y la cobertura de modelo day-0 más la ingeniería conjunta Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face refuerzan la precondición de que el ecosistema local-LLM tiene la madurez de rendimiento a nivel de kernel necesaria antes de que un knob unificado de KV-cache comprimido aterrice en la pila.
text_locales.fil: Ang sinukat na throughput lead at day-0 model coverage ng SGLang plus Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face joint engineering ay nagpapatibay sa precondition na ang local-LLM ecosystem ay may kernel-level performance maturity na kailangan bago lumapag ang unified compressed-KV-cache knob sa buong stack.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **By H2 2026 every major local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) exposes a unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + at least one alternative — and Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ships native TurboQuant integration tied to Windows ML / WinML execution providers as a Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 evidence: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite hitting 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool for multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress at Decoding-Press maturity; llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread active; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% faster. Foundry Local is the missing enterprise-Windows entry point — Microsoft ships it as a ~20MB native library that bundles local AI into any app with hardware-matched WinML execution providers, and the obvious next step for Q2 2026 is to surface a TurboQuant flag in the Foundry Catalog. The economic forcing function is the same Mag 7 capex tape: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that moves from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x, and Foundry Local makes that switch invisible to end-developers.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年下半期までに、すべての主要なローカルLLMエコシステム(vLLM、SGLang、TGI、Ollama、llama.cpp、NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM、Foundry Local)が統一された圧縮KVキャッシュデプロイメントノブ — TurboQuant + 少なくとも1つの代替案 — を公開し、Foundry Local(Microsoft、4月9日GA)はWindows ML / WinML実行プロバイダに紐付いたネイティブTurboQuant統合をWindowsデフォルト最適化として出荷する。** 4月27-29日のエビデンス:SGLang PR #21419がインツリー化、SGLang #23134のfused-Triton-decodeカーネル書き換えがbf16スループットの93–105%に到達、vLLM v0.19.0(4月2日)はtorch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / 非同期スケジューラがデフォルト + Model Runner V2、PolyKV(arxiv 2604.24971、4月27日)はマルチエージェント推論向けの共有非対称KVプール、NVIDIA kvpressはDecoding-Press成熟度、llama.cpp #20969のTurboQuant議論スレッドがアクティブ、Unsloth 2026.4.8の推論が20-30%高速化。Foundry Localは欠けていたエンタープライズWindowsエントリポイントである — Microsoftはこれをハードウェア対応のWinML実行プロバイダで任意のアプリにローカルAIをバンドルする約20MBのネイティブライブラリとして出荷しており、2026年Q2の明らかな次の一歩はFoundry CatalogでTurboQuantフラグを公開することである。経済的な強制要因はMag 7 capexテープと同じである:FP16から3.5ビットに移行するメモリ帯域幅律速の長文脈ワークロードはすべてトークンあたりの実効コストを約5-6倍削減し、Foundry Localはその切替をエンドデベロッパーに対して不可視にする。
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para H2 2026 cada ecosistema mayor de LLM local (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) expone un knob unificado de despliegue de KV-cache comprimido — TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa — y Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA 9 abr) lanza integración nativa de TurboQuant atada a los execution providers de Windows ML / WinML como optimización por defecto en Windows.** Evidencia del 27-29 abr: el PR #21419 de SGLang está in-tree; la rescritura de fused-Triton-decode kernel de SGLang #23134 alcanza 93–105% del throughput bf16; vLLM v0.19.0 (2 abr) trae torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler por defecto + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, 27 abr) es un pool compartido asimétrico de KV para inferencia multi-agente; NVIDIA kvpress alcanza madurez en Decoding-Press; el hilo #20969 de discusión de TurboQuant en llama.cpp está activo; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inferencia 20-30% más rápida. Foundry Local es el punto de entrada empresarial-Windows que faltaba — Microsoft lo envía como una librería nativa de ~20MB que empaqueta IA local en cualquier app con execution providers de WinML adaptados al hardware, y el siguiente paso obvio para Q2 2026 es exponer un flag de TurboQuant en el Foundry Catalog. La función forzante económica es el mismo tape de capex Mag 7: cada workload long-context limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pasa de FP16 a 3,5 bits recorta el costo efectivo por token unas 5-6x, y Foundry Local hace ese cambio invisible para los desarrolladores finales. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang bawat pangunahing local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) ay maglalantad ng unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + hindi bababa sa isang alternatibo — at ang Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ay magpapadala ng native TurboQuant integration na nakatali sa Windows ML / WinML execution providers bilang Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 ebidensiya: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite na umabot sa 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool para sa multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress sa Decoding-Press maturity; aktibo ang llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% mas mabilis. Ang Foundry Local ang nawawalang enterprise-Windows entry point — ipinapadala ito ng Microsoft bilang ~20MB native library na nagbubundle ng local AI sa anumang app na may hardware-matched WinML execution providers, at ang malinaw na susunod na hakbang para sa Q2 2026 ay ang paglalantad ng TurboQuant flag sa Foundry Catalog. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag 7 capex tape: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na lumilipat mula FP16 papuntang 3.5-bit ay nagbabawas ng effective per-token cost ng ~5-6x, at ginagawa ng Foundry Local na hindi nakikita ng end-developer ang switch na iyon.

nodes.description: By Q3 2026 the agentic-AI CVE class becomes its own first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, with ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs published under CSAI's MITRE-authorized CNA, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships a mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate before publish. Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization is the institutional spark; Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 names the techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ships native sandbox execution as a default primitive across 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents form the vendor-side counterpart; Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row leaks OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demonstrate the model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. The forcing function is enterprise risk transfer — once a CNA exists with the explicit AI-agent mandate, the disclosure cadence will compress from random-publisher to coordinated-issuer-driven, and skill marketplaces will not be able to remain unsigned-by-default without losing enterprise customers. CSAI's first-pull-quarter (Q3 2026) is the most-likely landing zone for the threshold to be crossed.

Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization is the institutional spark; Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 names the techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ships native sandbox execution as a default primitive across 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents form the vendor-side counterpart; Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row leaks OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demonstrate the model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. The forcing function is enterprise risk transfer — once a CNA exists with the explicit AI-agent mandate, the disclosure cadence will compress from random-publisher to coordinated-issuer-driven, and skill marketplaces will not be able to remain unsigned-by-default without losing enterprise customers. CSAI's first-pull-quarter (Q3 2026) is the most-likely landing zone for the threshold to be crossed.
description.ja: 2026年Q3までにエージェント型AIのCVEクラスが独立した第一級のCNA発行サブコーパスとなり、CSAIのMITRE認定CNAの下でエージェント／スキル／ハーネス／サンドボックス固有のCVEが50件以上公表され、少なくとも1つの主要なスキルマーケットプレイス(Anthropic skills、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Face skills)が公開前に署名済み+来歴証明済みの必須ゲートを実装する。4月29日のCSAI MITRE-CNA認定は制度的な火種であり、4月28日のATT&CK v19は技術名(コンテキスト汚染、ツール呼び出し悪用、MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェント展開)を命名し、4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDKは7つのサンドボックスプロバイダー(Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel)全体でデフォルトのプリミティブとしてネイティブサンドボックス実行を出荷し、4月28日のNovita Sandbox+4月28日のAWS Bedrock Managed Agents+4月30日のMicrosoft Foundry hosted agentsはベンダー側の対応を形成し、4月26日のLiteLLM CVE-2026-42208(単一のSQLi行がOpenAI+Anthropic+Bedrockキーを漏洩)+4月28日のSpring AI CVE-2026-40967+繰り越しのSGLang CVE-2026-5760はモデルツールレイヤー注入の影響半径を実証している。強制関数は企業のリスク移転である ― 明示的なAIエージェント任務を持つCNAが存在すれば、開示ケイデンスはランダムパブリッシャーから調整発行者主導へと圧縮され、スキルマーケットプレイスはエンタープライズ顧客を失わずに署名なしデフォルトを維持できなくなる。CSAIの最初のフルクォーター(2026年Q3)が閾値を超える最も可能性の高い着地点である。
description.es: Para Q3 2026 la clase de CVE de IA-agéntica se convierte en su propio sub-corpus de primera clase emitido por una CNA, con ≥50 CVEs específicas de agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox publicadas bajo la CNA autorizada por MITRE de CSAI, y al menos un marketplace mayor de skills (skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face) lanza un gate obligatorio de firma + atestación de provenance antes de publicar. La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI del 29 abr es la chispa institucional; ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr nombra las técnicas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agentes maliciosos); el OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr lanza ejecución sandbox nativa como primitiva por defecto a través de 7 proveedores sandbox (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Novita Sandbox del 28 abr + AWS Bedrock Managed Agents del 28 abr + agentes hospedados de Microsoft Foundry del 30 abr forman la contraparte del lado vendor; LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 26 abr (una sola fila SQLi filtra claves OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock) + Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 del 28 abr + el carry-forward de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demuestran el blast radius de la inyección en la capa model-tooling. La función forzante es la transferencia de riesgo empresarial — una vez que existe una CNA con el mandato explícito de IA-agente, la cadencia de divulgación se comprimirá de publisher-aleatorio a coordinated-issuer-driven, y los marketplaces de skills no podrán permanecer unsigned-by-default sin perder clientes empresariales. El primer trimestre de pull de CSAI (Q3 2026) es la zona de aterrizaje más probable para que se cruce el umbral.
description.fil: Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang agentic-AI CVE class ay magiging sariling first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, na may ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs na inilathala sa ilalim ng MITRE-authorized CNA ng CSAI, at hindi bababa sa isang malaking skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ay maglulunsad ng mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate bago mag-publish. Ang Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization ang institutional spark; ang Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 ay nagpangalan sa mga technique (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ay naglulunsad ng native sandbox execution bilang default primitive sa 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents ang bumubuo ng vendor-side counterpart; ang Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row na naglalabas ng OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay nagpapakita ng model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. Ang forcing function ay ang enterprise risk transfer — kapag may CNA na may explicit AI-agent mandate, mag-co-compress ang disclosure cadence mula random-publisher patungo sa coordinated-issuer-driven, at hindi makakaiwas ang skill marketplaces na manatiling unsigned-by-default nang hindi nawawalan ng enterprise customers. Ang first-pull-quarter ng CSAI (Q3 2026) ay ang pinaka-malamang na landing zone para malagpasan ang threshold.

detail.summary_short: CSAI's Apr 29 MITRE CNA authorization plus ATT&CK v19's named agentic techniques and parallel sandbox-as-primitive launches at OpenAI, AWS, and Microsoft point to ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs publishing under the CSAI CNA and at least one major skill marketplace mandating signed + provenance-attested gates before publish by Q3 2026.

summary_short_locales.en: CSAI's Apr 29 MITRE CNA authorization plus ATT&CK v19's named agentic techniques and parallel sandbox-as-primitive launches at OpenAI, AWS, and Microsoft point to ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs publishing under the CSAI CNA and at least one major skill marketplace mandating signed + provenance-attested gates before publish by Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.ja: CSAIの4月29日のMITRE CNA認定に加え、ATT&CK v19が命名したエージェント型技法、OpenAI、AWS、Microsoftの並行するサンドボックス・アズ・プリミティブ・ローンチは、2026年Q3までにCSAI CNAの下で50件以上のエージェント／スキル／ハーネス／サンドボックス固有のCVEが公表され、少なくとも1つの主要なスキルマーケットプレイスが公開前に署名済み+来歴証明済みゲートを必須化することを示している。
summary_short_locales.es: La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI del 29 abr más las técnicas agénticas nombradas de ATT&CK v19 y los lanzamientos paralelos de sandbox-como-primitiva en OpenAI, AWS y Microsoft apuntan a ≥50 CVEs específicas de agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox publicándose bajo la CNA de CSAI y al menos un marketplace mayor de skills exigiendo gates firmados + atestados con provenance antes de publicar para Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Apr 29 MITRE CNA authorization ng CSAI plus ang named agentic techniques ng ATT&CK v19 at ang parallel sandbox-as-primitive launches sa OpenAI, AWS, at Microsoft ay tumuturo sa ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs na maipa-publish sa ilalim ng CSAI CNA at hindi bababa sa isang malaking skill marketplace na mag-mandate ng signed + provenance-attested gates bago mag-publish pagsapit ng Q3 2026.

bridges.text: NHS England's blocklist names five distinct agentic-runtime CVEs (Ni8mare, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack) tied to the CISA May 21 KEV-mirroring deadline, and Trail of Bits publishes a sixth (SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 CVSS 8.1) the same week — the empirical base for a distinguishable agentic-AI CVE class hardens, but advisory coordination still flows through CISA / GitLab / OWASP / NHS rather than a CSAI CNA.

text_locales.en: NHS England's blocklist names five distinct agentic-runtime CVEs (Ni8mare, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack) tied to the CISA May 21 KEV-mirroring deadline, and Trail of Bits publishes a sixth (SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 CVSS 8.1) the same week — the empirical base for a distinguishable agentic-AI CVE class hardens, but advisory coordination still flows through CISA / GitLab / OWASP / NHS rather than a CSAI CNA.
text_locales.ja: NHS Englandのブロックリストは5つの異なるエージェンティック・ランタイムCVE(Ni8mare、LangGraph、LiteLLM、CrewAI、Haystack)をCISA 5月21日KEVミラーリング期限に紐付けて命名し、Trail of Bitsは同じ週で6つ目(SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 CVSS 8.1)を公表 — 区別可能なエージェンティックAI CVEクラスのための経験的ベースが硬化するが、アドバイザリー連携はCSAI CNAではなくCISA / GitLab / OWASP / NHSを通じて依然流れる。
text_locales.es: La blocklist de NHS England nombra cinco CVEs de runtime agéntico distintos (Ni8mare, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack) atados a la fecha límite KEV-mirroring del 21 de mayo de CISA, y Trail of Bits publica un sexto (SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 CVSS 8.1) la misma semana — la base empírica para una clase distinguible de CVE IA agéntica se endurece, pero la coordinación de avisos todavía fluye a través de CISA / GitLab / OWASP / NHS en lugar de un CSAI CNA.
text_locales.fil: Pinapangalanan ng blocklist ng NHS England ang limang distinct agentic-runtime CVEs (Ni8mare, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack) na nakatali sa CISA Mayo 21 KEV-mirroring deadline, at naglathala ang Trail of Bits ng pang-anim (SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 CVSS 8.1) sa parehong linggo — tumitigas ang empirical base para sa distinguishable agentic-AI CVE class, ngunit dumadaloy pa rin ang advisory coordination sa pamamagitan ng CISA / GitLab / OWASP / NHS sa halip na CSAI CNA.

bridges.text: CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 deserialization RCE in the agent-task-checkpoint loader and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 unauthenticated path-traversal in the deepset-cloud agent-tool registry land 24 hours after LangGraph plus LiteLLM, both added to the OWASP GenAI Exploit feed within hours. Aikido and Sysdig flag at least seven additional unmaintained agent-checkpoint loaders with structurally similar exposure, supplying the multi-vendor weekly cadence the CSAI sub-corpus requires.

text_locales.en: CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 deserialization RCE in the agent-task-checkpoint loader and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 unauthenticated path-traversal in the deepset-cloud agent-tool registry land 24 hours after LangGraph plus LiteLLM, both added to the OWASP GenAI Exploit feed within hours. Aikido and Sysdig flag at least seven additional unmaintained agent-checkpoint loaders with structurally similar exposure, supplying the multi-vendor weekly cadence the CSAI sub-corpus requires.
text_locales.ja: agent-task-checkpointローダーにおけるCrewAI CVE-2026-44352デシリアライゼーションRCE、およびdeepset-cloud agent-toolレジストリにおけるHaystack CVE-2026-44391の認証なしpath-traversalは、LangGraphとLiteLLMの24時間後に着地し、両方とも数時間以内にOWASP GenAI Exploitフィードに追加される。AikidoとSysdigは、構造的に類似した暴露パターンを持つ未保守agent-checkpointローダーが少なくともさらに7件存在することをフラグし、CSAIサブコーパスが要求するマルチベンダー週次cadenceを供給する。
text_locales.es: El RCE de deserializacion CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 en el agent-task-checkpoint loader y el path-traversal no autenticado Haystack CVE-2026-44391 en el deepset-cloud agent-tool registry aterrizan 24 horas despues de LangGraph mas LiteLLM, ambos anadidos al OWASP GenAI Exploit feed en horas. Aikido y Sysdig senalan al menos siete agent-checkpoint loaders no mantenidos adicionales con exposicion estructuralmente similar, suministrando la cadencia semanal multi-vendor que requiere el sub-corpus CSAI.
text_locales.fil: Ang CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 deserialization RCE sa agent-task-checkpoint loader at Haystack CVE-2026-44391 unauthenticated path-traversal sa deepset-cloud agent-tool registry ay lumalapag 24 oras matapos ang LangGraph plus LiteLLM, parehong idinagdag sa OWASP GenAI Exploit feed sa loob ng ilang oras. Tinatandaan ng Aikido at Sysdig ang hindi bababa sa pitong karagdagang unmaintained agent-checkpoint loaders na may structurally similar exposure, nagbibigay ng multi-vendor weekly cadence na kinakailangan ng CSAI sub-corpus.

text_locales.ja: n8nのKEV入りに加え、LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM認証バイパスが開示後数時間で発生、MCPサーバー露出が4週間で+34%増加し、エージェント型AI CVEサブコーパス予測(5月1日)が指す構造的力を強化する。AIツーリングCVEカテゴリーは、勧告形態とエクスプロイト潜時プロファイルにより、マルチベンダー週次ケイデンス全体で運用上区別可能となった。
text_locales.es: n8n entrando al KEV más SSRF de LangGraph + bypass de autenticación de LiteLLM en horas tras la divulgación más exposición de servidores MCP componiéndose a +34%/4 semanas tensan la fuerza estructural que la predicción de CVE-como-subcorpus de IA agéntica (1 de mayo) nombra: la categoría CVE de herramientas de IA es ahora operativamente distinguible por la forma del aviso y el perfil de latencia de explotación a través de cadencia semanal multi-proveedor.
text_locales.fil: Ang pagpasok ng n8n sa KEV kasama ang LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass sa loob ng oras pagkatapos ng disclosure kasama ang MCP-server exposure na nagco-compound sa +34%/4 weeks ay naghihigpit sa structural force na pinapangalanan ng agentic-AI CVE-as-sub-corpus prediction (Mayo 1): ang AI-tooling CVE category ay operational distinguishable na ngayon sa pamamagitan ng advisory shape at exploitation-latency profile sa multi-vendor weekly cadence.

text_locales.ja: Ni8mare CVSS-10 RCEに加え、FlowiseのプロンプトインジェクションRCE、LMDeployの12時間31分の悪用レイテンシ、これらすべてが1週間以内に複数ベンダーでアドバイザリ協調されており、エージェンティックAI CVEのサブコーパス予測(5月1日)が指摘する前提条件をまさに満たす: AIツーリングCVEカテゴリは現在、アドバイザリの形状と悪用レイテンシのプロファイルにより、汎用Webアプリ CVEから運用上区別可能になっている。

text_locales.fil: Ang Ni8mare CVSS-10 RCE plus ang Flowise prompt-injection RCE plus ang LMDeploy 12h-31m exploitation latency, lahat ay multi-vendor advisory-coordinated sa loob ng isang linggo, ay nagdedeliver ng eksaktong precondition na pinapangalanan ng agentic-AI CVE-as-sub-corpus prediction (Mayo 1): operationally distinguishable na ang AI-tooling CVE category mula sa generic web-app CVEs sa pamamagitan ng advisory shape at exploitation-latency profile.

detail.description: By Q3 2026 the agentic-AI CVE class becomes its own first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, with ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs published under CSAI's MITRE-authorized CNA, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships a mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate before publish. Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization is the institutional spark; Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 names the techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ships native sandbox execution as a default primitive across 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents form the vendor-side counterpart; Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row leaks OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demonstrate the model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. The forcing function is enterprise risk transfer — once a CNA exists with the explicit AI-agent mandate, the disclosure cadence will compress from random-publisher to coordinated-issuer-driven, and skill marketplaces will not be able to remain unsigned-by-default without losing enterprise customers. CSAI's first-pull-quarter (Q3 2026) is the most-likely landing zone for the threshold to be crossed.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2026年Q3までにエージェント型AIのCVEクラスが独立した第一級のCNA発行サブコーパスとなり、CSAIのMITRE認定CNAの下でエージェント／スキル／ハーネス／サンドボックス固有のCVEが50件以上公表され、少なくとも1つの主要なスキルマーケットプレイス(Anthropic skills、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Face skills)が公開前に署名済み+来歴証明済みの必須ゲートを実装する。4月29日のCSAI MITRE-CNA認定は制度的な火種であり、4月28日のATT&CK v19は技術名(コンテキスト汚染、ツール呼び出し悪用、MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェント展開)を命名し、4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDKは7つのサンドボックスプロバイダー(Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel)全体でデフォルトのプリミティブとしてネイティブサンドボックス実行を出荷し、4月28日のNovita Sandbox+4月28日のAWS Bedrock Managed Agents+4月30日のMicrosoft Foundry hosted agentsはベンダー側の対応を形成し、4月26日のLiteLLM CVE-2026-42208(単一のSQLi行がOpenAI+Anthropic+Bedrockキーを漏洩)+4月28日のSpring AI CVE-2026-40967+繰り越しのSGLang CVE-2026-5760はモデルツールレイヤー注入の影響半径を実証している。強制関数は企業のリスク移転である ― 明示的なAIエージェント任務を持つCNAが存在すれば、開示ケイデンスはランダムパブリッシャーから調整発行者主導へと圧縮され、スキルマーケットプレイスはエンタープライズ顧客を失わずに署名なしデフォルトを維持できなくなる。CSAIの最初のフルクォーター(2026年Q3)が閾値を超える最も可能性の高い着地点である。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q3 2026 la clase de CVE de IA-agéntica se convierte en su propio sub-corpus de primera clase emitido por una CNA, con ≥50 CVEs específicas de agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox publicadas bajo la CNA autorizada por MITRE de CSAI, y al menos un marketplace mayor de skills (skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face) lanza un gate obligatorio de firma + atestación de provenance antes de publicar. La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI del 29 abr es la chispa institucional; ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr nombra las técnicas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agentes maliciosos); el OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr lanza ejecución sandbox nativa como primitiva por defecto a través de 7 proveedores sandbox (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Novita Sandbox del 28 abr + AWS Bedrock Managed Agents del 28 abr + agentes hospedados de Microsoft Foundry del 30 abr forman la contraparte del lado vendor; LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 26 abr (una sola fila SQLi filtra claves OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock) + Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 del 28 abr + el carry-forward de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demuestran el blast radius de la inyección en la capa model-tooling. La función forzante es la transferencia de riesgo empresarial — una vez que existe una CNA con el mandato explícito de IA-agente, la cadencia de divulgación se comprimirá de publisher-aleatorio a coordinated-issuer-driven, y los marketplaces de skills no podrán permanecer unsigned-by-default sin perder clientes empresariales. El primer trimestre de pull de CSAI (Q3 2026) es la zona de aterrizaje más probable para que se cruce el umbral.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang agentic-AI CVE class ay magiging sariling first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, na may ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs na inilathala sa ilalim ng MITRE-authorized CNA ng CSAI, at hindi bababa sa isang malaking skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ay maglulunsad ng mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate bago mag-publish. Ang Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization ang institutional spark; ang Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 ay nagpangalan sa mga technique (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ay naglulunsad ng native sandbox execution bilang default primitive sa 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents ang bumubuo ng vendor-side counterpart; ang Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row na naglalabas ng OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay nagpapakita ng model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. Ang forcing function ay ang enterprise risk transfer — kapag may CNA na may explicit AI-agent mandate, mag-co-compress ang disclosure cadence mula random-publisher patungo sa coordinated-issuer-driven, at hindi makakaiwas ang skill marketplaces na manatiling unsigned-by-default nang hindi nawawalan ng enterprise customers. Ang first-pull-quarter ng CSAI (Q3 2026) ay ang pinaka-malamang na landing zone para malagpasan ang threshold.

nodes.title: Microsoft Agent 365 GA forces Big-3 to ship default MCP policy by Q4 2026
nodes.description: **By Q4 2026 the Microsoft Agent 365 GA ($15/user, M365 E7) + Cisco DefenseClaw open-source (Mar 23) + CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA (Apr 29) + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness (Apr 28) stack converges into an enterprise agent-control-plane reference model — at least 2 of the Big-3 hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) ship policy-based MCP-server allow/block enforcement at the tenant level with audited tool-invocation logs as a default-on primitive; at least one independent control-plane vendor (Vanta, Zenity, OpenClawAI) publishes a Sec-Labels-style artifact attestation gate.** Forcing function is enterprise procurement: Microsoft just put a per-user price tag ($15/user/mo) on the agent-control-plane category, which sets the pricing-anchor that AWS + Google must respond to with comparable disclosures; the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + 7 sandbox providers pre-baked the runtime side, and the May 1 GA wires the policy side to an existing M365 admin surface (Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender). Once the May 1 GA's Defender asset-context mapping (devices + MCP servers + identities + cloud resources per agent) ships in June 2026 it becomes the de-facto schema; the path of least resistance is for AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent Garden to publish parallel schemas before Q4 to avoid losing the M365-installed-base anchor. CSAI's MITRE-CNA cadence will compress the disclosure side in parallel. In plain language: Microsoft put a price tag on controlling AI agents — other clouds will copy or lose customers. description.es: **Para el Q4 2026, la pila formada por la GA de Microsoft Agent 365 ($15/usuario, M365 E7) + Cisco DefenseClaw open-source (23 mar) + CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA (29 abr) + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness (28 abr) converge en un modelo de referencia de plano de control para agentes empresariales — al menos 2 de los 3 grandes hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) lanzarán la aplicación de políticas de permitir/bloquear servidores MCP a nivel de inquilino con registros auditados de invocación de herramientas como primitiva activada por defecto; al menos un proveedor independiente de plano de control (Vanta, Zenity, OpenClawAI) publicará una puerta de atestación de artefactos al estilo Sec-Labels.** La función forzante es la contratación empresarial: Microsoft acaba de poner una etiqueta de precio por usuario ($15/usuario/mes) a la categoría de plano de control de agentes, lo que establece el ancla de precios al que AWS + Google deben responder con divulgaciones comparables; el OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr + 7 proveedores de sandbox prepararon el lado del runtime, y la GA del 1 mayo conecta el lado de las políticas con una superficie administrativa M365 existente (Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender). Una vez que el mapeo de contexto-de-activos de Defender de la GA del 1 mayo (dispositivos + servidores MCP + identidades + recursos cloud por agente) se lance en junio 2026, se convierte en el esquema de facto; la ruta de menor resistencia es que AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent Garden publiquen esquemas paralelos antes del Q4 para evitar perder el ancla de la base instalada de M365. description.fil: **Sa Q4 2026 ang stack na Microsoft Agent 365 GA ($15/user, M365 E7) + Cisco DefenseClaw open-source (Mar 23) + CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA (Apr 29) + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness (Apr 28) ay magtatagpo sa enterprise agent-control-plane reference model — hindi bababa sa 2 sa Big-3 hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) ay magpapadala ng policy-based MCP-server allow/block enforcement sa tenant level na may audited tool-invocation logs bilang default-on primitive; hindi bababa sa isang independent control-plane vendor (Vanta, Zenity, OpenClawAI) ay maglalathala ng Sec-Labels-style artifact attestation gate.** Ang forcing function ay enterprise procurement: kalalagay lang ng Microsoft ng per-user price tag ($15/user/mo) sa agent-control-plane category, na nagtatakda ng pricing-anchor na kailangang sagutin ng AWS + Google ng comparable disclosures; ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + 7 sandbox providers ay nag-pre-bake na sa runtime side, at ang May 1 GA ang nagwi-wire sa policy side patungo sa existing M365 admin surface (Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender). Sa sandaling magpadala sa Hunyo 2026 ang Defender asset-context mapping ng May 1 GA (devices + MCP servers + identities + cloud resources kada agent), ito ay magiging de-facto schema; ang pinakamadaling daan ay para sa AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent Garden na maglathala ng parallel schemas bago Q4 upang hindi mawalan sa M365-installed-base anchor. Ang CSAI MITRE-CNA cadence ay magpapasinop ng disclosure side parallel.

detail.description: **By Q4 2026 the Microsoft Agent 365 GA ($15/user, M365 E7) + Cisco DefenseClaw open-source (Mar 23) + CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA (Apr 29) + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness (Apr 28) stack converges into an enterprise agent-control-plane reference model — at least 2 of the Big-3 hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) ship policy-based MCP-server allow/block enforcement at the tenant level with audited tool-invocation logs as a default-on primitive; at least one independent control-plane vendor (Vanta, Zenity, OpenClawAI) publishes a Sec-Labels-style artifact attestation gate.** Forcing function is enterprise procurement: Microsoft just put a per-user price tag ($15/user/mo) on the agent-control-plane category, which sets the pricing-anchor that AWS + Google must respond to with comparable disclosures; the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + 7 sandbox providers pre-baked the runtime side, and the May 1 GA wires the policy side to an existing M365 admin surface (Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender). Once the May 1 GA's Defender asset-context mapping (devices + MCP servers + identities + cloud resources per agent) ships in June 2026 it becomes the de-facto schema; the path of least resistance is for AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent Garden to publish parallel schemas before Q4 to avoid losing the M365-installed-base anchor. CSAI's MITRE-CNA cadence will compress the disclosure side in parallel. In plain language: Microsoft put a price tag on controlling AI agents — other clouds will copy or lose customers. In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para el Q4 2026, la pila formada por la GA de Microsoft Agent 365 ($15/usuario, M365 E7) + Cisco DefenseClaw open-source (23 mar) + CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA (29 abr) + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness (28 abr) converge en un modelo de referencia de plano de control para agentes empresariales — al menos 2 de los 3 grandes hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) lanzarán la aplicación de políticas de permitir/bloquear servidores MCP a nivel de inquilino con registros auditados de invocación de herramientas como primitiva activada por defecto; al menos un proveedor independiente de plano de control (Vanta, Zenity, OpenClawAI) publicará una puerta de atestación de artefactos al estilo Sec-Labels.** La función forzante es la contratación empresarial: Microsoft acaba de poner una etiqueta de precio por usuario ($15/usuario/mes) a la categoría de plano de control de agentes, lo que establece el ancla de precios al que AWS + Google deben responder con divulgaciones comparables; el OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr + 7 proveedores de sandbox prepararon el lado del runtime, y la GA del 1 mayo conecta el lado de las políticas con una superficie administrativa M365 existente (Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender). Una vez que el mapeo de contexto-de-activos de Defender de la GA del 1 mayo (dispositivos + servidores MCP + identidades + recursos cloud por agente) se lance en junio 2026, se convierte en el esquema de facto; la ruta de menor resistencia es que AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent Garden publiquen esquemas paralelos antes del Q4 para evitar perder el ancla de la base instalada de M365. La cadencia MITRE-CNA de CSAI comprimirá el lado de la divulgación en paralelo. En lenguaje claro: Microsoft ha puesto una etiqueta de precio al control de los agentes de IA — otras nubes copiarán o perderán clientes. En lenguaje claro: En lenguaje claro:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Sa Q4 2026 ang stack na Microsoft Agent 365 GA ($15/user, M365 E7) + Cisco DefenseClaw open-source (Mar 23) + CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA (Apr 29) + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness (Apr 28) ay magtatagpo sa enterprise agent-control-plane reference model — hindi bababa sa 2 sa Big-3 hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) ay magpapadala ng policy-based MCP-server allow/block enforcement sa tenant level na may audited tool-invocation logs bilang default-on primitive; hindi bababa sa isang independent control-plane vendor (Vanta, Zenity, OpenClawAI) ay maglalathala ng Sec-Labels-style artifact attestation gate.** Ang forcing function ay enterprise procurement: kalalagay lang ng Microsoft ng per-user price tag ($15/user/mo) sa agent-control-plane category, na nagtatakda ng pricing-anchor na kailangang sagutin ng AWS + Google ng comparable disclosures; ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + 7 sandbox providers ay nag-pre-bake na sa runtime side, at ang May 1 GA ang nagwi-wire sa policy side patungo sa existing M365 admin surface (Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender). Sa sandaling magpadala sa Hunyo 2026 ang Defender asset-context mapping ng May 1 GA (devices + MCP servers + identities + cloud resources kada agent), ito ay magiging de-facto schema; ang pinakamadaling daan ay para sa AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent Garden na maglathala ng parallel schemas bago Q4 upang hindi mawalan sa M365-installed-base anchor. Ang CSAI MITRE-CNA cadence ay magpapasinop ng disclosure side parallel.

nodes.title: Frontier cyber-AI export-control category emerges by Q3 2026
nodes.description: **By Q3 2026 the Apr 7 Anthropic Mythos Preview launch under Project Glasswing (~50 launch partners + ~40 critical-software-infrastructure orgs + $100M usage credits + $4M open-source security donations) + the Apr 30 Bloomberg-disclosed NSA Project Aether benchmarking Mythos against classified sovereign cyber tools + the May 1 Pentagon CTO statement separating the Anthropic blacklist from the NSA Mythos engagement creates the regulatory-pull for the US to formally define a frontier cyber-capability AI export-control category — at least one government issuance (BIS Commerce Department export-control rule under Cat 5 part 2 dual-use cryptography or a parallel cyber-capability category, NIST AI Cyber Center RFI follow-up, or White House executive order) explicitly names frontier cyber-AI as a license-required category; at least two other foundation labs (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, xAI, Mistral, or Cohere) ship a comparable gated-distribution program with public partner-list disclosure mirroring the Glasswing pattern.** Forcing function is the asymmetry the Aether disclosure surfaces: the same model the Pentagon refused to procure is the one the NSA depends on for sovereign cyber benchmarking, which makes it impossible for the executive branch to leave the regulatory category undefined; the Apr 29 CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA authority + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, tool invocation abuse) provide the disclosure-side regulatory infrastructure. The path of least resistance is BIS issuing a rule under Cat 5 because it has 30 years of dual-use-tech precedent and avoids carving up the full FDA-style approval regime that would slow open-source agent skills. In plain language: When the NSA started borrowing Anthropic's most powerful AI to find Microsoft bugs, the US government had to start regulating who else can borrow it. description.ja: **2026年Q3までに、4月7日のAnthropic Mythos PreviewのProject Glasswing下での発表(~50社のローンチパートナー + ~40の重要ソフトウェアインフラ組織 + $100Mの利用クレジット + $4Mのオープンソースセキュリティ寄付)、4月30日のBloombergによるNSA Project AetherのMythosと機密主権サイバーツールのベンチマーク開示、5月1日のPentagon CTO声明によるAnthropic排除リストとNSA Mythos関与の分離が、米国がフロンティアサイバー能力AI輸出規制カテゴリーを正式に定義する規制プルを生み出す。少なくとも1つの政府発出(Cat 5 part 2のデュアルユース暗号下のBIS商務省輸出規制規則、または並行するサイバー能力カテゴリー、NIST AI Cyber Center RFIフォローアップ、ホワイトハウス大統領令)がフロンティアサイバーAIをライセンス必須カテゴリーとして明示的に命名する。少なくとも他に2つのファウンデーションラボ(OpenAI、Google DeepMind、xAI、Mistral、Cohere)が、Glasswingパターンを反映する公開パートナーリスト開示を伴う同等のゲート付き配布プログラムを出荷する。** 強制力はAether開示が表面化させた非対称性である。Pentagonが調達を拒否した同じモデルが、NSAが主権サイバーベンチマークで依存しているモデルだ。これにより、行政府が規制カテゴリーを未定義のままにすることは不可能となる。4月29日のCSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA権限 + ATT&CK v19の命名済み手法(MCPサーバー侵害、ツール呼び出し悪用)が開示側の規制インフラを提供する。最も抵抗の少ない経路はBISがCat 5下で規則を発出することだ。なぜなら30年のデュアルユース技術の前例があり、オープンソースのエージェントスキルを遅延させるFDA型の本格承認体制を切り出すことを避けられるからだ。平易な言葉で言えば: NSAがAnthropicの最強AIをMicrosoftバグ探しに借り始めたとき、米国政府は他に誰がそれを借りられるかを規制し始めなければならなくなった。
description.es: **Para Q3 2026, el lanzamiento del 7 de abril de Anthropic Mythos Preview bajo Project Glasswing (~50 socios de lanzamiento + ~40 organizaciones de software-infraestructura crítica + $100M en créditos de uso + $4M en donaciones de seguridad de código abierto) + la divulgación de Bloomberg del 30 de abril sobre el Project Aether de la NSA que evalúa Mythos contra herramientas cibernéticas soberanas clasificadas + la declaración del CTO del Pentágono del 1 de mayo separando la lista negra de Anthropic de la colaboración Mythos-NSA crea la presión regulatoria para que EE. UU. defina formalmente una categoría de control de exportación de IA de cibercapacidad frontera — al menos una emisión gubernamental (regla de control de exportación del BIS del Departamento de Comercio bajo Cat 5 parte 2 criptografía de doble uso o una categoría paralela de cibercapacidad, seguimiento de RFI del NIST AI Cyber Center, u orden ejecutiva de la Casa Blanca) nombra explícitamente la IA de cibercapacidad frontera como categoría que requiere licencia; al menos otros dos laboratorios de modelos fundacionales (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, xAI, Mistral, o Cohere) entregan un programa comparable de distribución gated con divulgación pública de lista de socios reflejando el patrón de Glasswing.** La función forzante es la asimetría que la divulgación de Aether expone: el mismo modelo que el Pentágono se negó a contratar es del que la NSA depende para la evaluación de cibercapacidades soberanas, lo que hace imposible que el ejecutivo deje la categoría regulatoria sin definir; la autoridad MITRE-CNA del 29 de abril de CSAI Foundation + las técnicas nombradas de ATT&CK v19 (compromiso de servidor MCP, abuso de invocación de herramientas) proveen la infraestructura regulatoria del lado de divulgación. El camino de menor resistencia es que el BIS emita una regla bajo Cat 5 porque tiene 30 años de precedente de tecnología de doble uso y evita tallar todo el régimen de aprobación tipo FDA que ralentizaría las habilidades de agentes de código abierto. En lenguaje sencillo: Cuando la NSA empezó a tomar prestada la IA más potente de Anthropic para encontrar bugs de Microsoft, el gobierno de EE. UU. tuvo que empezar a regular quién más puede tomarla prestada.
description.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang Apr 7 Anthropic Mythos Preview launch sa ilalim ng Project Glasswing (~50 launch partners + ~40 critical-software-infrastructure orgs + $100M usage credits + $4M open-source security donations) + ang Apr 30 Bloomberg-disclosed NSA Project Aether na nag-bebenchmark ng Mythos laban sa classified sovereign cyber tools + ang May 1 Pentagon CTO statement na naghihiwalay ng Anthropic blacklist mula sa NSA Mythos engagement ay lumilikha ng regulatory-pull para sa US na pormal na tukuyin ang isang frontier cyber-capability AI export-control category — hindi bababa sa isang government issuance (BIS Commerce Department export-control rule sa ilalim ng Cat 5 part 2 dual-use cryptography o parallel cyber-capability category, NIST AI Cyber Center RFI follow-up, o White House executive order) ang tahasang magpapangalan sa frontier cyber-AI bilang license-required category; hindi bababa sa dalawa pang foundation labs (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, xAI, Mistral, o Cohere) ang maglalabas ng katumbas na gated-distribution program na may pampublikong partner-list disclosure na sumasalamin sa Glasswing pattern.** Ang forcing function ay ang asymmetry na inilantad ng Aether disclosure: ang parehong modelo na tinanggihang bilhin ng Pentagon ay ang umaasahan ng NSA para sa sovereign cyber benchmarking, na nagpapahirap sa executive branch na iwanang hindi tinukoy ang regulatory category; ang Apr 29 CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA authority + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, tool invocation abuse) ang nagbibigay ng disclosure-side regulatory infrastructure. Ang pinakamadaling daan ay maglabas ang BIS ng panuntunan sa ilalim ng Cat 5 dahil mayroon itong 30 taong dual-use-tech precedent at iniiwasan nito ang pagbabaha-bahagi ng buong FDA-style approval regime na magpapabagal sa open-source agent skills. Sa madaling salita: nang nagsimulang humiram ang NSA ng pinakamalakas na AI ng Anthropic para hanapin ang Microsoft bugs, kinailangang regulahin ng US government kung sino pa ang maaaring humiram nito.

summary.en: **By Q3 2026 the Apr 7 Anthropic Mythos Preview launch under Project Glasswing (~50 launch partners + ~40 critical-software-infrastructure orgs + $100M usage credits + $4M open-source security donations) + the Apr 30 Bloomberg-disclosed NSA Project Aether benchmarking Mythos against classified sovereign cyber tools + the May 1 Pentagon CTO statement separating the Anthropic blacklist from the NSA Mythos engagement creates the regulatory-pull for the US to formally define a frontier cyber-capability AI export-control category — at least one government issuance (BIS Commerce Department export-control rule under Cat 5 part 2 dual-use cryptography or a parallel cyber-capability category, NIST AI Cyber Center RFI follow-up, or White House executive order) explicitly names frontier cyber-AI as a license-required category; at least two other foundation labs (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, xAI, Mistral, or Cohere) ship a comparable gated-distribution program with public partner-list disclosure mirroring the Glasswing pattern.** Forcing function is the asymmetry the Aether disclosure surfaces: the same model the Pentagon refused to procure is the one the NSA depends on for sovereign cyber benchmarking, which makes it impossible for the executive branch to leave the regulatory category undefined; the Apr 29 CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA authority + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, tool invocation abuse) provide the disclosure-side regulatory infrastructure. The path of least resistance is BIS issuing a rule under Cat 5 because it has 30 years of dual-use-tech precedent and avoids carving up the full FDA-style approval regime that would slow open-source agent skills. In plain language: When the NSA started borrowing Anthropic's most powerful AI to find Microsoft bugs, the US government had to start regulating who else can borrow it. summary_short_locales.ja: 4月7日のProject Glasswing下のMythos Preview、4月30日のBloombergによるMythosをベンチマークするNSA Project Aetherの開示、5月1日のPentagon CTOの切り分けが、規制の前倒しを構成する。2026年Q3までに、BIS、NIST、または大統領令の発出がフロンティアサイバーAIをライセンス必須として命名し、さらに2つのラボがゲート付き配布プログラムを出荷することが見込まれる。

Para Q3 2026 se espera una emisión del BIS, NIST u orden ejecutiva nombrando la IA de cibercapacidad frontera como categoría que requiere licencia, con dos laboratorios más entregando programas de distribución gated.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Apr 7 Mythos Preview sa ilalim ng Project Glasswing, ang Apr 30 Bloomberg disclosure ng NSA Project Aether na nagbe-benchmark ng Mythos, at ang May 1 Pentagon CTO carve-out ay bumubuo ng regulatory pull-forward. bridges.text: The Indo-Pacific cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter widens to eight named jurisdictions Sunday with India MeitY plus CERT-In and Taiwan NICS joining as formal observers, NHS England's named-CVE blocklist holds as the de-facto procurement-side export control, and Sunday Lawfare and Just Security FMRB analyses elevate customary-international-practice baseline arguments naming the cohort as the operative reference the US executive surface must mirror.

text_locales.en: The Indo-Pacific cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter widens to eight named jurisdictions Sunday with India MeitY plus CERT-In and Taiwan NICS joining as formal observers, NHS England's named-CVE blocklist holds as the de-facto procurement-side export control, and Sunday Lawfare and Just Security FMRB analyses elevate customary-international-practice baseline arguments naming the cohort as the operative reference the US executive surface must mirror.
text_locales.ja: インド太平洋サイバー評価相互性ペリメーターは日曜にインドMeitYプラスCERT-Inと台湾NICSが正式オブザーバーとして合流し8つの命名管轄区へ広がる、NHS Englandの命名CVEブロックリストは事実上の調達側輸出規制として保持される、そして日曜LawfareとJust SecurityのFMRB分析は、コホートをUS行政表面がミラーすべき作動リファレンスとして命名する慣習国際慣行ベースライン論証を引き上げる。
text_locales.es: El perímetro de reciprocidad cyber-evaluación Indo-Pacífico se amplía a ocho jurisdicciones nombradas el domingo con India MeitY más CERT-In y Taiwan NICS uniéndose como observadores formales, la blocklist de CVE nombrada de NHS England se mantiene como el control de exportación de-facto lado-adquisición, y los análisis FMRB dominicales de Lawfare y Just Security elevan argumentos de base de práctica internacional consuetudinaria nombrando la cohorte como la referencia operativa que la superficie ejecutiva de EE.UU. debe reflejar.
text_locales.fil: Lumalawak ang Indo-Pacific cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter sa walong named jurisdictions noong Linggo kasama ang India MeitY plus CERT-In at Taiwan NICS na sumasama bilang formal observers, hawak ng NHS England's named-CVE blocklist bilang de-facto procurement-side export control, at itinataas ng Sunday Lawfare at Just Security FMRB analyses ang customary-international-practice baseline arguments na nagpapangalan sa cohort bilang operative reference na dapat i-mirror ng US executive surface.

bridges.text: South Korea's PIPC plus Ministry of Science and ICT signal intent to mirror the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity MoC under a 90-day consultation window, and New Zealand's GCSB joins Canada CCCS and Australia ASD ACSC as observer with a Q3 mirror commitment. The recognition perimeter widens by two jurisdictions while OSTP confirms no FMRB signing before May 22 — the US gap sharpens.

The recognition perimeter widens by two jurisdictions while OSTP confirms no FMRB signing before May 22 — the US gap sharpens.
text_locales.ja: 韓国PIPCと科学技術情報通信部は90日協議ウィンドウ下でSingapore IMDA / Japan AISIサイバー評価相互性MoCをミラーする意向をシグナルし、ニュージーランドGCSBがCanada CCCSとAustralia ASD ACSCにオブザーバーとしてQ3ミラー・コミットメントを伴って合流。OSTPが5月22日以前のFMRB署名はないと確認する中、認識ペリメーターは2管轄区拡大する — 米国ギャップが先鋭化する。
text_locales.es: PIPC más el Ministerio de Ciencia y TIC de Corea del Sur señalan intención de reflejar el MoC de reciprocidad cyber-eval Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI bajo una ventana de consulta de 90 días, y el GCSB de Nueva Zelanda se une a Canada CCCS y Australia ASD ACSC como observador con un compromiso de espejo Q3. El perímetro de reconocimiento se amplía por dos jurisdicciones mientras OSTP confirma que no hay firma FMRB antes del 22 de mayo — la brecha de EE.UU. se afila.
text_locales.fil: Sinesenyas ng PIPC ng South Korea kasama ang Ministry of Science and ICT ang intent na i-mirror ang Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity MoC sa ilalim ng 90-day consultation window, at ang GCSB ng New Zealand ay sumasama sa Canada CCCS at Australia ASD ACSC bilang observer na may Q3 mirror commitment. Lumalawak ang recognition perimeter ng dalawang jurisdictions habang kinukumpirma ng OSTP na walang FMRB signing bago ang Mayo 22 — lumalalim ang US gap.

bridges.text: Singapore IMDA and Japan AISI sign a parallel cyber-eval reciprocity MoC citing the May 7 EU-UK protocol as template, with Canada CCCS and Australia ASD ACSC observing; HM Treasury extends the LLM-coding-assistant procurement pause to 30 days naming Gemini Code Assist and GitHub Copilot for Government. Four-jurisdiction recognition plus named-vendor freeze sharpens the cyber-capability category landing.

Four-jurisdiction recognition plus named-vendor freeze sharpens the cyber-capability category landing.
text_locales.ja: Singapore IMDAと日本AISIは、5月7日のEU-UKプロトコルをテンプレートとして引用するパラレルなcyber-eval reciprocity MoCに署名し、Canada CCCSとAustralia ASD ACSCがオブザーバーとして参加する。HM TreasuryはLLMコーディングアシスタント調達一時停止を30日間に延長し、Gemini Code AssistとGitHub Copilot for Governmentを名指しする。4管轄区域の認知に加え、ベンダー名指しでの凍結が、cyber-capabilityカテゴリーの着地を鋭くする。
text_locales.es: Singapore IMDA y Japan AISI firman un MoC paralelo de reciprocidad cyber-eval citando el protocolo EU-UK del 7 de mayo como plantilla, con Canada CCCS y Australia ASD ACSC como observadores; HM Treasury extiende la pausa de adquisicion de LLM-coding-assistant a 30 dias nombrando a Gemini Code Assist y GitHub Copilot for Government. El reconocimiento de cuatro jurisdicciones mas el congelamiento con vendor nombrado afilan la llegada de la categoria cyber-capability.
text_locales.fil: Pumirma ang Singapore IMDA at Japan AISI ng parallel cyber-eval reciprocity MoC na binabanggit ang May 7 EU-UK protocol bilang template, kasama ang Canada CCCS at Australia ASD ACSC bilang observers; pinalawig ng HM Treasury ang LLM-coding-assistant procurement pause sa 30 araw, pinapangalanan ang Gemini Code Assist at GitHub Copilot for Government. Ang four-jurisdiction recognition kasama ang named-vendor freeze ay nagpapatalas sa landing ng cyber-capability category.

bridges.text: The FMRB EO draft keying notification to the AISI 32-step threshold, the EU-UK joint cyber-eval reciprocity memorandum, and UK NCSC's CNI lockdown plus HM Treasury procurement pause together form the trans-Atlantic shape the frontier cyber-AI export-control prediction (May 3) names — a measurable threshold plus operating de-facto export-control posture is now in place ahead of any formal BIS designation.

text_locales.en: The FMRB EO draft keying notification to the AISI 32-step threshold, the EU-UK joint cyber-eval reciprocity memorandum, and UK NCSC's CNI lockdown plus HM Treasury procurement pause together form the trans-Atlantic shape the frontier cyber-AI export-control prediction (May 3) names — a measurable threshold plus operating de-facto export-control posture is now in place ahead of any formal BIS designation.
text_locales.ja: AISI 32ステップ閾値に通知を紐づけたFMRB大統領令ドラフト、EU-UK共同サイバー評価相互主義覚書、英国NCSCのCNIロックダウンとHM Treasury調達一時停止が、フロンティア・サイバーAI輸出規制予測(5月3日)が指す大西洋越えの形状を共に形成する。測定可能な閾値と事実上の輸出規制姿勢が、正式なBIS指定に先立って整備された。
text_locales.es: El borrador EO del FMRB que vincula la notificación al umbral AISI de 32 pasos, el memorándum de reciprocidad de evaluación cibernética conjunta UE-Reino Unido, y el bloqueo CNI del NCSC del Reino Unido más la pausa de adquisiciones del HM Treasury forman juntos la forma transatlántica que la predicción de control de exportaciones cibernético-IA frontier (3 de mayo) nombra — un umbral medible más una postura operativa de control de exportaciones de facto está ahora en su lugar antes de cualquier designación formal de BIS.
text_locales.fil: Ang FMRB EO draft na nagka-key ng notification sa AISI 32-step threshold, ang EU-UK joint cyber-eval reciprocity memorandum, at ang CNI lockdown ng UK NCSC kasama ang HM Treasury procurement pause ay sama-samang bumubuo sa trans-Atlantic shape na pinapangalanan ng frontier cyber-AI export-control prediction (Mayo 3) — isang nasusukat na threshold kasama ang umiiral na de-facto export-control posture ay nasa lugar na ngayon bago ang anumang formal BIS designation.

bridges.text: The White House EO trail plus the AISI 32-step attack range plus the UK NHS GitHub lockdown plus Anthropic Project Glasswing's vetted-partner routing tighten the structural force the frontier cyber-AI export-control prediction (May 3) names: a measurable cyber-capability threshold (AISI Expert-tier above human ceiling on a 20-hour exploit chain) plus an operating de-facto export-control posture is now in place ahead of any BIS / Commerce category.

text_locales.en: The White House EO trail plus the AISI 32-step attack range plus the UK NHS GitHub lockdown plus Anthropic Project Glasswing's vetted-partner routing tighten the structural force the frontier cyber-AI export-control prediction (May 3) names: a measurable cyber-capability threshold (AISI Expert-tier above human ceiling on a 20-hour exploit chain) plus an operating de-facto export-control posture is now in place ahead of any BIS / Commerce category.
text_locales.ja: ホワイトハウスEOトレイル、AISIの32ステップ攻撃レンジ、UK NHSのGitHubロックダウン、Anthropic Project Glasswingの審査済みパートナー・ルーティングは、フロンティア・サイバーAI輸出管理予測(5月3日)が指摘する構造的力を強化する: 測定可能なサイバー能力閾値(AISIエキスパート層が20時間エクスプロイト・チェーンで人間の上限を超える)に加え、運用中のデファクト輸出管理姿勢が、いかなるBIS / Commerceカテゴリよりも先に整っている。
text_locales.es: La pista de la EO de la Casa Blanca más el rango de ataque de 32 pasos de AISI más el bloqueo de GitHub del NHS del Reino Unido más el ruteo de partners evaluados de Anthropic Project Glasswing tensan la fuerza estructural que nombra la predicción de control de exportación cyber-IA frontier (3 may): un umbral medible de capacidad cyber (tier-Experto AISI por encima del techo humano en una cadena de explotación de 20 horas) más una postura de control de exportación de facto operativa están ahora en su sitio por delante de cualquier categoría BIS / Commerce.
text_locales.fil: Ang White House EO trail plus ang AISI 32-step attack range plus ang UK NHS GitHub lockdown plus ang Anthropic Project Glasswing's vetted-partner routing ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinapangalanan ng frontier cyber-AI export-control prediction (Mayo 3): isang measurable cyber-capability threshold (AISI Expert-tier sa itaas ng human ceiling sa 20-hour exploit chain) plus isang umaandar na de-facto export-control posture ay nasa lugar bago ang anumang BIS / Commerce category.

text_locales.es: El anuncio de la JV del 4 de mayo de Anthropic manteniendo Project Glasswing distribución gated como la forma de referencia operativa más la encuesta de Stellar Cyber tratando cyber-IA de frontera como un eje regulatorio refuerzan la precondición: el andamiaje de distribución gated + MITRE-CNA que la predicción nombra ahora es visible junto a la comunicación de despliegue comercial empresarial.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 4 JV announcement ng Anthropic na nagpapanatili sa Project Glasswing gated-distribution bilang operative reference shape plus ang Stellar Cyber survey na nagtatrato sa frontier cyber-AI bilang regulatory axis ay nagpapatibay sa precondition: ang gated-distribution + MITRE-CNA scaffolding na pinangalanan ng prediction ay nakikita na ngayon kasama ang enterprise commercial-deployment communication.
