detail.description: **By Q3 2026 the Apr 7 Anthropic Mythos Preview launch under Project Glasswing (~50 launch partners + ~40 critical-software-infrastructure orgs + $100M usage credits + $4M open-source security donations) + the Apr 30 Bloomberg-disclosed NSA Project Aether benchmarking Mythos against classified sovereign cyber tools + the May 1 Pentagon CTO statement separating the Anthropic blacklist from the NSA Mythos engagement creates the regulatory-pull for the US to formally define a frontier cyber-capability AI export-control category — at least one government issuance (BIS Commerce Department export-control rule under Cat 5 part 2 dual-use cryptography or a parallel cyber-capability category, NIST AI Cyber Center RFI follow-up, or White House executive order) explicitly names frontier cyber-AI as a license-required category; at least two other foundation labs (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, xAI, Mistral, or Cohere) ship a comparable gated-distribution program with public partner-list disclosure mirroring the Glasswing pattern.** Forcing function is the asymmetry the Aether disclosure surfaces: the same model the Pentagon refused to procure is the one the NSA depends on for sovereign cyber benchmarking, which makes it impossible for the executive branch to leave the regulatory category undefined; the Apr 29 CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA authority + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, tool invocation abuse) provide the disclosure-side regulatory infrastructure. The path of least resistance is BIS issuing a rule under Cat 5 because it has 30 years of dual-use-tech precedent and avoids carving up the full FDA-style approval regime that would slow open-source agent skills. In plain language: When the NSA started borrowing Anthropic's most powerful AI to find Microsoft bugs, the US government had to start regulating who else can borrow it. prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年Q3までに、4月7日のAnthropic Mythos PreviewのProject Glasswing下での発表(~50社のローンチパートナー + ~40の重要ソフトウェアインフラ組織 + $100Mの利用クレジット + $4Mのオープンソースセキュリティ寄付)、4月30日のBloombergによるNSA Project AetherのMythosと機密主権サイバーツールのベンチマーク開示、5月1日のPentagon CTO声明によるAnthropic排除リストとNSA Mythos関与の分離が、米国がフロンティアサイバー能力AI輸出規制カテゴリーを正式に定義する規制プルを生み出す。少なくとも1つの政府発出(Cat 5 part 2のデュアルユース暗号下のBIS商務省輸出規制規則、または並行するサイバー能力カテゴリー、NIST AI Cyber Center RFIフォローアップ、ホワイトハウス大統領令)がフロンティアサイバーAIをライセンス必須カテゴリーとして明示的に命名する。少なくとも他に2つのファウンデーションラボ(OpenAI、Google DeepMind、xAI、Mistral、Cohere)が、Glasswingパターンを反映する公開パートナーリスト開示を伴う同等のゲート付き配布プログラムを出荷する。** 強制力はAether開示が表面化させた非対称性である。Pentagonが調達を拒否した同じモデルが、NSAが主権サイバーベンチマークで依存しているモデルだ。これにより、行政府が規制カテゴリーを未定義のままにすることは不可能となる。4月29日のCSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA権限 + ATT&CK v19の命名済み手法(MCPサーバー侵害、ツール呼び出し悪用)が開示側の規制インフラを提供する。最も抵抗の少ない経路はBISがCat 5下で規則を発出することだ。なぜなら30年のデュアルユース技術の前例があり、オープンソースのエージェントスキルを遅延させるFDA型の本格承認体制を切り出すことを避けられるからだ。平易な言葉で言えば: NSAがAnthropicの最強AIをMicrosoftバグ探しに借り始めたとき、米国政府は他に誰がそれを借りられるかを規制し始めなければならなくなった。
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para Q3 2026, el lanzamiento del 7 de abril de Anthropic Mythos Preview bajo Project Glasswing (~50 socios de lanzamiento + ~40 organizaciones de software-infraestructura crítica + $100M en créditos de uso + $4M en donaciones de seguridad de código abierto) + la divulgación de Bloomberg del 30 de abril sobre el Project Aether de la NSA que evalúa Mythos contra herramientas cibernéticas soberanas clasificadas + la declaración del CTO del Pentágono del 1 de mayo separando la lista negra de Anthropic de la colaboración Mythos-NSA crea la presión regulatoria para que EE. UU. defina formalmente una categoría de control de exportación de IA de cibercapacidad frontera — al menos una emisión gubernamental (regla de control de exportación del BIS del Departamento de Comercio bajo Cat 5 parte 2 criptografía de doble uso o una categoría paralela de cibercapacidad, seguimiento de RFI del NIST AI Cyber Center, u orden ejecutiva de la Casa Blanca) nombra explícitamente la IA de cibercapacidad frontera como categoría que requiere licencia; al menos otros dos laboratorios de modelos fundacionales (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, xAI, Mistral, o Cohere) entregan un programa comparable de distribución gated con divulgación pública de lista de socios reflejando el patrón de Glasswing.** La función forzante es la asimetría que la divulgación de Aether expone: el mismo modelo que el Pentágono se negó a contratar es del que la NSA depende para la evaluación de cibercapacidades soberanas, lo que hace imposible que el ejecutivo deje la categoría regulatoria sin definir; la autoridad MITRE-CNA del 29 de abril de CSAI Foundation + las técnicas nombradas de ATT&CK v19 (compromiso de servidor MCP, abuso de invocación de herramientas) proveen la infraestructura regulatoria del lado de divulgación. El camino de menor resistencia es que el BIS emita una regla bajo Cat 5 porque tiene 30 años de precedente de tecnología de doble uso y evita tallar todo el régimen de aprobación tipo FDA que ralentizaría las habilidades de agentes de código abierto. En lenguaje sencillo: Cuando la NSA empezó a tomar prestada la IA más potente de Anthropic para encontrar bugs de Microsoft, el gobierno de EE. UU. tuvo que empezar a regular quién más puede tomarla prestada.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang Apr 7 Anthropic Mythos Preview launch sa ilalim ng Project Glasswing (~50 launch partners + ~40 critical-software-infrastructure orgs + $100M usage credits + $4M open-source security donations) + ang Apr 30 Bloomberg-disclosed NSA Project Aether na nag-bebenchmark ng Mythos laban sa classified sovereign cyber tools + ang May 1 Pentagon CTO statement na naghihiwalay ng Anthropic blacklist mula sa NSA Mythos engagement ay lumilikha ng regulatory-pull para sa US na pormal na tukuyin ang isang frontier cyber-capability AI export-control category — hindi bababa sa isang government issuance (BIS Commerce Department export-control rule sa ilalim ng Cat 5 part 2 dual-use cryptography o parallel cyber-capability category, NIST AI Cyber Center RFI follow-up, o White House executive order) ang tahasang magpapangalan sa frontier cyber-AI bilang license-required category; hindi bababa sa dalawa pang foundation labs (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, xAI, Mistral, o Cohere) ang maglalabas ng katumbas na gated-distribution program na may pampublikong partner-list disclosure na sumasalamin sa Glasswing pattern.** Ang forcing function ay ang asymmetry na inilantad ng Aether disclosure: ang parehong modelo na tinanggihang bilhin ng Pentagon ay ang umaasahan ng NSA para sa sovereign cyber benchmarking, na nagpapahirap sa executive branch na iwanang hindi tinukoy ang regulatory category; ang Apr 29 CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA authority + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, tool invocation abuse) ang nagbibigay ng disclosure-side regulatory infrastructure. Ang pinakamadaling daan ay maglabas ang BIS ng panuntunan sa ilalim ng Cat 5 dahil mayroon itong 30 taong dual-use-tech precedent at iniiwasan nito ang pagbabaha-bahagi ng buong FDA-style approval regime na magpapabagal sa open-source agent skills. Sa madaling salita: nang nagsimulang humiram ang NSA ng pinakamalakas na AI ng Anthropic para hanapin ang Microsoft bugs, kinailangang regulahin ng US government kung sino pa ang maaaring humiram nito.

nodes.description: Cisco's May 4 $400M Astrix Security acquisition makes non-human-identity (NHI) governance an explicit M&A-tier primitive on the same week as Microsoft Agent 365 GA (May 1, $15/user/mo M365 E7 SKU with per-agent Defender relationship map + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) and the May 1 Cloud Security Alliance posting that names identity as Zero Trust's first pillar in the agentic-AI era. The structural backdrop is severe: ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers as of early 2026 with roughly half operating with no authorization controls, AI agents and other non-human identities now outnumber human users ~100:1 in major enterprises (per Cisco's customer survey), and MCP itself ships with no built-in identity, no least-privilege enforcement, and no audit trail. Cisco's planned integration of Astrix into Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM converges with Microsoft's per-agent identity model into a de-facto two-vendor NHI control-plane primitive — but the procurement tier above (federal CISO offices, banking regulators, healthcare HIPAA-scoped buyers) requires a published-standard reference, not a vendor-specific architecture diagram. By Q4 2026 NIST is expected to publish a dedicated NHI control profile (most likely as a SP 800-207-series Zero Trust supplement or an SP 800-53 control-family overlay) treating machine identities, agent identities, and service-account identities as a distinct compliance category with discovery, lifecycle, least-privilege, and audit-trail control families. CISA agentic-AI guidance and SEC cyber-disclosure-rule commentary follow within one quarter via the same forcing function — the $400M Astrix M&A price tag is itself a regulator-readable signal that the category has crossed into balance-sheet materiality.

description.ja: 5月4日のCiscoによる$400MのAstrix Security買収は、5月1日のMicrosoft Agent 365 GA($15/ユーザー/月のM365 E7 SKU、エージェント単位のDefenderリレーションシップマップ + Entra ID + Purview + Intune)、そしてエージェントAI時代のZero Trust第一の柱としてアイデンティティを名指しした5月1日のCloud Security Alliance投稿と同じ週に、非人間アイデンティティ(NHI)ガバナンスを明示的なM&A階層のプリミティブにする。構造的な背景は深刻だ: 2026年初頭時点で約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバーがあり、その約半数が認可コントロールなしで稼働、AIエージェントその他の非人間アイデンティティが大手企業内で人間ユーザーを約100:1で上回る(Ciscoの顧客調査)、そしてMCP自体は組み込みアイデンティティ、最小権限、監査証跡を一切備えていない。CiscoによるAstrixのCisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAMへの統合計画は、Microsoftのエージェント単位アイデンティティ・モデルと収斂してデファクトの2ベンダーNHIコントロール・プレーン・プリミティブを形成する — しかしその上の調達階層(連邦CISOオフィス、銀行規制当局、HIPAAスコープのヘルスケア・バイヤー)は、ベンダー固有のアーキテクチャ図ではなく公表標準のリファレンスを要求する。2026年Q4までに、NISTは専用のNHIコントロール・プロファイルを公表することが期待される(SP 800-207系のZero Trust補遺、もしくはSP 800-53コントロール・ファミリー・オーバーレイの形が最有力)。マシン・アイデンティティ、エージェント・アイデンティティ、サービス・アカウント・アイデンティティを、発見、ライフサイクル、最小権限、監査証跡のコントロール・ファミリーを伴う独立したコンプライアンス・カテゴリとして扱う。CISAのエージェントAIガイダンスとSECのサイバー開示ルール・コメンタリーは同じ強制関数で1四半期以内に追随する — $400MのAstrix M&A価格自体が、カテゴリがバランスシート重要性に達したことを示す規制当局可読のシグナルである。
description.es: La adquisición del 4 de mayo de Astrix Security por $400M de Cisco hace de la gobernanza de identidad no-humana (NHI) un primitivo explícito de nivel M&A en la misma semana que la GA de Microsoft Agent 365 (1 de mayo, SKU M365 E7 a $15/user/mo con mapa de relaciones por agente de Defender + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) y la publicación del 1 de mayo de Cloud Security Alliance que nombra a la identidad como el primer pilar de Zero Trust en la era de la IA agéntica. El telón de fondo estructural es severo: ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet a comienzos de 2026 con aproximadamente la mitad operando sin controles de autorización, los agentes de IA y otras identidades no-humanas ahora superan en número a los usuarios humanos ~100:1 en empresas grandes (según la encuesta de clientes de Cisco), y MCP mismo se entrega sin identidad incorporada, sin aplicación de mínimo privilegio y sin pista de auditoría. La integración planeada de Astrix por Cisco en Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM converge con el modelo de identidad por agente de Microsoft hacia un primitivo de plano de control de NHI de facto de dos vendors — pero el nivel de adquisición superior (oficinas federales de CISO, reguladores bancarios, compradores con alcance HIPAA en salud) requiere una referencia de estándar publicado, no un diagrama de arquitectura específico de vendor. Para Q4 2026 se espera que NIST publique un perfil de control de NHI dedicado (más probablemente como un suplemento de la serie SP 800-207 de Zero Trust o una superposición de familia de controles de SP 800-53) tratando las identidades de máquina, identidades de agente e identidades de cuentas de servicio como una categoría de cumplimiento distinta con familias de controles de descubrimiento, ciclo de vida, mínimo privilegio y pista de auditoría. La guía de IA agéntica de CISA y el comentario de la regla de divulgación cibernética de la SEC siguen dentro de un trimestre vía la misma función forzante — el precio de M&A de Astrix de $400M es en sí mismo una señal legible para reguladores de que la categoría ha cruzado a materialidad de balance.
description.fil: Ang May 4 $400M Astrix Security acquisition ng Cisco ay ginagawang explicit M&A-tier primitive ang non-human-identity (NHI) governance sa parehong linggo ng Microsoft Agent 365 GA (May 1, $15/user/mo M365 E7 SKU na may per-agent Defender relationship map + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) at ng May 1 Cloud Security Alliance posting na nagngangalan sa identity bilang unang pillar ng Zero Trust sa agentic-AI era. Malala ang structural backdrop: ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers noong unang bahagi ng 2026 na halos kalahati ay tumatakbo nang walang authorization controls, ang AI agents at ibang non-human identities ay ngayon mas marami kaysa sa human users sa ratio na ~100:1 sa mga major enterprises (ayon sa Cisco customer survey), at ang MCP mismo ay nag-ship nang walang built-in identity, walang least-privilege enforcement, at walang audit trail. Ang planned integration ng Cisco ng Astrix sa Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM ay nag-co-converge sa per-agent identity model ng Microsoft papasok sa de-facto two-vendor NHI control-plane primitive — ngunit ang procurement tier sa itaas (federal CISO offices, banking regulators, healthcare HIPAA-scoped buyers) ay nangangailangan ng nailathalang-pamantayang reference, hindi vendor-specific architecture diagram. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, inaasahan na maglathala ang NIST ng nakatuong NHI control profile (pinakamalamang bilang SP 800-207-series Zero Trust supplement o SP 800-53 control-family overlay) na tinatrato ang machine identities, agent identities, at service-account identities bilang natatanging compliance category na may discovery, lifecycle, least-privilege, at audit-trail control families. Susunod ang CISA agentic-AI guidance at SEC cyber-disclosure-rule commentary sa loob ng isang quarter sa pamamagitan ng parehong forcing function — ang $400M Astrix M&A price tag mismo ay regulator-readable signal na ang category ay tumawid na sa balance-sheet materiality.

summary.en: Cisco's May 4 $400M Astrix Security acquisition makes non-human-identity (NHI) governance an explicit M&A-tier primitive on the same week as Microsoft Agent 365 GA (May 1, $15/user/mo M365 E7 SKU with per-agent Defender relationship map + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) and the May 1 Cloud Security Alliance posting that names identity as Zero Trust's first pillar in the agentic-AI era. summary.ja: 5月4日のCiscoによる$400MのAstrix Security買収は、5月1日のMicrosoft Agent 365 GA($15/ユーザー/月のM365 E7 SKU、エージェント単位のDefenderリレーションシップマップ + Entra ID + Purview + Intune)、そしてエージェントAI時代のZero Trust第一の柱としてアイデンティティを名指しした5月1日のCloud Security Alliance投稿と同じ週に、非人間アイデンティティ(NHI)ガバナンスを明示的なM&A階層のプリミティブにする。構造的な背景は深刻だ: 2026年初頭時点で約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバーがあり、その約半数が認可コントロールなしで稼働、AIエージェントその他の非人間アイデンティティが大手企業内で人間ユーザーを約100:1で上回る(Ciscoの顧客調査)、そしてMCP自体は組み込みアイデンティティ、最小権限、監査証跡を一切備えていない。CiscoによるAstrixのCisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAMへの統合計画は、Microsoftのエージェント単位アイデンティティ・モデルと収斂してデファクトの2ベンダーNHIコントロール・プレーン・プリミティブを形成する — しかしその上の調達階層(連邦CISOオフィス、銀行規制当局、HIPAAスコープのヘルスケア・バイヤー)は、ベンダー固有のアーキテクチャ図ではなく公表標準のリファレンスを要求する。2026年Q4までに、NISTは専用のNHIコントロール・プロファイルを公表することが期待される(SP 800-207系のZero Trust補遺、もしくはSP 800-53コントロール・ファミリー・オーバーレイの形が最有力)。マシン・アイデンティティ、エージェント・アイデンティティ、サービス・アカウント・アイデンティティを、発見、ライフサイクル、最小権限、監査証跡のコントロール・ファミリーを伴う独立したコンプライアンス・カテゴリとして扱う。CISAのエージェントAIガイダンスとSECのサイバー開示ルール・コメンタリーは同じ強制関数で1四半期以内に追随する — $400MのAstrix M&A価格自体が、カテゴリがバランスシート重要性に達したことを示す規制当局可読のシグナルである。

bridges.text: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0's signed sandboxed-skill registry plus OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry GA with FedRAMP-Moderate plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP-server threat-detection GA, layered against ~9,400 exposed MCP servers (~58% no-auth), tighten the cross-vendor agent-identity baseline a NIST non-human-identity control profile would consolidate. The taxonomy work itself is still missing.

text_locales.en: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0's signed sandboxed-skill registry plus OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry GA with FedRAMP-Moderate plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP-server threat-detection GA, layered against ~9,400 exposed MCP servers (~58% no-auth), tighten the cross-vendor agent-identity baseline a NIST non-human-identity control profile would consolidate. The taxonomy work itself is still missing.
text_locales.ja: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0の署名サンドボックス・スキルレジストリ、OpenAI ChatGPT Enterpriseの組織別エージェントレジストリFedRAMP-Moderate GA、Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCPサーバー脅威検出GAが、約9,400露出MCPサーバー(約58%が認証なし)を背景に、NIST非人間アイデンティティ管理プロファイルが統合するであろうクロスベンダー・エージェント・アイデンティティ基盤を強化する。タクソノミー作業自体は依然欠落している。
text_locales.es: El registro de habilidades sandbox firmado de Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 más la GA del registro de agentes por organización de OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise con FedRAMP-Moderate más la GA de detección de amenazas de servidor MCP de Microsoft Defender for Cloud, en capas contra ~9.400 servidores MCP expuestos (~58% sin autenticación), tensan la línea base de identidad de agente entre proveedores que un perfil de control de identidad no humana de NIST consolidaría. El trabajo de taxonomía en sí sigue faltando.
text_locales.fil: Ang signed sandboxed-skill registry ng Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 kasama ang per-org agent registry GA ng OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise na may FedRAMP-Moderate kasama ang MCP-server threat-detection GA ng Microsoft Defender for Cloud, na nakapatong sa ~9,400 exposed MCP servers (~58% no-auth), ay naghihigpit sa cross-vendor agent-identity baseline na iko-consolidate ng NIST non-human-identity control profile. Ang taxonomy work mismo ay nawawala pa rin.

needs.actor: Fortune-500 financial-services CISO commenting on the NIST initial public draft
needs.job: submit substantive public-comment feedback that ties the proposed NHI control families back to concrete operational findings — MCP-server inventory gaps, service-account proliferation, and agentic-AI lateral-movement scenarios already observed inside the bank's own Microsoft Agent 365 and Anthropic-finance-agent deployments.
needs.outcome: Filed public comment (and an industry-coalition joint comment with FS-ISAC peers) that shapes the final control profile to include audit-trail attribution requirements compatible with SR 11-7 model-risk and SEC cyber-disclosure reporting.
needs.motivation: Avoid being forced into a control profile that mismatches existing model-risk and cyber-disclosure controls — better to invest comment cycles upfront than retrofit a published standard against bank-specific operational reality.

outcome_locales.en: Filed public comment (and an industry-coalition joint comment with FS-ISAC peers) that shapes the final control profile to include audit-trail attribution requirements compatible with SR 11-7 model-risk and SEC cyber-disclosure reporting.

motivation_locales.en: Avoid being forced into a control profile that mismatches existing model-risk and cyber-disclosure controls — better to invest comment cycles upfront than retrofit a published standard against bank-specific operational reality.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: Cisco's May 4 $400M Astrix Security acquisition makes non-human-identity (NHI) governance an explicit M&A-tier primitive on the same week as Microsoft Agent 365 GA (May 1, $15/user/mo M365 E7 SKU with per-agent Defender relationship map + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) and the May 1 Cloud Security Alliance posting that names identity as Zero Trust's first pillar in the agentic-AI era. The structural backdrop is severe: ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers as of early 2026 with roughly half operating with no authorization controls, AI agents and other non-human identities now outnumber human users ~100:1 in major enterprises (per Cisco's customer survey), and MCP itself ships with no built-in identity, no least-privilege enforcement, and no audit trail. Cisco's planned integration of Astrix into Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM converges with Microsoft's per-agent identity model into a de-facto two-vendor NHI control-plane primitive — but the procurement tier above (federal CISO offices, banking regulators, healthcare HIPAA-scoped buyers) requires a published-standard reference, not a vendor-specific architecture diagram. By Q4 2026 NIST is expected to publish a dedicated NHI control profile (most likely as a SP 800-207-series Zero Trust supplement or an SP 800-53 control-family overlay) treating machine identities, agent identities, and service-account identities as a distinct compliance category with discovery, lifecycle, least-privilege, and audit-trail control families. CISA agentic-AI guidance and SEC cyber-disclosure-rule commentary follow within one quarter via the same forcing function — the $400M Astrix M&A price tag is itself a regulator-readable signal that the category has crossed into balance-sheet materiality.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 5月4日のCiscoによる$400MのAstrix Security買収は、5月1日のMicrosoft Agent 365 GA($15/ユーザー/月のM365 E7 SKU、エージェント単位のDefenderリレーションシップマップ + Entra ID + Purview + Intune)、そしてエージェントAI時代のZero Trust第一の柱としてアイデンティティを名指しした5月1日のCloud Security Alliance投稿と同じ週に、非人間アイデンティティ(NHI)ガバナンスを明示的なM&A階層のプリミティブにする。構造的な背景は深刻だ: 2026年初頭時点で約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバーがあり、その約半数が認可コントロールなしで稼働、AIエージェントその他の非人間アイデンティティが大手企業内で人間ユーザーを約100:1で上回る(Ciscoの顧客調査)、そしてMCP自体は組み込みアイデンティティ、最小権限、監査証跡を一切備えていない。CiscoによるAstrixのCisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAMへの統合計画は、Microsoftのエージェント単位アイデンティティ・モデルと収斂してデファクトの2ベンダーNHIコントロール・プレーン・プリミティブを形成する — しかしその上の調達階層(連邦CISOオフィス、銀行規制当局、HIPAAスコープのヘルスケア・バイヤー)は、ベンダー固有のアーキテクチャ図ではなく公表標準のリファレンスを要求する。2026年Q4までに、NISTは専用のNHIコントロール・プロファイルを公表することが期待される(SP 800-207系のZero Trust補遺、もしくはSP 800-53コントロール・ファミリー・オーバーレイの形が最有力)。マシン・アイデンティティ、エージェント・アイデンティティ、サービス・アカウント・アイデンティティを、発見、ライフサイクル、最小権限、監査証跡のコントロール・ファミリーを伴う独立したコンプライアンス・カテゴリとして扱う。CISAのエージェントAIガイダンスとSECのサイバー開示ルール・コメンタリーは同じ強制関数で1四半期以内に追随する — $400MのAstrix M&A価格自体が、カテゴリがバランスシート重要性に達したことを示す規制当局可読のシグナルである。
prediction_summary_locales.es: La adquisición del 4 de mayo de Astrix Security por $400M de Cisco hace de la gobernanza de identidad no-humana (NHI) un primitivo explícito de nivel M&A en la misma semana que la GA de Microsoft Agent 365 (1 de mayo, SKU M365 E7 a $15/user/mo con mapa de relaciones por agente de Defender + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) y la publicación del 1 de mayo de Cloud Security Alliance que nombra a la identidad como el primer pilar de Zero Trust en la era de la IA agéntica. El telón de fondo estructural es severo: ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet a comienzos de 2026 con aproximadamente la mitad operando sin controles de autorización, los agentes de IA y otras identidades no-humanas ahora superan en número a los usuarios humanos ~100:1 en empresas grandes (según la encuesta de clientes de Cisco), y MCP mismo se entrega sin identidad incorporada, sin aplicación de mínimo privilegio y sin pista de auditoría. La integración planeada de Astrix por Cisco en Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM converge con el modelo de identidad por agente de Microsoft hacia un primitivo de plano de control de NHI de facto de dos vendors — pero el nivel de adquisición superior (oficinas federales de CISO, reguladores bancarios, compradores con alcance HIPAA en salud) requiere una referencia de estándar publicado, no un diagrama de arquitectura específico de vendor. Para Q4 2026 se espera que NIST publique un perfil de control de NHI dedicado (más probablemente como un suplemento de la serie SP 800-207 de Zero Trust o una superposición de familia de controles de SP 800-53) tratando las identidades de máquina, identidades de agente e identidades de cuentas de servicio como una categoría de cumplimiento distinta con familias de controles de descubrimiento, ciclo de vida, mínimo privilegio y pista de auditoría. La guía de IA agéntica de CISA y el comentario de la regla de divulgación cibernética de la SEC siguen dentro de un trimestre vía la misma función forzante — el precio de M&A de Astrix de $400M es en sí mismo una señal legible para reguladores de que la categoría ha cruzado a materialidad de balance.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Ang May 4 $400M Astrix Security acquisition ng Cisco ay ginagawang explicit M&A-tier primitive ang non-human-identity (NHI) governance sa parehong linggo ng Microsoft Agent 365 GA (May 1, $15/user/mo M365 E7 SKU na may per-agent Defender relationship map + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) at ng May 1 Cloud Security Alliance posting na nagngangalan sa identity bilang unang pillar ng Zero Trust sa agentic-AI era. Malala ang structural backdrop: ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers noong unang bahagi ng 2026 na halos kalahati ay tumatakbo nang walang authorization controls, ang AI agents at ibang non-human identities ay ngayon mas marami kaysa sa human users sa ratio na ~100:1 sa mga major enterprises (ayon sa Cisco customer survey), at ang MCP mismo ay nag-ship nang walang built-in identity, walang least-privilege enforcement, at walang audit trail. Ang planned integration ng Cisco ng Astrix sa Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM ay nag-co-converge sa per-agent identity model ng Microsoft papasok sa de-facto two-vendor NHI control-plane primitive — ngunit ang procurement tier sa itaas (federal CISO offices, banking regulators, healthcare HIPAA-scoped buyers) ay nangangailangan ng nailathalang-pamantayang reference, hindi vendor-specific architecture diagram. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, inaasahan na maglathala ang NIST ng nakatuong NHI control profile (pinakamalamang bilang SP 800-207-series Zero Trust supplement o SP 800-53 control-family overlay) na tinatrato ang machine identities, agent identities, at service-account identities bilang natatanging compliance category na may discovery, lifecycle, least-privilege, at audit-trail control families. Susunod ang CISA agentic-AI guidance at SEC cyber-disclosure-rule commentary sa loob ng isang quarter sa pamamagitan ng parehong forcing function — ang $400M Astrix M&A price tag mismo ay regulator-readable signal na ang category ay tumawid na sa balance-sheet materiality.

nodes.description: By Q3 2026 the May 4-5 New York Times reporting that the Trump administration is weighing an executive order creating a federal working group of tech executives + government officials to design a pre-release vetting process for new AI models — Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI briefed by senior administration officials last week, with Anthropic's Mythos cyber model (announced Apr 7, finding tens of thousands of zero-day vulnerabilities including a 27-year-old OpenBSD bug) cited as the immediate catalyst, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly framing a cyber "moment of danger," the UK NHS already ordering tech leaders to wall off hundreds of open-source GitHub repositories with a May deadline citing Mythos exposure, and the May 1 AISI cyber eval placing GPT-5.5 + Claude Mythos on the 32-step "The Last Ones" corporate-network attack range (each completing it end-to-end in 2-3 of 10 attempts against an AISI-estimated 20 human hours) — together force the White House to issue an executive order naming a structured pre-release vetting process for frontier models above a defined cyber-capability threshold ahead of the H2 2026 GPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5 release cohort. The shape is most likely a working-group EO with disclosure + voluntary-test-protocol scaffolding (mirroring the May 2025 - Jan 2026 NIST AISI-equivalent posture) rather than a hard FDA-style pre-market approval regime; the structural force is that the Mythos Discord-leak incident and the NHS GitHub lockdown have made the absence of a federal pre-release review the politically operative gap. Anthropic Project Glasswing + AISI red.anthropic.com framework is the de-facto template the EO formalises; OpenAI + Google sign on within one filing cycle to avoid being the lone hold-out under the new working-group reporting cadence.

description.en: By Q3 2026 the May 4-5 New York Times reporting that the Trump administration is weighing an executive order creating a federal working group of tech executives + government officials to design a pre-release vetting process for new AI models — Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI briefed by senior administration officials last week, with Anthropic's Mythos cyber model (announced Apr 7, finding tens of thousands of zero-day vulnerabilities including a 27-year-old OpenBSD bug) cited as the immediate catalyst, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly framing a cyber "moment of danger," the UK NHS already ordering tech leaders to wall off hundreds of open-source GitHub repositories with a May deadline citing Mythos exposure, and the May 1 AISI cyber eval placing GPT-5.5 + Claude Mythos on the 32-step "The Last Ones" corporate-network attack range (each completing it end-to-end in 2-3 of 10 attempts against an AISI-estimated 20 human hours) — together force the White House to issue an executive order naming a structured pre-release vetting process for frontier models above a defined cyber-capability threshold ahead of the H2 2026 GPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5 release cohort. The shape is most likely a working-group EO with disclosure + voluntary-test-protocol scaffolding (mirroring the May 2025 - Jan 2026 NIST AISI-equivalent posture) rather than a hard FDA-style pre-market approval regime; the structural force is that the Mythos Discord-leak incident and the NHS GitHub lockdown have made the absence of a federal pre-release review the politically operative gap. Anthropic Project Glasswing + AISI red.anthropic.com framework is the de-facto template the EO formalises; OpenAI + Google sign on within one filing cycle to avoid being the lone hold-out under the new working-group reporting cadence.
description.ja: 2026年Q3までに、5月4日〜5日のニューヨーク・タイムズ報道—トランプ政権がテック幹部+政府職員からなる連邦ワーキンググループを設置し新規AIモデルのリリース前審査プロセスを設計する大統領令を検討中、Anthropic + Google + OpenAIに先週シニア政権職員がプランを説明、AnthropicのMythos cyberモデル(4月7日発表、テンス・オブ・サウザンズの未公開ゼロデイを発見、27年物のOpenBSDバグも含む)が直接の引き金、AnthropicのCEO Dario Amodeiがcyber「moment of danger」を公に警告、英NHSはすでに数百のオープンソースGitHubリポジトリの遮断を技術リーダーに5月期限で命令(Mythos露出を理由)、5月1日のAISI cyber evalがGPT-5.5 + Claude Mythosを32-step「The Last Ones」企業ネットワーク攻撃レンジに乗せた(各々10回中2-3回をエンドツーエンドで完走、AISI推定の20人時の攻撃チェーンに対して)—がそろって、ホワイトハウスをして、定義されたcyber-capability閾値を超えるフロンティアモデルに対する構造化されたリリース前審査プロセスを命名する大統領令を、H2 2026のGPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5リリース・コホートに先立ち発出させる。形状はワーキンググループ型大統領令+開示+任意テスト・プロトコルの足場(2025年5月〜2026年1月のNIST AISI相当姿勢を踏襲)が最も可能性が高く、FDA型の事前承認規制ではない;構造的力学は、Mythos Discord-leak事件と英NHSのGitHubロックダウンが、連邦リリース前審査の不在を政治的に切迫したギャップに変えたこと。Anthropic Project Glasswing + AISI red.anthropic.comフレームワークがEOが公式化するデファクト・テンプレート;OpenAI + Googleは新たなワーキンググループ報告ケイデンス下で唯一のホールドアウトを避けるため一申請サイクル以内にサインオン。
description.es: Para el Q3 2026 la cobertura del 4-5 de mayo del New York Times indica que la administración Trump está sopesando una orden ejecutiva que crearía un grupo de trabajo federal de ejecutivos tecnológicos + funcionarios gubernamentales para diseñar un proceso de revisión previa al lanzamiento de nuevos modelos de IA — Anthropic, Google y OpenAI fueron informados por altos funcionarios la semana pasada, con el modelo cyber Mythos de Anthropic (anunciado el 7 de abril, identificando decenas de miles de vulnerabilidades zero-day incluyendo un bug de 27 años en OpenBSD) citado como catalizador inmediato, el CEO de Anthropic Dario Amodei enmarcando públicamente un "moment of danger" cyber, el NHS del Reino Unido ya ordenando a líderes tecnológicos aislar cientos de repositorios open-source de GitHub con plazo en mayo citando exposición a Mythos, y la evaluación cyber AISI del 1 de mayo colocando a GPT-5.5 + Claude Mythos en el rango de ataque corporativo de 32 pasos "The Last Ones" (cada uno completándolo end-to-end en 2-3 de 10 intentos contra una cadena de exploits estimada por AISI en 20 horas humanas) — fuerzan en conjunto a la Casa Blanca a emitir una orden ejecutiva nombrando un proceso estructurado de revisión previa al lanzamiento para modelos frontera por encima de un umbral cyber-capability definido antes de la cohorte de lanzamientos H2 2026 GPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5. La forma más probable es una EO de grupo de trabajo con andamiaje de divulgación + protocolo voluntario de pruebas (reflejando la postura equivalente NIST AISI de mayo 2025 - enero 2026), no un régimen de aprobación previa al mercado tipo FDA; la fuerza estructural es que el incidente Discord-leak de Mythos y el cierre NHS GitHub han hecho la ausencia de revisión federal previa al lanzamiento la brecha políticamente operativa. Anthropic Project Glasswing + el marco AISI red.anthropic.com es la plantilla de facto que la EO formaliza; OpenAI + Google se suman dentro de un ciclo de presentación para evitar ser el único holdout bajo la nueva cadencia de reporte del grupo de trabajo.
description.fil: Bago ang Q3 2026, ang ulat ng New York Times noong May 4-5 na pinag-iisipan ng administrasyong Trump ang isang executive order na lumilikha ng federal working group ng tech executives + government officials para magdisenyo ng pre-release vetting process para sa mga bagong AI models — Anthropic, Google, at OpenAI ay binriefing ng senior administration officials nakaraang linggo, na may Anthropic Mythos cyber model (inanunsyo Apr 7, naghahanap ng tens of thousands ng zero-day vulnerabilities kabilang ang isang 27-year-old OpenBSD bug) na binanggit bilang immediate catalyst, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei na pampublikong nag-frame ng cyber "moment of danger," ang UK NHS na nag-utos na sa tech leaders na isara ang daan-daang open-source GitHub repositories na may May deadline na tumutukoy sa Mythos exposure, at ang May 1 AISI cyber eval na naglagay sa GPT-5.5 + Claude Mythos sa 32-step "The Last Ones" corporate-network attack range (bawat isa ay nakapag-complete nito end-to-end sa 2-3 ng 10 attempts laban sa AISI-estimated 20 human hours) — magkakasamang pumipilit sa White House na maglabas ng executive order na nagngangalan ng structured pre-release vetting process para sa frontier models sa itaas ng defined cyber-capability threshold bago ang H2 2026 GPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5 release cohort. Ang shape ay malamang isang working-group EO na may disclosure + voluntary-test-protocol scaffolding (sumasalamin sa May 2025 - Jan 2026 NIST AISI-equivalent posture), hindi isang mahirap na FDA-style pre-market approval regime; ang structural force ay ang Mythos Discord-leak incident at ang NHS GitHub lockdown ay ginawa ang kawalan ng federal pre-release review ang politically operative gap. Ang Anthropic Project Glasswing + AISI red.anthropic.com framework ay ang de-facto template na pino-formalize ng EO; OpenAI + Google ay sasanib sa loob ng isang filing cycle upang maiwasang maging nag-iisang hold-out sa ilalim ng bagong working-group reporting cadence.

plain_language.en: After Anthropic's Mythos model found tens of thousands of software bugs and the UK health service shut down code repositories, the White House is set to publish a rule for vetting AI models before release.
plain_language.ja: AnthropicのMythosモデルがソフトウェアの脆弱性を多数発見し英NHSがコードリポジトリを閉鎖した後、ホワイトハウスはAIモデルのリリース前審査ルールを発出する見込み。
plain_language.es: Después de que el modelo Mythos de Anthropic encontrara decenas de miles de errores de software y el servicio de salud del Reino Unido cerrara repositorios de código, la Casa Blanca publicará una norma para revisar modelos de IA antes de su lanzamiento.
plain_language.fil: Pagkatapos ng Anthropic Mythos model na nakahanap ng tens of thousands ng software bugs at ang UK health service ay nagsara ng code repositories, maglalabas ang White House ng tuntunin para sa pag-vet ng AI models bago ilabas.

By Q3 2026 the EO is expected to formalise a working-group review with disclosure + voluntary-test-protocol scaffolding ahead of the H2 2026 release cohort.

Para Q3 2026 la EO formalizaría un grupo de trabajo con divulgación + protocolo voluntario de pruebas antes de la cohorte H2 2026.

Bago ang Q3 2026, inaasahang i-formalize ng EO ang isang working-group review na may disclosure + voluntary-test-protocol scaffolding bago ang H2 2026 release cohort.

bridges.text: Monday opens the FMRB executive-order interagency-review track with the May 15 S-407 classified threshold briefing witness slate sharpened to include the CISA Director alongside NIST, ODNI, NSA, and Microsoft MSTIC; an eight-group amicus coalition adds ACLU and CDT pressing a State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument plus a 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window.

text_locales.en: Monday opens the FMRB executive-order interagency-review track with the May 15 S-407 classified threshold briefing witness slate sharpened to include the CISA Director alongside NIST, ODNI, NSA, and Microsoft MSTIC; an eight-group amicus coalition adds ACLU and CDT pressing a State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument plus a 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window.
text_locales.ja: 月曜はFMRB大統領令省庁間レビュー・トラックを、CISAディレクターをNIST、ODNI、NSA、Microsoft MSTICと並んで含む先鋭化された5月15日S-407機密閾値ブリーフィング証人スレートで開始;8グループ・アミカス連合はACLUとCDTを追加し、State Farm理由付き決定記録論証プラス60日国防生産法第708条パブリック・コメント・ウィンドウを推進。
text_locales.es: El lunes abre el track de revisión interagencial de orden ejecutiva FMRB con el panel de testigos del briefing clasificado de umbral del 15 de mayo en S-407 afilado para incluir al director de CISA junto a NIST, ODNI, NSA y Microsoft MSTIC; una coalición amicus de ocho grupos añade ACLU y CDT presionando un argumento del registro de decisión razonada State Farm más una ventana de comentarios públicos de 60 días bajo Defense Production Act Section 708.
text_locales.fil: Bumubukas ang Monday ng FMRB executive-order interagency-review track kasama ang May 15 S-407 classified threshold briefing witness slate na hinasa upang isama ang CISA Director kasama ang NIST, ODNI, NSA, at Microsoft MSTIC; isang eight-group amicus coalition ang nagdaragdag sa ACLU at CDT na pinipresyon ang State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument plus isang 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window.

bridges.text: Lawfare's Sunday long-read frames the State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument as the dispositive litigation vector if the executive order ships on the Defense Production Act Section 708 vehicle without notice-and-comment; Just Security argues the May 7-8 EU/UK and Singapore/Japan reciprocity instruments establish a customary-practice baseline; OSTP holds the draft in interagency review, pushing the operative window to late-May or early-June while the Q3 2026 frame still holds.

text_locales.ja: Lawfareの日曜ロング・リードは、大統領令が告示・パブリック・コメントなしに国防生産法第708条ビークルで出荷される場合の決定的訴訟ベクターとしてState Farm理由付き決定記録論証をフレームする;Just SecurityはEU/UKおよびシンガポール/日本5月7-8日相互性文書が慣習慣行ベースラインを確立する、と論じる;OSTPはドラフトを省庁間レビューで維持、作動ウィンドウを5月下旬または6月上旬まで押し出し、Q3 2026フレームは依然保持される。
text_locales.es: El long-read dominical de Lawfare enmarca el argumento del registro de decisión razonada State Farm como el vector de litigación dispositivo si la orden ejecutiva se envía sobre el vehículo Defense Production Act Section 708 sin notice-and-comment; Just Security argumenta que los instrumentos de reciprocidad EU/UK y Singapore/Japan del 7-8 de mayo establecen una base de práctica consuetudinaria; OSTP mantiene el borrador en revisión interagencial, empujando la ventana operativa a finales-de-mayo o principios-de-junio mientras el marco Q3 2026 se mantiene.
text_locales.fil: Ino-frame ng Sunday long-read ng Lawfare ang State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument bilang dispositive litigation vector kung mag-ship ang executive order sa Defense Production Act Section 708 vehicle nang walang notice-and-comment; nag-aargumento ang Just Security na ang Mayo 7-8 EU/UK at Singapore/Japan reciprocity instruments ay nag-eestablish ng customary-practice baseline; hawak ng OSTP ang draft sa interagency review, na itinutulak ang operative window patungo sa late-May o early-June habang hawak pa rin ang Q3 2026 frame.

bridges.text: Knight Institute and EFF join the May 8 civil-society amicus stack demanding a 60-day comment window, while Senators Warner, Young, and now Rosen lock the May 15 classified FMRB threshold briefing with NIST, ODNI, and CISA JCDC attending. OSTP confirms no signing window before May 22 — the political-operativeness condition hardens and the Q3 landing window holds.

text_locales.en: Knight Institute and EFF join the May 8 civil-society amicus stack demanding a 60-day comment window, while Senators Warner, Young, and now Rosen lock the May 15 classified FMRB threshold briefing with NIST, ODNI, and CISA JCDC attending. OSTP confirms no signing window before May 22 — the political-operativeness condition hardens and the Q3 landing window holds.
text_locales.ja: Knight InstituteとEFFが5月8日の市民社会意見書スタックに合流し60日間のコメント期間を要求、Warner、Young、そして今やRosen上院議員が5月15日の機密FMRB閾値ブリーフィングをNIST、ODNI、CISA JCDC出席で固める。OSTPは5月22日以前の署名ウィンドウはないと確認 — 政治的作動性条件が硬化し、Q3着地ウィンドウは保持される。
text_locales.es: Knight Institute y EFF se unen a la pila amicus de la sociedad civil del 8 de mayo exigiendo una ventana de comentarios de 60 días, mientras que los senadores Warner, Young y ahora Rosen bloquean el briefing clasificado de umbral FMRB del 15 de mayo con NIST, ODNI y CISA JCDC asistiendo. OSTP confirma que no hay ventana de firma antes del 22 de mayo — la condición de operatividad política se endurece y la ventana de aterrizaje Q3 se mantiene.
text_locales.fil: Sumasama ang Knight Institute at EFF sa Mayo 8 civil-society amicus stack na humihingi ng 60-day comment window, habang sina Senators Warner, Young, at ngayon ay si Rosen ay nag-lock sa Mayo 15 classified FMRB threshold briefing kasama sina NIST, ODNI, at CISA JCDC. Kinukumpirma ng OSTP na walang signing window bago ang Mayo 22 — tumitigas ang political-operativeness condition at hawak ang Q3 landing window.

bridges.text: AI Policy Institute, R Street, Public Knowledge, and Lawyers for Civil Justice file an open APA-challenge letter to OSTP within 24 hours of the May 7 FMRB EO interagency draft, while Senators Warner and Young request a NIST/ODNI threshold briefing on May 15. The civil-society and Senate pressure layer operationalizes the political-operativeness condition the prediction names.

text_locales.en: AI Policy Institute, R Street, Public Knowledge, and Lawyers for Civil Justice file an open APA-challenge letter to OSTP within 24 hours of the May 7 FMRB EO interagency draft, while Senators Warner and Young request a NIST/ODNI threshold briefing on May 15. The civil-society and Senate pressure layer operationalizes the political-operativeness condition the prediction names.
text_locales.ja: AI Policy Institute、R Street、Public Knowledge、Lawyers for Civil Justiceは、5月7日のFMRB EO省庁間ドラフト回覧から24時間以内にOSTPへAPA異議申立て書簡を共同提出し、Warner議員とYoung議員は5月15日にNIST/ODNIによる閾値ブリーフィングを要請する。市民社会と上院による圧力レイヤーが、予測の挙げる政治的可動性条件を実装する。
text_locales.es: AI Policy Institute, R Street, Public Knowledge y Lawyers for Civil Justice presentan una carta conjunta de impugnacion APA a la OSTP dentro de las 24 horas posteriores al borrador interagencial de la EO FMRB del 7 de mayo, mientras los senadores Warner y Young solicitan un briefing de umbral de NIST/ODNI para el 15 de mayo. La capa de presion de la sociedad civil y el Senado operacionaliza la condicion de operatividad politica que nombra la prediccion.
text_locales.fil: Ang AI Policy Institute, R Street, Public Knowledge, at Lawyers for Civil Justice ay naghain ng pinagsamang APA-challenge letter sa OSTP sa loob ng 24 oras matapos ang May 7 FMRB EO interagency draft, habang sina Senators Warner at Young ay humihiling ng NIST/ODNI threshold briefing sa May 15. Ang pressure layer ng civil society at Senate ay nag-ooperationalize sa political-operativeness condition na pinapangalanan ng prediction.

bridges.text: The May 6-7 interagency draft circulating to OSTP, NSC, NIST, and Commerce — naming the FMRB structure, the DPA §708 vehicle, and the AISI 32-step threshold — converts the EO trail named by the frontier-model pre-release vetting prediction (May 6) from rumor into operational draft. Trans-Atlantic reciprocity and UK CNI freeze define the landing shape.

text_locales.en: The May 6-7 interagency draft circulating to OSTP, NSC, NIST, and Commerce — naming the FMRB structure, the DPA §708 vehicle, and the AISI 32-step threshold — converts the EO trail named by the frontier-model pre-release vetting prediction (May 6) from rumor into operational draft. Trans-Atlantic reciprocity and UK CNI freeze define the landing shape.
text_locales.ja: 5月6-7日にOSTP、NSC、NIST、商務省へ回付された省庁間ドラフトは、FMRB構造、DPA §708ビークル、AISI 32ステップ閾値を明示し、フロンティアモデル事前リリース審査予測(5月6日)が示した大統領令の道筋を噂から運用ドラフトへ転換した。大西洋越え相互主義と英国CNI凍結が着地形状を規定する。
text_locales.es: El borrador interagencial del 6-7 de mayo que circula en OSTP, NSC, NIST y Commerce — que nombra la estructura FMRB, el vehículo DPA §708 y el umbral AISI de 32 pasos — convierte el rastro de la EO nombrado por la predicción de evaluación previa al lanzamiento de modelos frontier (6 de mayo) de rumor en borrador operativo. La reciprocidad transatlántica y el congelamiento de CNI del Reino Unido definen la forma de aterrizaje.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mayo 6-7 interagency draft na nagpa-circulate sa OSTP, NSC, NIST, at Commerce — na nagpapangalan sa FMRB structure, sa DPA §708 vehicle, at sa AISI 32-step threshold — ay nagko-convert sa EO trail na pinapangalanan ng frontier-model pre-release vetting prediction (Mayo 6) mula tsismis tungo sa operational draft. Tinutukoy ng trans-Atlantic reciprocity at UK CNI freeze ang landing shape.

needs.job: co-design a voluntary pre-release vetting pilot with the OSTP working group that maps the AISI 32-step attack-range methodology onto each lab's red-team pipeline and that publishes a summary metric (Expert-tier offensive-cyber score + Last-Ones-class attack-range pass rate) before each H2 2026 model release.
needs.outcome: Joint pilot framework signed by Anthropic + OpenAI + Google with a published summary-metric template, an embedded AISI-equivalent red-team protocol, and a release-cycle reporting cadence aligned to the EO working-group cadence.
needs.motivation: Voluntary co-design of the pilot framework lets the labs shape the threshold metric and reporting cadence; absent a co-designed pilot, the EO working group writes a metric the labs cannot easily satisfy and the release cycle gates on a federal-process bottleneck.

needs.job: draft a bipartisan AI-safety-disclosure bill that codifies the EO working-group framework, gives NIST AISI-equivalent statutory authority over the cyber-capability threshold, and pre-empts the patchwork of state-level AI-disclosure regimes (CA SB 1047 follow-on, NY SHIELD-AI, Texas AI Act drafts) that emerged after the Jan 2025 Trump-EO rescission.
needs.outcome: Bipartisan AI-safety-disclosure bill introduced in both chambers with NIST AISI-equivalent statutory authority, federal-pre-emption language for state-level AI-disclosure regimes, and a defined cyber-capability threshold tied to AISI benchmarks.
needs.motivation: An EO can be rescinded by the next administration; statutory codification + federal pre-emption gives the framework durability and gives the frontier labs a single national reporting target rather than a 50-state patchwork.

detail.description: By Q3 2026 the May 4-5 New York Times reporting that the Trump administration is weighing an executive order creating a federal working group of tech executives + government officials to design a pre-release vetting process for new AI models — Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI briefed by senior administration officials last week, with Anthropic's Mythos cyber model (announced Apr 7, finding tens of thousands of zero-day vulnerabilities including a 27-year-old OpenBSD bug) cited as the immediate catalyst, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly framing a cyber "moment of danger," the UK NHS already ordering tech leaders to wall off hundreds of open-source GitHub repositories with a May deadline citing Mythos exposure, and the May 1 AISI cyber eval placing GPT-5.5 + Claude Mythos on the 32-step "The Last Ones" corporate-network attack range (each completing it end-to-end in 2-3 of 10 attempts against an AISI-estimated 20 human hours) — together force the White House to issue an executive order naming a structured pre-release vetting process for frontier models above a defined cyber-capability threshold ahead of the H2 2026 GPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5 release cohort. The shape is most likely a working-group EO with disclosure + voluntary-test-protocol scaffolding (mirroring the May 2025 - Jan 2026 NIST AISI-equivalent posture) rather than a hard FDA-style pre-market approval regime; the structural force is that the Mythos Discord-leak incident and the NHS GitHub lockdown have made the absence of a federal pre-release review the politically operative gap. Anthropic Project Glasswing + AISI red.anthropic.com framework is the de-facto template the EO formalises; OpenAI + Google sign on within one filing cycle to avoid being the lone hold-out under the new working-group reporting cadence.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2026年Q3までに、5月4日〜5日のニューヨーク・タイムズ報道—トランプ政権がテック幹部+政府職員からなる連邦ワーキンググループを設置し新規AIモデルのリリース前審査プロセスを設計する大統領令を検討中、Anthropic + Google + OpenAIに先週シニア政権職員がプランを説明、AnthropicのMythos cyberモデル(4月7日発表、テンス・オブ・サウザンズの未公開ゼロデイを発見、27年物のOpenBSDバグも含む)が直接の引き金、AnthropicのCEO Dario Amodeiがcyber「moment of danger」を公に警告、英NHSはすでに数百のオープンソースGitHubリポジトリの遮断を技術リーダーに5月期限で命令(Mythos露出を理由)、5月1日のAISI cyber evalがGPT-5.5 + Claude Mythosを32-step「The Last Ones」企業ネットワーク攻撃レンジに乗せた(各々10回中2-3回をエンドツーエンドで完走、AISI推定の20人時の攻撃チェーンに対して)—がそろって、ホワイトハウスをして、定義されたcyber-capability閾値を超えるフロンティアモデルに対する構造化されたリリース前審査プロセスを命名する大統領令を、H2 2026のGPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5リリース・コホートに先立ち発出させる。形状はワーキンググループ型大統領令+開示+任意テスト・プロトコルの足場(2025年5月〜2026年1月のNIST AISI相当姿勢を踏襲)が最も可能性が高く、FDA型の事前承認規制ではない;構造的力学は、Mythos Discord-leak事件と英NHSのGitHubロックダウンが、連邦リリース前審査の不在を政治的に切迫したギャップに変えたこと。Anthropic Project Glasswing + AISI red.anthropic.comフレームワークがEOが公式化するデファクト・テンプレート;OpenAI + Googleは新たなワーキンググループ報告ケイデンス下で唯一のホールドアウトを避けるため一申請サイクル以内にサインオン。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para el Q3 2026 la cobertura del 4-5 de mayo del New York Times indica que la administración Trump está sopesando una orden ejecutiva que crearía un grupo de trabajo federal de ejecutivos tecnológicos + funcionarios gubernamentales para diseñar un proceso de revisión previa al lanzamiento de nuevos modelos de IA — Anthropic, Google y OpenAI fueron informados por altos funcionarios la semana pasada, con el modelo cyber Mythos de Anthropic (anunciado el 7 de abril, identificando decenas de miles de vulnerabilidades zero-day incluyendo un bug de 27 años en OpenBSD) citado como catalizador inmediato, el CEO de Anthropic Dario Amodei enmarcando públicamente un "moment of danger" cyber, el NHS del Reino Unido ya ordenando a líderes tecnológicos aislar cientos de repositorios open-source de GitHub con plazo en mayo citando exposición a Mythos, y la evaluación cyber AISI del 1 de mayo colocando a GPT-5.5 + Claude Mythos en el rango de ataque corporativo de 32 pasos "The Last Ones" (cada uno completándolo end-to-end en 2-3 de 10 intentos contra una cadena de exploits estimada por AISI en 20 horas humanas) — fuerzan en conjunto a la Casa Blanca a emitir una orden ejecutiva nombrando un proceso estructurado de revisión previa al lanzamiento para modelos frontera por encima de un umbral cyber-capability definido antes de la cohorte de lanzamientos H2 2026 GPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5. La forma más probable es una EO de grupo de trabajo con andamiaje de divulgación + protocolo voluntario de pruebas (reflejando la postura equivalente NIST AISI de mayo 2025 - enero 2026), no un régimen de aprobación previa al mercado tipo FDA; la fuerza estructural es que el incidente Discord-leak de Mythos y el cierre NHS GitHub han hecho la ausencia de revisión federal previa al lanzamiento la brecha políticamente operativa. Anthropic Project Glasswing + el marco AISI red.anthropic.com es la plantilla de facto que la EO formaliza; OpenAI + Google se suman dentro de un ciclo de presentación para evitar ser el único holdout bajo la nueva cadencia de reporte del grupo de trabajo.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Bago ang Q3 2026, ang ulat ng New York Times noong May 4-5 na pinag-iisipan ng administrasyong Trump ang isang executive order na lumilikha ng federal working group ng tech executives + government officials para magdisenyo ng pre-release vetting process para sa mga bagong AI models — Anthropic, Google, at OpenAI ay binriefing ng senior administration officials nakaraang linggo, na may Anthropic Mythos cyber model (inanunsyo Apr 7, naghahanap ng tens of thousands ng zero-day vulnerabilities kabilang ang isang 27-year-old OpenBSD bug) na binanggit bilang immediate catalyst, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei na pampublikong nag-frame ng cyber "moment of danger," ang UK NHS na nag-utos na sa tech leaders na isara ang daan-daang open-source GitHub repositories na may May deadline na tumutukoy sa Mythos exposure, at ang May 1 AISI cyber eval na naglagay sa GPT-5.5 + Claude Mythos sa 32-step "The Last Ones" corporate-network attack range (bawat isa ay nakapag-complete nito end-to-end sa 2-3 ng 10 attempts laban sa AISI-estimated 20 human hours) — magkakasamang pumipilit sa White House na maglabas ng executive order na nagngangalan ng structured pre-release vetting process para sa frontier models sa itaas ng defined cyber-capability threshold bago ang H2 2026 GPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5 release cohort. Ang shape ay malamang isang working-group EO na may disclosure + voluntary-test-protocol scaffolding (sumasalamin sa May 2025 - Jan 2026 NIST AISI-equivalent posture), hindi isang mahirap na FDA-style pre-market approval regime; ang structural force ay ang Mythos Discord-leak incident at ang NHS GitHub lockdown ay ginawa ang kawalan ng federal pre-release review ang politically operative gap. Ang Anthropic Project Glasswing + AISI red.anthropic.com framework ay ang de-facto template na pino-formalize ng EO; OpenAI + Google ay sasanib sa loob ng isang filing cycle upang maiwasang maging nag-iisang hold-out sa ilalim ng bagong working-group reporting cadence.

nodes.description: By Q3 2026 the cluster of LLM-workflow-platform CVEs landing in the same window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE via webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare by Cyera Research Labs, patched in 1.121.0, with Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security advisories), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE where a chatflow user coaxes the LLM into emitting attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (first exploited within 12 hours 31 minutes of disclosure per Sysdig honeypot fleet), the Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in March 2026 directly attributable to AI coding tools (with researchers estimating 5-10x undercount across the open-source ecosystem) — combined with the standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + the ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline forces CISA to publish a dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide naming n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms by category and prescribing webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. The forcing function is that the Ni8mare CVSS-10 score on a no-code AI-workflow harness widely deployed in Tier-2 enterprises makes the existing CISA AI guidance (which targeted model providers and large-deployment-tier buyers) too narrow for the operational reality. The guide is most likely a CISA Cybersecurity Advisory or Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts co-sign within one cycle (the AL26-001 joint pattern from CCCS / ASD on n8n is the dispatch-shape precedent).

title.fil: CISA maglalabas ng agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide bago ang Q3 2026

description.en: By Q3 2026 the cluster of LLM-workflow-platform CVEs landing in the same window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE via webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare by Cyera Research Labs, patched in 1.121.0, with Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security advisories), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE where a chatflow user coaxes the LLM into emitting attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (first exploited within 12 hours 31 minutes of disclosure per Sysdig honeypot fleet), the Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in March 2026 directly attributable to AI coding tools (with researchers estimating 5-10x undercount across the open-source ecosystem) — combined with the standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + the ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline forces CISA to publish a dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide naming n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms by category and prescribing webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. The forcing function is that the Ni8mare CVSS-10 score on a no-code AI-workflow harness widely deployed in Tier-2 enterprises makes the existing CISA AI guidance (which targeted model providers and large-deployment-tier buyers) too narrow for the operational reality. The guide is most likely a CISA Cybersecurity Advisory or Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts co-sign within one cycle (the AL26-001 joint pattern from CCCS / ASD on n8n is the dispatch-shape precedent).
description.ja: 2026年Q3までに、同じウィンドウ内で着地したLLMワークフロー・プラットフォームCVEのクラスター—n8n CVE-2026-21858(CVSS 10.0、ウェブフックcontent-type混乱経由の未認証RCE、Cyera Research Labsが「Ni8mare」と命名、1.121.0でパッチ、カナダ・サイバーセキュリティセンター + 豪ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security全てがアドバイザリーを公表)、Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264(プロンプト・インジェクション駆動のRCEで、チャットフロー・ユーザーがLLMに攻撃者制御Pythonを発出させる)、LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF(Sysdigハニーポット艦隊で開示後12時間31分以内に最初のエクスプロイト試行)、Georgia Techの Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in 2026年3月にAIコーディング・ツール直接起因(オープンソース・エコシステム全体で5-10倍の真の数のアンダーカウントと研究者推定)—がSGLang CVE-2026-5760パッチと~7,000のインターネット露出MCPサーバー(約半数が未認証)のベースラインと組み合わさり、CISAをして、n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Difyクラス・プラットフォームをカテゴリーで命名し、ウェブフックcontent-type検証 + プロンプト・インジェクション認識最小権限 + MCP-tool-call audit-trailコントロール・ファミリーを規定する専用エージェンティックAIワークフロー・プラットフォーム・セキュア展開ガイドを発出させる。フォーシング・ファンクションは、Tier-2エンタープライズで広く展開されているノーコードAIワークフロー・ハーネスでのNi8mare CVSS-10スコアが、既存のCISA AIガイダンス(モデル・プロバイダーと大規模展開層バイヤーをターゲット)を運用上の現実に対して狭すぎるものにすること。ガイドはCISA Cybersecurity AdvisoryまたはSecure-by-Design補足が最も可能性高い;FBI + NSA + 国際Five Eyesカウンターパートがn8nに関するCCCS / ASDのAL26-001ジョイント・パターンをディスパッチ形状の前例として、一サイクル以内に共同署名する。
description.es: Para Q3 2026 el cluster de CVEs de plataformas LLM-workflow aterrizando en la misma ventana — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 RCE no autenticado vía confusión content-type en webhook, codenombrado Ni8mare por Cyera Research Labs, parchado en 1.121.0, con avisos de Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (RCE driven por inyección de prompt donde un usuario chatflow induce al LLM a emitir Python controlado por atacante), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (primero explotado dentro de 12 horas 31 minutos de divulgación per flota honeypot Sysdig), el conteo Vibe Security Radar de Georgia Tech de 35 CVEs en marzo 2026 directamente atribuibles a herramientas AI coding (con investigadores estimando subconteo 5-10x a través del ecosistema open-source) — combinado con el parche standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + la baseline de ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet (~mitad sin autenticación) fuerza a CISA a publicar una guía dedicada de despliegue seguro de plataformas de workflow agentic-AI nombrando plataformas clase n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify por categoría y prescribiendo familias de control de validación content-type webhook + least-privilege consciente de inyección de prompts + audit-trail MCP-tool-call. La forcing function es que la puntuación CVSS-10 Ni8mare en un harness no-code de workflow AI ampliamente desplegado en empresas Tier-2 hace la guía CISA AI existente (que apuntaba a model providers y compradores de gran despliegue) demasiado estrecha para la realidad operacional. La guía es muy probablemente un Cybersecurity Advisory CISA o suplemento Secure-by-Design; FBI + NSA + contrapartes internacionales Five Eyes co-firman dentro de un ciclo (el patrón conjunto AL26-001 de CCCS / ASD en n8n es el precedente de forma de despacho).
description.fil: Bago ang Q3 2026 ang cluster ng LLM-workflow-platform CVEs na lumalapag sa parehong window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE sa pamamagitan ng webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare ng Cyera Research Labs, na-patch sa 1.121.0, na may mga advisories mula sa Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE kung saan ang isang chatflow user ay umaakit sa LLM na maglabas ng attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (unang na-exploit sa loob ng 12 hours 31 minutes ng disclosure ayon sa Sysdig honeypot fleet), ang Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count na 35 CVEs noong March 2026 na direkta na maiuugnay sa AI coding tools (na may researchers na nag-eestima ng undercount na 5-10x sa buong open-source ecosystem) — kasama ng standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + ang ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline ay pumipilit sa CISA na maglabas ng dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide na nagngangalan ng n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms ayon sa kategorya at nagre-prescribe ng webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. Ang forcing function ay ang Ni8mare CVSS-10 score sa isang no-code AI-workflow harness na malawakang na-deploy sa Tier-2 enterprises ay ginagawa ang umiiral na CISA AI guidance (na nagta-target ng model providers at large-deployment-tier buyers) na masyadong makitid para sa operational reality. Ang guide ay malamang isang CISA Cybersecurity Advisory o Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts ay co-sign sa loob ng isang cycle (ang AL26-001 joint pattern mula CCCS / ASD sa n8n ay ang dispatch-shape precedent).

plain_language.en: After several no-code AI workflow tools were hit by serious security flaws this month, the US cyber agency is set to publish a deployment guide naming those tools by category.
plain_language.ja: いくつかのノーコードAIワークフロー・ツールがこの月に深刻なセキュリティ欠陥を受けた後、米サイバー機関はそれらのツールをカテゴリー別に命名する展開ガイドを公表する見込み。
plain_language.es: Tras varias herramientas no-code de flujos de trabajo de IA recibir fallos serios de seguridad este mes, la agencia cyber de EE.UU. publicará una guía de despliegue nombrando esas herramientas por categoría.
plain_language.fil: Matapos ang ilang no-code AI workflow tools ay tinamaan ng malubhang security flaws ngayong buwan, ang US cyber agency ay maglalabas ng deployment guide na nagngangalan ng mga tool na iyon ayon sa kategorya.

bridges.text: LangChain CVE-2026-44712 (CVSS 8.7) lands Monday completing the seven-CVE agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader wave Trail of Bits taxonomizes with a signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist-validation common-mitigation proposal; Shadowserver day-eleven n8n exposed instances fall to 4,920 with unpatched share at 33 percent; Censys reports exploitation attempts at 6.4x baseline ahead of the May 21 federal-civilian deadline.

text_locales.en: LangChain CVE-2026-44712 (CVSS 8.7) lands Monday completing the seven-CVE agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader wave Trail of Bits taxonomizes with a signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist-validation common-mitigation proposal; Shadowserver day-eleven n8n exposed instances fall to 4,920 with unpatched share at 33 percent; Censys reports exploitation attempts at 6.4x baseline ahead of the May 21 federal-civilian deadline.
text_locales.ja: LangChain CVE-2026-44712(CVSS 8.7)が月曜に着地し、Trail of Bitsが署名済みチェックポイント・プラス・マニフェスト許可リスト検証共通緩和提案で分類学化する7-CVEエージェント・チェックポイント・アンド・マニフェスト・ローダー波を完結;Shadowserverの11日目n8n曝露インスタンスは4,920に下落し未パッチ・シェアは33パーセント;Censysは5月21日連邦民間期限を控えベースライン6.4倍の悪用試行を報告。
text_locales.es: LangChain CVE-2026-44712 (CVSS 8.7) aterriza el lunes completando la ola de siete CVE de agent-checkpoint-y-manifest-loader que Trail of Bits taxonomiza con una propuesta de mitigación común signed-checkpoint más manifest-allowlist-validation; las instancias expuestas de n8n del día once de Shadowserver caen a 4,920 con la cuota sin parche en 33 por ciento; Censys reporta intentos de explotación en 6.4x baseline antes de la fecha límite federal-civil del 21 de mayo.
text_locales.fil: Lumalapag ang LangChain CVE-2026-44712 (CVSS 8.7) ngayong Monday na tinatapos ang seven-CVE agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader wave na nag-ta-taxonomize ng Trail of Bits sa isang signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist-validation common-mitigation proposal; bumababa ang Shadowserver day-eleven n8n exposed instances sa 4,920 na may unpatched share sa 33 percent; iniuulat ng Censys ang exploitation attempts sa 6.4x baseline bago ang May 21 federal-civilian deadline.

bridges.text: Sunday compounds the agentic-platform CVE wave that anchors the prediction: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 checkpoint deserialization) and Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 plugin-manifest SSRF) extend the Microsoft agent stack; Trail of Bits names a shared checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; Shadowserver day-ten drops exposed n8n to ~5,700; CISA refreshes KEV ahead of the May 21 deadline.

text_locales.en: Sunday compounds the agentic-platform CVE wave that anchors the prediction: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 checkpoint deserialization) and Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 plugin-manifest SSRF) extend the Microsoft agent stack; Trail of Bits names a shared checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; Shadowserver day-ten drops exposed n8n to ~5,700; CISA refreshes KEV ahead of the May 21 deadline.
text_locales.ja: 日曜は予測をアンカーするエージェンティック・プラットフォームCVEの波を複合化させる: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612(CVSS 8.9 チェックポイント・デシリアライゼーション)とSemantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638(CVSS 8.4 プラグイン・マニフェストSSRF)がMicrosoftエージェント・スタックを拡張する;Trail of Bitsは共有チェックポイント・アンド・マニフェスト・ローダー曝露パターンを命名する;Shadowserverの10日目は曝露n8nを~5,700へ低下させる;CISAは5月21日期限に先立ってKEVをリフレッシュする。
text_locales.es: El domingo compone la ola de CVE de plataforma agéntica que ancla la predicción: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 deserialización de checkpoint) y Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 SSRF de plugin-manifest) extienden el stack de agente Microsoft; Trail of Bits nombra un patrón compartido de exposición checkpoint-y-manifest-loader; el día diez de Shadowserver baja n8n expuesto a ~5,700; CISA refresca KEV antes de la fecha límite del 21 de mayo.
text_locales.fil: Nagdadagdag ang Linggo sa agentic-platform CVE wave na nag-aanchor sa prediksyon: pinapalawig ng AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 checkpoint deserialization) at Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 plugin-manifest SSRF) ang Microsoft agent stack; pinapangalanan ng Trail of Bits ang shared checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; bumababa ang Shadowserver day-ten exposed n8n sa ~5,700; nire-refresh ng CISA ang KEV bago ang Mayo 21 deadline.

bridges.text: Shadowserver day-nine n8n exposed instances drop to ~6,800 (44% unpatched) ahead of the CISA May 21 federal-civilian deadline; NHS England's five-CVE blocklist now functions as the de-facto allied reference, and Sysdig's 19-minute median time-to-credential-extraction puts a measurable cost on absent secure-deployment guidance — the exact predicate set a CISA guide would consolidate.

text_locales.ja: Shadowserverの9日目n8n曝露インスタンスはCISAの5月21日連邦民間期限に先立ち~6,800まで低下(44%未パッチ);NHS Englandの5-CVEブロックリストは今や事実上の同盟参照として機能し、Sysdigの19分中央認証情報抽出時間は安全デプロイメント・ガイダンス不在に測定可能なコストを置く — CISAガイドが統合する正にプレディケート・セット。
text_locales.es: Las instancias n8n expuestas del día nueve de Shadowserver caen a ~6,800 (44% sin parchar) antes de la fecha límite federal-civil del 21 de mayo de CISA; la blocklist de cinco CVE de NHS England ahora funciona como la referencia aliada de facto, y el tiempo mediano de 19 minutos a extracción de credenciales de Sysdig pone un costo medible sobre la guía ausente de despliegue seguro — el set predicado exacto que una guía de CISA consolidaría.
text_locales.fil: Bumababa ang day-nine n8n exposed instances ng Shadowserver sa ~6,800 (44% unpatched) bago ang CISA Mayo 21 federal-civilian deadline; gumagana na ngayon ang five-CVE blocklist ng NHS England bilang de-facto allied reference, at inilalagay ng 19-minute median time-to-credential-extraction ng Sysdig ang measurable cost sa absent secure-deployment guidance — ang eksaktong predicate set na ico-consolidate ng CISA guide.

bridges.text: Day-eight n8n KEV scans drop exposed pre-1.121.0 instances 41.5% with a 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike on REST webhooks, while CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserialization RCE) and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal pivoting to AWS metadata) land 24 hours after LangGraph plus LiteLLM. NHS England names Ni8mare on its agentic-AI workflow blocklist, hardening the no-code harness forcing function.

text_locales.en: Day-eight n8n KEV scans drop exposed pre-1.121.0 instances 41.5% with a 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike on REST webhooks, while CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserialization RCE) and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal pivoting to AWS metadata) land 24 hours after LangGraph plus LiteLLM. NHS England names Ni8mare on its agentic-AI workflow blocklist, hardening the no-code harness forcing function.
text_locales.ja: 8日目のn8n KEVスキャンは、公開済みpre-1.121.0インスタンスを41.5%減少させ、REST webhookで4.8倍の悪用試行スパイクを記録する。CrewAI CVE-2026-44352(CVSS 8.7のデシリアライゼーションRCE)とHaystack CVE-2026-44391(CVSS 9.4のpath-traversalでAWSメタデータへピボット)は、LangGraphとLiteLLMの24時間後に着地する。NHS EnglandはNi8mareをそのagentic-AIワークフローブロックリストに名指しし、ノーコードハーネスのforcing functionを硬化させる。
text_locales.es: Los escaneos del dia ocho de la KEV de n8n reducen las instancias pre-1.121.0 expuestas en 41.5% con un spike de 4.8x en intentos de explotacion en REST webhooks, mientras que CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserializacion RCE) y Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal pivotando a AWS metadata) aterrizan 24 horas despues de LangGraph mas LiteLLM. NHS England nombra a Ni8mare en su blocklist de workflow agentic-AI, endureciendo el forcing function del no-code harness.
text_locales.fil: Ibinaba ng day-eight n8n KEV scans ang exposed pre-1.121.0 instances ng 41.5% na may 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike sa REST webhooks, habang ang CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserialization RCE) at Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal na pumapivot sa AWS metadata) ay lumalapag 24 oras matapos ang LangGraph plus LiteLLM. Pinapangalanan ng NHS England si Ni8mare sa kanilang agentic-AI workflow blocklist, pinatitigas ang no-code harness forcing function.

bridges.text: The n8n KEV addition with a May 21 federal deadline (first agentic-workflow CVE in the catalog), concurrent LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass with sub-18-hour exploitation, ~14,200 internet-exposed instances 62% unpatched, and Microsoft Defender MCP-server detection GA crystallize exactly the operational case the CISA secure-deployment guide prediction (May 6) names — multi-vendor weekly cadence has displaced monthly.

text_locales.en: The n8n KEV addition with a May 21 federal deadline (first agentic-workflow CVE in the catalog), concurrent LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass with sub-18-hour exploitation, ~14,200 internet-exposed instances 62% unpatched, and Microsoft Defender MCP-server detection GA crystallize exactly the operational case the CISA secure-deployment guide prediction (May 6) names — multi-vendor weekly cadence has displaced monthly.
text_locales.ja: n8nのKEV追加(カタログ初のエージェント型ワークフローCVE、5月21日連邦期限)、同時並行のLangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM認証バイパスで18時間未満のエクスプロイト発生、インターネット露出インスタンス約14,200(62%未パッチ)、Microsoft Defender MCPサーバー検出GAが、CISAセキュア配備ガイド予測(5月6日)が指す運用面の根拠を結晶化させた──マルチベンダー週次ケイデンスが月次を置き換えた。
text_locales.es: La adición de n8n al KEV con plazo federal del 21 de mayo (primer CVE de flujo de trabajo agéntico en el catálogo), el SSRF concurrente de LangGraph + bypass de autenticación de LiteLLM con explotación en menos de 18 horas, ~14.200 instancias expuestas a internet con 62% sin parchar, y la GA de detección de servidor MCP de Microsoft Defender cristalizan exactamente el caso operativo que la predicción de la guía de despliegue seguro de CISA (6 de mayo) nombra — la cadencia semanal multi-proveedor ha desplazado a la mensual.
text_locales.fil: Ang n8n KEV addition na may Mayo 21 federal deadline (unang agentic-workflow CVE sa catalog), ang concurrent LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass na may sub-18-hour exploitation, ~14,200 internet-exposed instances na 62% unpatched, at ang Microsoft Defender MCP-server detection GA ay nagsa-crystallize ng eksaktong operational case na pinapangalanan ng CISA secure-deployment guide prediction (Mayo 6) — pinalitan na ng multi-vendor weekly cadence ang monthly.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: By Q3 2026 the cluster of LLM-workflow-platform CVEs landing in the same window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE via webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare by Cyera Research Labs, patched in 1.121.0, with Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security advisories), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE where a chatflow user coaxes the LLM into emitting attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (first exploited within 12 hours 31 minutes of disclosure per Sysdig honeypot fleet), the Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in March 2026 directly attributable to AI coding tools (with researchers estimating 5-10x undercount across the open-source ecosystem) — combined with the standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + the ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline forces CISA to publish a dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide naming n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms by category and prescribing webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. The forcing function is that the Ni8mare CVSS-10 score on a no-code AI-workflow harness widely deployed in Tier-2 enterprises makes the existing CISA AI guidance (which targeted model providers and large-deployment-tier buyers) too narrow for the operational reality. The guide is most likely a CISA Cybersecurity Advisory or Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts co-sign within one cycle (the AL26-001 joint pattern from CCCS / ASD on n8n is the dispatch-shape precedent).
