prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q3 2026 la ola de CVEs de plataforma de workflow agentic-AI convergiendo a través de la ventana del 8 al 11 de mayo fuerza a CISA a publicar una Binding Operational Directive que trate el estatus de remediación por-CVE y los logs de atestación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant como requisitos emparejados de adquisición y operación de federal-civil-executive-branch, con la cadencia operativa de revisión fijada a la fecha límite de remediación federal-civil del n8n CVE-2026-21858 del 21 de mayo. Los catalizadores que aterrizan en un solo ciclo de noticias son concretos y mutuamente reforzantes: la ruta de ejecución-de-código-remoto de deserialización de checkpoint de AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 más la falsificación de petición server-side autenticada de plugin-manifest a endpoints internos de cloud-metadata de Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 extienden el cluster de CVEs del 8 de mayo de CrewAI más Haystack y el anterior de LangGraph más LiteLLM a través de todo el stack de agentes open-source de Microsoft dentro de un fin de semana, con Trail of Bits catalogando el patrón de exposición compartido de cargador de agent-checkpoint-y-manifest; la nota del catálogo KEV de la edición del domingo de CISA recuerda expresamente a las agencias del federal-civilian-executive-branch la fecha límite de remediación del n8n del 21 de mayo mientras la ola de CVEs agentic-AI se acumula encima; el director del Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center más el director de la NSA Cybersecurity Directorate sumándose al briefing clasificado de umbral S-407 del 15 de mayo del Frontier Model Review Board lleva la vista operativa de la exposición de capacidad clase Mythos en tenants empresariales directamente a la conversación de revisión interagencial de la orden ejecutiva; la matriz de interop de registro de tres hyperscalers del domingo (pull-forward FedRAMP-Moderate de preview público de AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center agregando interop con el registro de habilidades sandboxed de Anthropic Claude Code 3.0, y el Microsoft Azure AI Foundry Skill Catalog reflejando los campos de atestación-de-reciprocidad de eval cyber South Korea PIPC más New Zealand GCSB en el esquema de política-de-tenant junto con la integración Singapore IMDA más Japan AISI del 8 de mayo) demuestra que la plomería de cumplimiento cross-vendor ya existe a través de las seis jurisdicciones de la cohorte de reciprocidad Indo-Pacífica; la prueba de libertad-de-fuga del arxiv 2605.05933 del 9 de mayo para atestación-de-capacidad por tenant más el teorema de seguridad composicional multi-tenant del arxiv 2605.06012 del 10 de mayo le dan a los redactores de la directiva un ancla citable de verificación-formal; y la lista de bloqueo de CVE de plataforma de workflow agentic-AI de NHS England (Ni8mare más LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 más LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 más CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 más Haystack CVE-2026-44391, ahora con AutoGen y Semantic Kernel como adiciones obvias) ya demuestra la forma publicable de lista-de-bloqueo por-CVE que un régimen de adquisición público-sector aliado puede emparejar con el requisito de evidencia de log-de-atestación. La fuerza estructural es que la fecha límite de remediación federal-civil del 21 de mayo llega antes de la ventana más temprana de firma de la EO del FMRB del 22 de mayo, dejando a CISA como el vehículo operativo de aplicación federal-civil-executive-branch mientras el régimen de política está aún en revisión interagencial; la agencia no puede dejar que el patrón de divulgación AutoGen más Semantic Kernel se asiente como una coincidencia después de publicar cuatro adiciones previas de KEV de plataforma-agentic en tres semanas. La forma más probable es una Binding Operational Directive abarcando plataformas de workflow agentic-AI (nombradas explícitamente para incluir n8n, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel) con un requisito emparejado: estatus de remediación por-CVE más evidencia de log de atestación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant (la primitiva Anthropic Project Glasswing más el marco de verificación-formal de los papers arxiv 2605.05933 más 2605.06012 como la evidencia de cumplimiento citada) en una propiedad federal-civil, con la cadencia de revisión alineada con la fecha límite del 21 de mayo del n8n CVE-2026-21858. Los tenants sovereign-cloud y FedRAMP-Moderate cumplen primero porque la matriz de interop de preview público de AWS Bedrock más Google Cloud Vertex ya expone el campo de log-de-atestación. El caso bajista es que la orden ejecutiva del FMRB se envíe primero con el alcance de workflow agentic-AI preempted; en ausencia de eso, Q3 2026 aterriza la directiva a través del perímetro federal-civil-executive-branch.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Sa Q3 2026 ang agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE wave na nagko-converge sa buong May 8 hanggang May 11 window ay pumipilit sa CISA na maglathala ng Binding Operational Directive na tumatrato sa per-CVE remediation status at per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation logs bilang paired federal-civilian-executive-branch procurement at operating requirements, kasama ng operative review cadence na nakatali sa May 21 n8n CVE-2026-21858 federal-civilian remediation deadline. Ang mga catalysts na lumapag sa isang news cycle ay konkreto at mutually reinforcing: ang AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 checkpoint-deserialization remote-code-execution path plus ang Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 plugin-manifest authenticated server-side request forgery sa internal cloud-metadata endpoints ay nagpapalawak sa May 8 CrewAI plus Haystack at sa naunang LangGraph plus LiteLLM CVE cluster sa buong Microsoft open-source agent stack sa loob ng isang weekend, kasama ng Trail of Bits na nagka-catalog sa shared agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; ang Sunday-edition KEV catalog note ng CISA ay hayagang nagpapaalala sa federal-civilian-executive-branch agencies tungkol sa May 21 n8n remediation deadline habang nag-co-compound ang agentic-AI CVE wave; ang pagdalo ng Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center director plus ng NSA Cybersecurity Directorate director sa May 15 S-407 classified Frontier Model Review Board threshold briefing ay nagdadala ng operational view ng Mythos-class capability exposure sa enterprise tenants direkta papasok sa executive-order interagency-review conversation; ang Sunday three-hyperscaler registry interop matrix (AWS Bedrock public-preview FedRAMP-Moderate pull-forward, Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center na nagdaragdag ng Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry interop, at Microsoft Azure AI Foundry Skill Catalog na sumasalamin sa South Korea PIPC plus New Zealand GCSB cyber-eval reciprocity attestation fields sa tenant-policy schema kasama ng May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI integration) ay nagpapakita na ang cross-vendor compliance plumbing ay umiiral na sa lahat ng anim na Indo-Pacific reciprocity-cohort jurisdictions; ang May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof para sa per-tenant capability attestation plus ang May 10 arxiv 2605.06012 multi-tenant compositional safety theorem ay nagbibigay sa directive drafters ng citable formal-verification anchor; at ang NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist (Ni8mare plus LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 plus LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 plus CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 plus Haystack CVE-2026-44391, kasama na ngayon ang AutoGen at Semantic Kernel bilang obvious additions) ay nagpapakita na ng publishable per-CVE blocklist shape na maaaring ipares ng allied public-sector procurement regime sa attestation-log evidence requirement. Ang structural force ay na ang May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline ay dumarating bago ang May 22 earliest FMRB executive-order signing window, na nag-iiwan sa CISA bilang operative federal-civilian-executive-branch enforcement vehicle habang ang policy regime ay nasa interagency review pa rin; ang agency ay hindi pwedeng hayaang manatili lamang ang AutoGen plus Semantic Kernel disclosure pattern bilang coincidence matapos maglathala ng apat na naunang agentic-platform KEV additions sa tatlong linggo. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang Binding Operational Directive na sumasaklaw sa agentic-AI workflow platforms (hayagang pinangalanan upang isama ang n8n, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel) kasama ng paired requirement: per-CVE remediation status plus per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation log evidence (ang Anthropic Project Glasswing primitive plus ang formal-verification framework mula sa arxiv 2605.05933 plus 2605.06012 papers bilang cited compliance evidence) sa federal-civilian estate, kasama ng review cadence na naka-align sa n8n CVE-2026-21858 May 21 deadline. Ang sovereign-cloud at FedRAMP-Moderate tenants ang unang sumusunod dahil ang AWS Bedrock plus Google Cloud Vertex public-preview interop matrix ay naglalantad na ng attestation-log field. Ang bear case ay na ang FMRB executive order ay nag-ship muna kasama ang agentic-AI workflow scope na pre-empted; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q3 2026 sa directive sa buong federal-civilian-executive-branch perimeter.

plain_language.es: Los modelos más grandes están pasando detrás de muros de pago mientras los más pequeños y abiertos siguen siendo gratis, así que la gente usará modelos locales para tareas cotidianas y la nube para las más difíciles.
plain_language.fil: Ang pinakamalalaking models ay pumupunta sa likod ng paywalls habang ang mas maliliit na open ones ay nananatiling libre, kaya gagamitin ng mga tao ang local models para sa pang-araw-araw na tasks at cloud para sa pinakamahihirap.

title_locales.en: Closed-weight frontier crystallizes as open weights cap at 35B-A3B by Q3 2026
title_locales.ja: クローズドウェイトのフロンティアが結晶化、2026年Q3までにオープンウェイトは35B-A3Bで頭打ちに
title_locales.es: La frontera de pesos cerrados se cristaliza mientras los pesos abiertos se topan con un techo de 35B-A3B para Q3 2026
title_locales.fil: Sumusulpot ang closed-weight frontier habang nakakulong ang open weights sa 35B-A3B pagsapit ng Q3 2026

detail.summary_short: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview's API-only pivot and Anthropic's gating of Mythos Preview together mark Q3 2026 as the point where the strongest models are uniformly closed weights. Open-weight releases concentrate on the 35B-A3B, Bonsai, and Llama production tiers, formalizing a split between local utility models and cloud frontier models.

summary_short_locales.en: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview's API-only pivot and Anthropic's gating of Mythos Preview together mark Q3 2026 as the point where the strongest models are uniformly closed weights. Open-weight releases concentrate on the 35B-A3B, Bonsai, and Llama production tiers, formalizing a split between local utility models and cloud frontier models.
summary_short_locales.ja: Qwen3.6-Max-PreviewのAPIのみへの転換と、AnthropicによるMythos Previewのゲーティングが揃って、2026年Q3を「最強モデルが一様にクローズドウェイト」となる転換点として位置づける。オープンウェイトのリリースは35B-A3B、Bonsai、Llamaの本番層に集約され、ローカル実用モデルとクラウドフロンティアモデルとの分離が定式化される。
summary_short_locales.es: El giro a solo API de Qwen3.6-Max-Preview y la restricción por Anthropic de Mythos Preview marcan juntos el Q3 2026 como el punto en que los modelos más fuertes son uniformemente de pesos cerrados. Los lanzamientos de pesos abiertos se concentran en los niveles de producción 35B-A3B, Bonsai y Llama, formalizando una división entre modelos locales de utilidad y modelos de frontera en la nube.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang API-only pivot ng Qwen3.6-Max-Preview at ang gating ng Anthropic sa Mythos Preview ay magkasamang nagmamarka sa Q3 2026 bilang punto kung saan ang pinakamalakas na models ay uniformly closed weights. Ang open-weight releases ay nakakonsentra sa 35B-A3B, Bonsai, at Llama production tiers, na nag-formalize ng split sa pagitan ng local utility models at cloud frontier models.

bridges.text: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview's API-only stance plus Mythos gating against DeepSeek V4's open-weight price aggression keep the geopolitical-split structure intact: the Western flagships keep tightening proprietary access while the Chinese open tier widens.

text_locales.en: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview's API-only stance plus Mythos gating against DeepSeek V4's open-weight price aggression keep the geopolitical-split structure intact: the Western flagships keep tightening proprietary access while the Chinese open tier widens.
text_locales.ja: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview の API 限定スタンスと Mythos のゲーティングが、DeepSeek V4 のオープンウェイト価格攻勢に対して維持されることで、地政学的分断構造はそのまま保たれる — 西側のフラッグシップは独自アクセスをさらに引き締め、中国のオープン階層は広がっていく。
text_locales.es: La postura solo-API de Qwen3.6-Max-Preview más el cierre de Mythos contra la agresión de precio open-weight de DeepSeek V4 mantienen intacta la estructura de división geopolítica: los buques insignia occidentales siguen ajustando el acceso propietario mientras el tier abierto chino se ensancha.
text_locales.fil: Ang API-only stance ng Qwen3.6-Max-Preview kasama ang Mythos gating laban sa open-weight price aggression ng DeepSeek V4 ay pinapanatili ang geopolitical-split structure: patuloy na hinihigpitan ng Western flagships ang proprietary access habang lumalawak ang Chinese open tier.

bridges.text: DeepSeek V4 staying open-weights and price-aggressive while practitioner consensus calls it near-frontier reinforces the geopolitical-split structure: Chinese labs are widening the open-tier corridor while Western flagships keep tightening proprietary access.

text_locales.en: DeepSeek V4 staying open-weights and price-aggressive while practitioner consensus calls it near-frontier reinforces the geopolitical-split structure: Chinese labs are widening the open-tier corridor while Western flagships keep tightening proprietary access.
text_locales.ja: DeepSeek V4 がオープンウェイトと攻撃的な価格設定を維持しつつ、実務者コンセンサスがそれをほぼフロンティア級と評している点は、地政学的分断の構造を補強している: 中国系ラボがオープン階層の回廊を広げている一方で、西側のフラッグシップは独自アクセスを締め続けている。
text_locales.es: DeepSeek V4 manteniéndose con pesos abiertos y precios agresivos mientras el consenso de los profesionales lo llama casi-frontier refuerza la estructura de división geopolítica: los laboratorios chinos están ampliando el corredor de nivel abierto mientras los buques insignia occidentales siguen apretando el acceso propietario.
text_locales.fil: Ang DeepSeek V4 na nananatiling open-weights at price-aggressive habang tinatawag ito ng practitioner consensus na near-frontier ay nagpapatibay sa geopolitical-split structure: pinapalawak ng Chinese labs ang open-tier corridor habang ang Western flagships ay patuloy na hinihigpitan ang proprietary access.

text_locales.es: El desglose de precios GPT-5.5 de Apidog fijando el nivel de pago solo-API a 2x GPT-5.4 con GPT-5.5 Pro a $30 / $180 por M tokens y la cobertura de DeepSeek V4-Pro de gHacks a ~7x más barato que Opus 4.7 con ajuste para Huawei Ascend según la pieza de Bloomberg-CCTV del 26 de abril materializan ambas mitades de la división estructural en la misma ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apidog's GPT-5.5 pricing breakdown na nagla-lock sa API-only paid tier sa 2x GPT-5.4 na may GPT-5.5 Pro sa $30 / $180 per M tokens at ang gHacks' DeepSeek V4-Pro coverage sa ~7x mas mura kaysa Opus 4.7 na may Huawei Ascend tuning ayon sa Apr 26 Bloomberg-CCTV piece ay nagma-materialize sa parehong halves ng structural split sa parehong window.

bridges.text: Apidog's GPT-5.5 pricing breakdown locking the API-only paid tier at 2x GPT-5.4 with GPT-5.5 Pro at $30 / $180 per M tokens, alongside Xinhua framing DeepSeek V4 as matching the best open-source options, materializes both halves of the structural split — proprietary frontier paid-tier and open-weight production tier consolidating in the Chinese-lab line — in the same window.

text_locales.es: El desglose de precios de GPT-5.5 de Apidog bloqueando el nivel pago solo-API a 2x GPT-5.4 con GPT-5.5 Pro a $30 / $180 por M tokens, junto con Xinhua enmarcando a DeepSeek V4 como igualando las mejores opciones de código abierto, materializa ambas mitades de la división estructural — frontera propietaria de nivel pago y nivel de producción de pesos abiertos consolidándose en la línea del laboratorio chino — en la misma ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang GPT-5.5 pricing breakdown ng Apidog na nagla-lock sa API-only paid tier sa 2x GPT-5.4 na may GPT-5.5 Pro sa $30 / $180 per M tokens, kasama ang Xinhua na nag-frame sa DeepSeek V4 bilang katumbas ng pinakamahusay na open-source options, ay nagpapamateryalisa sa dalawang halves ng structural split — proprietary frontier paid-tier at open-weight production tier na nagkokonsolida sa Chinese-lab line — sa parehong window.

bridges.text: DeepSeek V4 + Tencent Hunyuan Hy3 Preview landing as open weights inside the same week with a self-rated 3-6-month gap to the proprietary frontier, alongside GPT-5.5's API-only paid-tier launch and Mythos's staged gating, fits both halves of the structural split — closed weights for the frontier / staged tier, open weights consolidating in Chinese-lab production tier — strengthening the structural force.

text_locales.en: DeepSeek V4 + Tencent Hunyuan Hy3 Preview landing as open weights inside the same week with a self-rated 3-6-month gap to the proprietary frontier, alongside GPT-5.5's API-only paid-tier launch and Mythos's staged gating, fits both halves of the structural split — closed weights for the frontier / staged tier, open weights consolidating in Chinese-lab production tier — strengthening the structural force.

text_locales.es: DeepSeek V4 + Tencent Hunyuan Hy3 Preview aterrizando como pesos abiertos dentro de la misma semana con una brecha autoclasificada de 3-6 meses respecto a la frontera propietaria, junto con el lanzamiento solo-API de nivel pago de GPT-5.5 y el staged gating de Mythos, encaja con ambas mitades de la división estructural — pesos cerrados para la frontera / nivel staged, pesos abiertos consolidándose en el nivel de producción de laboratorios chinos — fortaleciendo la fuerza estructural.
text_locales.fil: Ang DeepSeek V4 + Tencent Hunyuan Hy3 Preview na bumabagsak bilang open weights sa loob ng parehong linggo na may self-rated 3-6-month gap sa proprietary frontier, kasama ng API-only paid-tier launch ng GPT-5.5 at staged gating ng Mythos, ay tumutugma sa parehong halves ng structural split — closed weights para sa frontier / staged tier, open weights na nagsasama-sama sa Chinese-lab production tier — pinatatatag ang structural force.

bridges.text: Mythos Preview's continued staged-gated third-party-only access pattern alongside Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0 reaching Claude Opus 4.5 / 4.6-class coding directly fits both halves of the structural split — closed weights for the frontier / staged tier, open weights consolidating at the 27-35B Dense production tier — strengthening the prediction's underlying force.

text_locales.en: Mythos Preview's continued staged-gated third-party-only access pattern alongside Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0 reaching Claude Opus 4.5 / 4.6-class coding directly fits both halves of the structural split — closed weights for the frontier / staged tier, open weights consolidating at the 27-35B Dense production tier — strengthening the prediction's underlying force.
text_locales.ja: Mythos Previewの継続的なステージドゲートのサードパーティ専用アクセスパターンと、Claude Opus 4.5 / 4.6級のコーディングに到達したQwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0は、構造的分裂の両半分にちょうど合致している ― フロンティア / ステージドティア向けにクローズドウェイト、27-35B Denseの本番ティアに統合されるオープンウェイト ― 予測の根本的な力を強化している。
text_locales.es: El patrón continuo de acceso solo de terceros con staged-gated de Mythos Preview junto con Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0 alcanzando codificación de clase Claude Opus 4.5 / 4.6 encaja directamente con ambas mitades de la división estructural — pesos cerrados para el nivel de frontera / staged, pesos abiertos consolidándose en el nivel de producción 27-35B Dense — fortaleciendo la fuerza subyacente de la predicción.
text_locales.fil: Ang patuloy na staged-gated third-party-only access pattern ng Mythos Preview kasama ang Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0 na umaabot sa Claude Opus 4.5 / 4.6-class coding ay tahasang umaakma sa dalawang halves ng structural split — closed weights para sa frontier / staged tier, open weights na nagsasama-sama sa 27-35B Dense production tier — na nagpapalakas sa underlying force ng prediction.

bridges.text: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview's hosted-only stance with statistically significant agentic-coding deltas plus AISI's Mythos Preview evaluation under Project Glasswing partner-only access (AWS / Apple / Google / JPMC / Microsoft / NVIDIA) directly extend the precondition that frontier labs gate top-tier models behind staged closed access while open-weight cadence stays at the 35B-A3B class.

text_locales.en: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview's hosted-only stance with statistically significant agentic-coding deltas plus AISI's Mythos Preview evaluation under Project Glasswing partner-only access (AWS / Apple / Google / JPMC / Microsoft / NVIDIA) directly extend the precondition that frontier labs gate top-tier models behind staged closed access while open-weight cadence stays at the 35B-A3B class.
text_locales.ja: Qwen3.6-Max-Previewのホスト限定姿勢と統計的に有意なエージェント型コーディングのデルタ、加えてProject Glasswingパートナー限定アクセス(AWS / Apple / Google / JPMC / Microsoft / NVIDIA)下でのAISIによるMythos Preview評価は、フロンティアラボがトップ層モデルを段階的なクローズドアクセスでゲーティングし、オープンウェイトのリリースペースを35B-A3Bクラスにとどめるという前提を直接延伸している。
text_locales.es: La postura solo-hospedada de Qwen3.6-Max-Preview con deltas estadisticamente significativos de codificacion agentica mas la evaluacion AISI del Mythos Preview bajo acceso solo-de-socios de Project Glasswing (AWS / Apple / Google / JPMC / Microsoft / NVIDIA) extienden directamente la precondicion de que los laboratorios frontera bloquean modelos de nivel superior detras de acceso cerrado por etapas mientras la cadencia open-weight permanece en la clase 35B-A3B.
text_locales.fil: Ang hosted-only stance ng Qwen3.6-Max-Preview na may statistically significant agentic-coding deltas kasama ng Mythos Preview evaluation ng AISI sa ilalim ng Project Glasswing partner-only access (AWS / Apple / Google / JPMC / Microsoft / NVIDIA) ay direktang nag-eextend sa precondition na ang frontier labs ay nag-gate ng top-tier models sa likod ng staged closed access habang ang open-weight cadence ay nananatili sa 35B-A3B class.

nodes.title: Open-weight 1M-context era arrives as the new floor by Q3 2026
nodes.description: **The "1M context as default" open-weight era arrives in full by Q3 2026.** DeepSeek V4's "1M context designed in, not bolted on," Qwen3.6-27B's 262K → 1M extension, Claude Opus 4.7's 1M context (Bedrock), and GPT-5.5's long-context strengthening all point the same direction. By Q3 2026, "native 1M context" becomes the floor for open weights, and existing 32K-128K models drop to legacy. RAG pipelines flip from "search → context-insert" to "dump everything in + dynamic prune," and vector DB vendors are pushed to redefine themselves as "long-context cache optimization layers." Señal fuerte a través de múltiples patas de la tesis.

Ang shared asymmetric KV-pool ng PolyKV kasama ang native 1M context ng DeepSeek V4 ay pumupuno sa long-context-cache replacement architecture. Matibay na signal sa maraming legs ng thesis.

text_locales.ja: DeepSeek V4が1Mコンテキストを設計上の特性として出荷し、Corpus2Skillが階層的スキル・ツリー・ナビゲーションがサーブ時に埋め込みインデックスなしでWixQA上で密検索とagentic RAGを上回ることを実証し、PolyKVが共有マルチエージェントKVキャッシュ・プールを提案する。これらが組み合わさり、予測が投影する結果を物質化する: パイプラインがsearch-then-insertからdump-and-pruneに反転し、ベクトルDBはロングコンテキスト・キャッシュ層に押し進められる。

bridges.text: TechXplore's Hybrid Attention writeup pinning long-context inference cost at 27% of V3.2 with KV cache at 10%, Cryptonomist's open-source 1M-token race framing, and OFox's release guide confirming 1.6T MoE / 1M context / Apache 2.0 / immediate API availability give three concurrent confirmations of native 1M context in open weights.

text_locales.en: TechXplore's Hybrid Attention writeup pinning long-context inference cost at 27% of V3.2 with KV cache at 10%, Cryptonomist's open-source 1M-token race framing, and OFox's release guide confirming 1.6T MoE / 1M context / Apache 2.0 / immediate API availability give three concurrent confirmations of native 1M context in open weights.
text_locales.ja: TechXploreのハイブリッド・アテンション分析が長コンテキスト推論コストをV3.2の27%、KVキャッシュを10%にピンポイント、Cryptonomistのオープンソース1Mトークンレースの枠組み、OFoxのリリース・ガイドが1.6T MoE / 1Mコンテキスト / Apache 2.0 / 即時API利用可能を確認することが、オープンウェイトでのネイティブ1Mコンテキストの3つの同時並行的確認を提供する。
text_locales.es: El writeup de Hybrid Attention de TechXplore fijando el costo de inferencia de contexto largo al 27% de V3.2 con caché KV al 10%, el encuadre de Cryptonomist de la carrera open-source de 1M tokens, y la guía de lanzamiento de OFox confirmando 1.6T MoE / contexto 1M / Apache 2.0 / disponibilidad inmediata de API dan tres confirmaciones concurrentes de contexto 1M nativo en pesos abiertos.
text_locales.fil: Ang Hybrid Attention writeup ng TechXplore na nagpipipi sa long-context inference cost sa 27% ng V3.2 kasama ang KV cache sa 10%, ang open-source 1M-token race framing ng Cryptonomist, at ang release guide ng OFox na nagkukumpirma ng 1.6T MoE / 1M context / Apache 2.0 / agarang API availability ay nagbibigay ng tatlong sabay-sabay na kumpirmasyon ng native 1M context sa open weights.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **The "1M context as default" open-weight era arrives in full by Q3 2026.** DeepSeek V4's "1M context designed in, not bolted on," Qwen3.6-27B's 262K → 1M extension, Claude Opus 4.7's 1M context (Bedrock), and GPT-5.5's long-context strengthening all point the same direction. By Q3 2026, "native 1M context" becomes the floor for open weights, and existing 32K-128K models drop to legacy. RAG pipelines flip from "search → context-insert" to "dump everything in + dynamic prune," and vector DB vendors are pushed to redefine themselves as "long-context cache optimization layers." In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **「1Mコンテキストがデフォルト」のオープンウェイト時代がQ3 2026までに本格到来する。** DeepSeek V4の「1Mコンテキストは後付けではなく設計段階から組み込み」、Qwen3.6-27Bの262K → 1M拡張、Claude Opus 4.7の1Mコンテキスト(Bedrock)、GPT-5.5の長コンテキスト強化は、すべて同じ方向を指している。Q3 2026までに、「ネイティブ1Mコンテキスト」がオープンウェイトの最低水準となり、既存の32K-128Kモデルはレガシーに転落する。RAGパイプラインは「検索 → コンテキスト挿入」から「全部投入 + 動的プルーニング」へと反転し、ベクトルDBベンダーは「長コンテキスト・キャッシュ最適化レイヤー」への再定義を迫られる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **La era de "contexto de 1M por defecto" en pesos abiertos llega de lleno para el Q3 2026.** El "contexto de 1M diseñado de origen, no añadido a la fuerza" de DeepSeek V4, la extensión de 262K → 1M de Qwen3.6-27B, el contexto de 1M de Claude Opus 4.7 (Bedrock) y el refuerzo de contexto largo de GPT-5.5 apuntan todos en la misma dirección. Para el Q3 2026, el "contexto de 1M nativo" se convierte en el piso para los pesos abiertos, y los modelos existentes de 32K-128K caen al nivel legacy. Los pipelines RAG cambian de "búsqueda → inserción de contexto" a "volcar todo + poda dinámica", y los proveedores de bases de datos vectoriales son empujados a redefinirse como "capas de optimización de caché de contexto largo". Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang "native 1M context" ay nagiging floor para sa open weights, at ang umiiral na 32K-128K models ay babagsak sa legacy. Ang RAG pipelines ay lumilipat mula sa "search → context-insert" papunta sa "dump everything in + dynamic prune," at ang mga vendor ng vector DB ay napipilitang i-redefine ang sarili bilang "long-context cache optimization layers." nodes.title: Unsloth 2026 stack lands as hyperscaler-managed fine-tuning service by H2 2026
nodes.description: **By H2 2026 the Unsloth 2026 update wave — 12x faster MoE training + ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning + 1.8-3.3x faster embedding / BERT / classifier training with 20% less VRAM and 2x longer context (joint Hugging Face engineering) + Unsloth Studio Mar 17 100%-offline GGUF + Safetensors runtime + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garage fine-tuning guide (RTX-laptop performance up 2.5x) — combined with the SGLang 29% throughput advantage on H100 (RadixAttention prefix-cache shared with vLLM at ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + day-0 SGLang support for MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + the Apr 28-May 3 KV-cache arxiv wave (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) makes consumer-GPU training operationally equivalent to enterprise-GPU 2024-baseline; expect ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex AI) to ship a managed Unsloth-as-a-service tier with managed-runtime + IAM + audit + cost-optimized GPU pool to close the consumer-GPU → enterprise-fine-tuning gap before AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite cycles.** Forcing function is the procurement-friction asymmetry: enterprises with internal Unsloth pilots already see 70%-VRAM-reduction economics on consumer GPUs, but enterprise security + governance demands a managed control plane that the open-source CLI doesn't provide; whichever hyperscaler ships first absorbs the migration. Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI all have the runtime substrate; the missing piece is the fine-tuning-as-a-service surface that unifies the open-source kernel performance with managed-IAM enterprise governance. In plain language: Local-LLM training is now twice as fast and uses 70% less VRAM — soon big clouds will rent that out as a managed service. In plain language: In plain language:

description.ja: **2026年下半期までに、Unsloth 2026アップデートの波 — 12倍高速MoE学習 + 超ロングコンテキスト強化学習 + 1.8〜3.3倍高速 embedding / BERT / 分類器学習でVRAM 20%削減 + コンテキスト2倍長(Hugging Face共同エンジニアリング) + Unsloth Studio 3月17日 100%オフラインGGUF + Safetensorsランタイム + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garageファインチューニング・ガイド(RTXラップトップ性能2.5倍向上) — がSGLangのH100上での29%スループット優位(RadixAttentionプレフィックスキャッシュをvLLMと共有、約16,200 vs 約12,500 tok/s) + SGLangのMiMo-V2-Flash、Nemotron 3 Nano、Mistral Large 3、LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion、MiniMax M2へのday-0サポート + 4月28日〜5月3日のKVキャッシュarxiv波(SideQuest、DepthKV、KVFundaBench)と組み合わさり、コンシューマーGPU学習をエンタープライズGPU 2024ベースラインと運用上同等にする。1社以上のハイパースケーラー(AWS Bedrock fine-tuning、Azure AI Foundry、またはGoogle Vertex AI)が、コンシューマーGPU → エンタープライズ・ファインチューニング間のギャップを埋めるため、AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Igniteのサイクルまでに、マネージド・ランタイム + IAM + 監査 + コスト最適化GPUプールを伴うマネージドUnsloth-as-a-serviceティアを出荷することが期待される。** 強制関数は調達摩擦の非対称性: 内部Unslothパイロットを持つ企業はコンシューマーGPUで既にVRAM 70%削減の経済性を得ているが、エンタープライズのセキュリティ + ガバナンス要件には、オープンソースCLIでは提供できないマネージド・コントロールプレーンが必要となる。最初に出荷したハイパースケーラーが移行需要を吸収する。Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AIはいずれもランタイム基盤を持っており、欠けているピースは、オープンソースカーネル性能とマネージドIAMエンタープライズ・ガバナンスを統合するファインチューニング・アズ・ア・サービスのサーフェスである。In plain language: ローカルLLM学習は今や2倍高速でVRAMも70%少なくて済む — 近いうちに大手クラウドがそれをマネージドサービスとして貸し出すだろう。In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Para H2 2026, la ola de actualización Unsloth 2026 — entrenamiento MoE 12x más rápido + Reinforcement Learning de contexto ultra-largo + entrenamiento de embedding / BERT / clasificador 1.8-3.3x más rápido con 20% menos VRAM y contexto 2x más largo (ingeniería conjunta con Hugging Face) + Unsloth Studio del 17 de marzo con runtime GGUF + Safetensors 100% offline + guía de fine-tuning RTX-AI Garage de NVIDIA DGX Spark (rendimiento de portátil RTX hasta 2.5x) — combinado con la ventaja de rendimiento del 29% de SGLang en H100 (caché de prefijo RadixAttention compartido con vLLM en ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + soporte day-0 de SGLang para MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + la ola arxiv KV-cache del 28 de abril al 3 de mayo (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) hace que el entrenamiento en GPU de consumo sea operativamente equivalente a la línea base de GPU empresarial de 2024; se espera que ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, o Google Vertex AI) entregue un nivel gestionado de Unsloth-as-a-service con runtime gestionado + IAM + auditoría + pool de GPU optimizado en costo para cerrar la brecha entre fine-tuning en GPU de consumo → empresarial antes de los ciclos de AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite.** La función forzante es la asimetría de fricción de adquisición: las empresas con pilotos internos de Unsloth ya ven la economía de reducción del 70% de VRAM en GPUs de consumo, pero la seguridad + gobernanza empresarial demanda un plano de control gestionado que el CLI open-source no proporciona; el hyperscaler que entregue primero absorbe la migración. Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI tienen todos el sustrato de runtime; la pieza que falta es la superficie de fine-tuning-as-a-service que unifica el rendimiento del kernel open-source con la gobernanza empresarial de IAM gestionada. In plain language: Local-LLM training is now twice as fast and uses 70% less VRAM — soon big clouds will rent that out as a managed service. In plain language: In plain language:

summary.ja: **2026年下半期までに、Unsloth 2026アップデートの波 — 12倍高速MoE学習 + 超ロングコンテキスト強化学習 + 1.8〜3.3倍高速 embedding / BERT / 分類器学習でVRAM 20%削減 + コンテキスト2倍長(Hugging Face共同エンジニアリング) + Unsloth Studio 3月17日 100%オフラインGGUF + Safetensorsランタイム + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garageファインチューニング・ガイド(RTXラップトップ性能2.5倍向上) — がSGLangのH100上での29%スループット優位(RadixAttentionプレフィックスキャッシュをvLLMと共有、約16,200 vs 約12,500 tok/s) + SGLangのMiMo-V2-Flash、Nemotron 3 Nano、Mistral Large 3、LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion、MiniMax M2へのday-0サポート + 4月28日〜5月3日のKVキャッシュarxiv波(SideQuest、DepthKV、KVFundaBench)と組み合わさり、コンシューマーGPU学習をエンタープライズGPU 2024ベースラインと運用上同等にする。1社以上のハイパースケーラー(AWS Bedrock fine-tuning、Azure AI Foundry、またはGoogle Vertex AI)が、コンシューマーGPU → エンタープライズ・ファインチューニング間のギャップを埋めるため、AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Igniteのサイクルまでに、マネージド・ランタイム + IAM + 監査 + コスト最適化GPUプールを伴うマネージドUnsloth-as-a-serviceティアを出荷することが期待される。** 強制関数は調達摩擦の非対称性: 内部Unslothパイロットを持つ企業はコンシューマーGPUで既にVRAM 70%削減の経済性を得ているが、エンタープライズのセキュリティ + ガバナンス要件には、オープンソースCLIでは提供できないマネージド・コントロールプレーンが必要となる。最初に出荷したハイパースケーラーが移行需要を吸収する。Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AIはいずれもランタイム基盤を持っており、欠けているピースは、オープンソースカーネル性能とマネージドIAMエンタープライズ・ガバナンスを統合するファインチューニング・アズ・ア・サービスのサーフェスである。In plain language: ローカルLLM学習は今や2倍高速でVRAMも70%少なくて済む — 近いうちに大手クラウドがそれをマネージドサービスとして貸し出すだろう。In plain language: In plain language:
summary.es: **Para H2 2026, la ola de actualización Unsloth 2026 — entrenamiento MoE 12x más rápido + Reinforcement Learning de contexto ultra-largo + entrenamiento de embedding / BERT / clasificador 1.8-3.3x más rápido con 20% menos VRAM y contexto 2x más largo (ingeniería conjunta con Hugging Face) + Unsloth Studio del 17 de marzo con runtime GGUF + Safetensors 100% offline + guía de fine-tuning RTX-AI Garage de NVIDIA DGX Spark (rendimiento de portátil RTX hasta 2.5x) — combinado con la ventaja de rendimiento del 29% de SGLang en H100 (caché de prefijo RadixAttention compartido con vLLM en ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + soporte day-0 de SGLang para MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + la ola arxiv KV-cache del 28 de abril al 3 de mayo (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) hace que el entrenamiento en GPU de consumo sea operativamente equivalente a la línea base de GPU empresarial de 2024; se espera que ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, o Google Vertex AI) entregue un nivel gestionado de Unsloth-as-a-service con runtime gestionado + IAM + auditoría + pool de GPU optimizado en costo para cerrar la brecha entre fine-tuning en GPU de consumo → empresarial antes de los ciclos de AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite.** La función forzante es la asimetría de fricción de adquisición: las empresas con pilotos internos de Unsloth ya ven la economía de reducción del 70% de VRAM en GPUs de consumo, pero la seguridad + gobernanza empresarial demanda un plano de control gestionado que el CLI open-source no proporciona; el hyperscaler que entregue primero absorbe la migración. Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI tienen todos el sustrato de runtime; la pieza que falta es la superficie de fine-tuning-as-a-service que unifica el rendimiento del kernel open-source con la gobernanza empresarial de IAM gestionada. In plain language: Local-LLM training is now twice as fast and uses 70% less VRAM — soon big clouds will rent that out as a managed service. In plain language: In plain language:
summary.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang Unsloth 2026 update wave — 12x faster MoE training + ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning + 1.8-3.3x faster embedding / BERT / classifier training na may 20% less VRAM at 2x longer context (joint Hugging Face engineering) + Unsloth Studio Mar 17 100%-offline GGUF + Safetensors runtime + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garage fine-tuning guide (RTX-laptop performance up 2.5x) — pinagsama sa SGLang 29% throughput advantage sa H100 (RadixAttention prefix-cache shared sa vLLM sa ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + day-0 SGLang support para sa MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + ang Apr 28-May 3 KV-cache arxiv wave (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) ay ginagawang operationally equivalent ang consumer-GPU training sa enterprise-GPU 2024-baseline; inaasahan na ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, o Google Vertex AI) ang magpapadala ng managed Unsloth-as-a-service tier na may managed-runtime + IAM + audit + cost-optimized GPU pool upang isara ang consumer-GPU → enterprise-fine-tuning gap bago ang AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite cycles.** Ang forcing function ay ang procurement-friction asymmetry: ang mga enterprises na may panloob na Unsloth pilots ay nakakita na ng 70%-VRAM-reduction economics sa consumer GPUs, ngunit ang enterprise security + governance ay humihingi ng managed control plane na hindi maibibigay ng open-source CLI; sinumang hyperscaler ang unang magpapadala ay sumusubsob sa migration. Ang Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI ay lahat may runtime substrate; ang nawawalang piraso ay ang fine-tuning-as-a-service surface na nagbubuklod sa open-source kernel performance sa managed-IAM enterprise governance. detail.description: **By H2 2026 the Unsloth 2026 update wave — 12x faster MoE training + ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning + 1.8-3.3x faster embedding / BERT / classifier training with 20% less VRAM and 2x longer context (joint Hugging Face engineering) + Unsloth Studio Mar 17 100%-offline GGUF + Safetensors runtime + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garage fine-tuning guide (RTX-laptop performance up 2.5x) — combined with the SGLang 29% throughput advantage on H100 (RadixAttention prefix-cache shared with vLLM at ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + day-0 SGLang support for MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + the Apr 28-May 3 KV-cache arxiv wave (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) makes consumer-GPU training operationally equivalent to enterprise-GPU 2024-baseline; expect ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex AI) to ship a managed Unsloth-as-a-service tier with managed-runtime + IAM + audit + cost-optimized GPU pool to close the consumer-GPU → enterprise-fine-tuning gap before AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite cycles.** Forcing function is the procurement-friction asymmetry: enterprises with internal Unsloth pilots already see 70%-VRAM-reduction economics on consumer GPUs, but enterprise security + governance demands a managed control plane that the open-source CLI doesn't provide; whichever hyperscaler ships first absorbs the migration. Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI all have the runtime substrate; the missing piece is the fine-tuning-as-a-service surface that unifies the open-source kernel performance with managed-IAM enterprise governance. In plain language: Local-LLM training is now twice as fast and uses 70% less VRAM — soon big clouds will rent that out as a managed service. In plain language: In plain language:

nodes.description: By Q4 2026 the May 4 Cerebras Systems IPO launch — 28M shares at $115-$125 each to raise ~$3.5B at a $26.6B market cap at the high end (vs Series H $23B Feb 2026), $510M trailing revenue, OpenAI partnership disclosed at >$10B multi-year warrant + loan structure (Dec 2025 OpenAI $1B loan secured by warrants for >33M shares), angel roster including Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo — combined with the standing $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape, the OpenAI / Anthropic frontier-lab supply-contract precedent now publicly priceable on the open market, and the Fleet Data Centers $4.6B Storey County secured-notes offering as the parallel debt-issuance signal forces a second AI-accelerator IPO at >$10B valuation within the same calendar window — Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etched the most-likely candidate cohort, with Groq the leading first-mover given its prior funding-round signaling and inference-tier API revenue. The forcing function is that Cerebras's IPO surfaces a public-market comparable for AI-accelerator-startup equity for the first time — buyside coverage now has a direct multiple to anchor against, so a sibling priced inside the same cycle reads as continuation rather than first-mover risk premium. The Cerebras pricing window itself acts as a forward-guide for sibling underwriters (Goldman / Morgan Stanley / Citi) who can syndicate the next deal at parallel terms. Bear case is Cerebras pricing below midpoint and forcing the cohort to wait two quarters; absent that, Q4 2026 lands the second deal.

description.ja: 2026年Q4までに、5月4日のCerebras Systems IPOローンチ—28M株を$115-$125で価格決定、$3.5Bを調達しハイエンドで$26.6B時価総額(2026年2月のシリーズH $23B 対比)、$510Mトレーリング売上、OpenAIパートナーシップを$10B超のマルチイヤー・ワラント+ローン構造で開示(2025年12月にOpenAIがCerebrasに$1Bを貸付、33M+株のワラント担保)、エンジェル・ロスターはSam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angeloを含む—が、$700Bの2026 Big-Tech AI-capexテープ、OpenAI / Anthropicフロンティア・ラボ供給契約の前例が公開市場で価格付け可能になったこと、Fleet Data Centersの$4.6B Storey County担保ノート発行が並行する債券発行シグナルとして組み合わさり、同じカレンダー・ウィンドウ内で2件目のAIアクセラレータIPOを$10B超評価で強制する—Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etchedが最有力候補コホート、その先行資金調達ラウンドのシグナリングとインフェレンス層APIレベニューを考えるとGroqが先行ファースト・ムーバー候補。フォーシング・ファンクションはCerebrasのIPOがAIアクセラレータ・スタートアップ・エクイティの公開市場コンパラブルを初めて可視化することで、バイサイド・カバレッジが直接アンカーすべき倍率を持つことになり、同じサイクル内で価格付けされる兄弟案件はファースト・ムーバー・リスクプレミアムではなく継続として読まれる。Cerebrasの価格付けウィンドウ自体が兄弟引受人(Goldman / Morgan Stanley / Citi)に対するフォワードガイドとなり、次案件をパラレル条件で組成可能にする。ベアケースはCerebrasがミッドポイント以下で価格付けされコホートを2四半期待たせること;それがなければ2026年Q4が2件目を着地させる。
description.es: Para Q4 2026 el lanzamiento del IPO de Cerebras Systems del 4 de mayo — 28M acciones a $115-$125 cada una para recaudar ~$3.5B a una capitalización de mercado de $26.6B en el extremo alto (vs Series H $23B feb 2026), $510M en ingresos trailing, asociación OpenAI revelada en estructura warrant + préstamo multi-año >$10B (dic 2025 OpenAI prestó $1B a Cerebras garantizado por warrants para >33M acciones), roster de inversionistas ángel incluyendo Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo — combinado con la cinta standing de $700B en AI-capex 2026 Big-Tech, el precedente de contratos de suministro frontier-lab de OpenAI / Anthropic ahora cotizable públicamente, y la oferta de notas garantizadas de Fleet Data Centers de $4.6B en Storey County como señal paralela de emisión de deuda obliga a un segundo IPO de acelerador AI a valoración >$10B dentro de la misma ventana calendario — Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etched la cohorte candidata más probable, con Groq el first-mover líder dado su signaling previo de rondas y revenue de API de capa de inferencia. La forcing function es que el IPO de Cerebras revela un comparable público para equity de startups de aceleradores AI por primera vez — la cobertura buyside ahora tiene un múltiplo directo para anclar, así que un hermano fijado dentro del mismo ciclo se lee como continuación en lugar de prima de riesgo first-mover. La ventana de fijación de Cerebras misma actúa como guía forward para underwriters hermanos (Goldman / Morgan Stanley / Citi) que pueden sindicar la siguiente operación en términos paralelos. Caso bajista es Cerebras fijando bajo el midpoint y forzando a la cohorte a esperar dos trimestres; sin eso, Q4 2026 aterriza la segunda operación.
description.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026 ang May 4 Cerebras Systems IPO launch — 28M shares sa $115-$125 bawat isa upang makakalap ng ~$3.5B sa $26.6B market cap sa high end (vs Series H $23B Feb 2026), $510M trailing revenue, OpenAI partnership na inilantad sa >$10B multi-year warrant + loan structure (Dec 2025 OpenAI $1B loan na sineguro ng warrants para sa >33M shares), angel roster kabilang Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo — kasama ng standing $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape, ang OpenAI / Anthropic frontier-lab supply-contract precedent na ngayon ay publicly priceable sa open market, at ang Fleet Data Centers $4.6B Storey County secured-notes offering bilang parallel debt-issuance signal ay pumipilit ng pangalawang AI-accelerator IPO sa >$10B valuation sa loob ng parehong calendar window — Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etched ang most-likely candidate cohort, na may Groq bilang nangungunang first-mover dahil sa kanyang prior funding-round signaling at inference-tier API revenue. Ang forcing function ay nilalantad ng Cerebras IPO ang isang public-market comparable para sa AI-accelerator-startup equity sa unang pagkakataon — buyside coverage ngayon ay may direct multiple para mag-anchor laban sa, kaya ang isang sibling na napresyo sa loob ng parehong cycle ay binabasa bilang continuation sa halip na first-mover risk premium. Ang Cerebras pricing window mismo ay kumikilos bilang forward-guide para sa sibling underwriters (Goldman / Morgan Stanley / Citi) na maaaring mag-syndicate ng susunod na deal sa parallel terms. Ang bear case ay ang Cerebras na mag-presyo sa ibaba ng midpoint at pumilit sa cohort na maghintay ng dalawang quarters; kung wala iyon, ipupunta ng Q4 2026 ang pangalawang deal.

Caso bajista es Cerebras fijando bajo el midpoint y forzando a la cohorte a esperar dos trimestres; sin eso, Q4 2026 aterriza la segunda operación.
summary.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026 ang May 4 Cerebras Systems IPO launch — 28M shares sa $115-$125 bawat isa upang makakalap ng ~$3.5B sa $26.6B market cap sa high end (vs Series H $23B Feb 2026), $510M trailing revenue, OpenAI partnership na inilantad sa >$10B multi-year warrant + loan structure (Dec 2025 OpenAI $1B loan na sineguro ng warrants para sa >33M shares), angel roster kabilang Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo — kasama ng standing $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape, ang OpenAI / Anthropic frontier-lab supply-contract precedent na ngayon ay publicly priceable sa open market, at ang Fleet Data Centers $4.6B Storey County secured-notes offering bilang parallel debt-issuance signal ay pumipilit ng pangalawang AI-accelerator IPO sa >$10B valuation sa loob ng parehong calendar window — Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etched ang most-likely candidate cohort, na may Groq bilang nangungunang first-mover dahil sa kanyang prior funding-round signaling at inference-tier API revenue. Ang forcing function ay nilalantad ng Cerebras IPO ang isang public-market comparable para sa AI-accelerator-startup equity sa unang pagkakataon — buyside coverage ngayon ay may direct multiple para mag-anchor laban sa, kaya ang isang sibling na napresyo sa loob ng parehong cycle ay binabasa bilang continuation sa halip na first-mover risk premium. Ang Cerebras pricing window mismo ay kumikilos bilang forward-guide para sa sibling underwriters (Goldman / Morgan Stanley / Citi) na maaaring mag-syndicate ng susunod na deal sa parallel terms. Ang bear case ay ang Cerebras na mag-presyo sa ibaba ng midpoint at pumilit sa cohort na maghintay ng dalawang quarters; kung wala iyon, ipupunta ng Q4 2026 ang pangalawang deal.

bridges.text: Cerebras CBRS opens its second trading week at $189.40 (+9.5 percent from Friday) on a 3.8x call-skew, validating the Morgan Stanley $192 and Goldman $185 buyside marks; Tenstorrent files Monday's S-1 pre-submission cover note at a $3.4B bridge valuation; SambaNova holds the late-June confidential-submission target at the $7-9B fully-diluted range, hardening the second-deal comparable stack.

text_locales.en: Cerebras CBRS opens its second trading week at $189.40 (+9.5 percent from Friday) on a 3.8x call-skew, validating the Morgan Stanley $192 and Goldman $185 buyside marks; Tenstorrent files Monday's S-1 pre-submission cover note at a $3.4B bridge valuation; SambaNova holds the late-June confidential-submission target at the $7-9B fully-diluted range, hardening the second-deal comparable stack.
text_locales.ja: Cerebras CBRSは2週目取引を$189.40(金曜から+9.5パーセント)、3.8倍コール・スキューで開始し、Morgan Stanley $192とGoldman $185のバイサイド・マークを妥当化;Tenstorrentは月曜のS-1事前提出カバー・ノートを$3.4Bブリッジ・バリュエーションで提出;SambaNovaは$7-9B完全希薄化レンジで6月下旬機密提出ターゲットを維持し、2番目のディール・コンパラブル・スタックを硬化させる。
text_locales.es: Cerebras CBRS abre su segunda semana de trading en $189.40 (+9.5 por ciento desde el viernes) sobre un call-skew 3.8x, validando los marcadores buyside Morgan Stanley $192 y Goldman $185; Tenstorrent presenta la nota cover de pre-submission S-1 del lunes en una valoración de puente $3.4B; SambaNova mantiene el objetivo de submission confidencial de finales-de-junio en el rango completamente diluido de $7-9B, endureciendo la pila de comparables del segundo trato.
text_locales.fil: Bumubukas ang Cerebras CBRS ng ikalawang trading week sa $189.40 (+9.5 percent mula sa Friday) sa isang 3.8x call-skew, nagva-validate sa Morgan Stanley $192 at Goldman $185 buyside marks; naghahain ang Tenstorrent ng Monday S-1 pre-submission cover note sa $3.4B bridge valuation; hawak ng SambaNova ang late-June confidential-submission target sa $7-9B fully-diluted range, na nagpapatibay sa second-deal comparable stack.

bridges.text: The Sunday CBRS buyside note season (Morgan Stanley raises target to $192, Jefferies initiates Buy at $178, Goldman holds $185 with a $220 upside scenario) supplies the public-market reference the second deal must clear; Tenstorrent's syndicate plus $3.4B fully-closed bridge tracks toward an August confidential S-1, while SambaNova's $7-9B range sits below the $10B threshold but inside negotiation distance and Groq's Saudi-PIF secondary discussion surfaces the contingent capital structure.

text_locales.es: La temporada de notas buyside dominicales de CBRS (Morgan Stanley sube objetivo a $192, Jefferies inicia Buy a $178, Goldman mantiene $185 con un escenario al alza de $220) suministra la referencia de mercado público que el segundo trato debe superar; el sindicato de Tenstorrent más el puente completamente cerrado de $3.4B trackea hacia un S-1 confidencial en agosto, mientras el rango $7-9B de SambaNova se sitúa por debajo del umbral $10B pero dentro de distancia de negociación y la discusión de secundario Saudi-PIF de Groq emerge la estructura de capital contingente.
text_locales.fil: Nagbibigay ang Sunday CBRS buyside note season (nagtataas ang Morgan Stanley ng target sa $192, nag-iinitiate ang Jefferies ng Buy sa $178, hawak ng Goldman ang $185 na may $220 upside scenario) ng public-market reference na dapat laktawan ng pangalawang deal; sumusubaybay ang syndicate plus lubusang isinarang $3.4B bridge ng Tenstorrent patungo sa isang August confidential S-1, habang ang $7-9B range ng SambaNova ay nakaupo sa ibaba ng $10B threshold pero nasa loob ng negotiation distance at pinapaibabaw ng Groq's Saudi-PIF secondary discussion ang contingent capital structure.

text_locales.es: El precio de Cerebras +2,4% por encima del rango a ~$27,2B con green-shoe completo establece un piso concreto en el mercado público que la predicción de un segundo acuerdo mayor a $10B (6 de mayo) requiere; SambaNova ($5,1B última valoración) y Groq ($2,8B + vehículo anclado por Arabia Saudí) acelerando presentaciones confidenciales S-1 a 60-90 días, más la ronda puente IPO de Tenstorrent >$3B, mueven la cohorte de observar a ejecutar.
text_locales.fil: Ang Cerebras pricing na +2.4% sa itaas ng range sa ~$27.2B kasama ang full green-shoe ay nagtatakda ng konkretong public-market floor na kinakailangan ng second-deal-greater-than-$10B prediction (Mayo 6); ang SambaNova ($5.1B last-priced) at Groq ($2.8B + Saudi-anchored vehicle) na nagpapabilis ng S-1 confidential submissions sa 60-90 araw kasama ang >$3B IPO bridge round ng Tenstorrent ay naglilipat sa cohort mula sa pagmamasid tungo sa ehekusyon.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: By Q4 2026 the May 4 Cerebras Systems IPO launch — 28M shares at $115-$125 each to raise ~$3.5B at a $26.6B market cap at the high end (vs Series H $23B Feb 2026), $510M trailing revenue, OpenAI partnership disclosed at >$10B multi-year warrant + loan structure (Dec 2025 OpenAI $1B loan secured by warrants for >33M shares), angel roster including Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo — combined with the standing $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape, the OpenAI / Anthropic frontier-lab supply-contract precedent now publicly priceable on the open market, and the Fleet Data Centers $4.6B Storey County secured-notes offering as the parallel debt-issuance signal forces a second AI-accelerator IPO at >$10B valuation within the same calendar window — Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etched the most-likely candidate cohort, with Groq the leading first-mover given its prior funding-round signaling and inference-tier API revenue. The forcing function is that Cerebras's IPO surfaces a public-market comparable for AI-accelerator-startup equity for the first time — buyside coverage now has a direct multiple to anchor against, so a sibling priced inside the same cycle reads as continuation rather than first-mover risk premium. The Cerebras pricing window itself acts as a forward-guide for sibling underwriters (Goldman / Morgan Stanley / Citi) who can syndicate the next deal at parallel terms. Bear case is Cerebras pricing below midpoint and forcing the cohort to wait two quarters; absent that, Q4 2026 lands the second deal.

nodes.description: By Q1 2027 the May 6-7 Cerebras Systems IPO above-range pricing print — $128 per share (vs $115-$125 disclosed range, +2.4% above the upper end), $3.58B raise lifted to ~$4.12B with the green-shoe exercised in full at a fully-diluted ~$27.2B market cap, OpenAI's December 2025 $1B warrant package (~33M shares, ~12% of float, struck at the Series H reference) marked publicly in-the-money on listing day, Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo angel positions all crystallized at a $26.6B-target → $27.2B-actual print — combined with the May 7 SambaNova + Groq accelerated S-1 confidential-submission timelines (60-90 days), the Tenstorrent Hyundai + Samsung Foundry IPO bridge round at >$3B, and a public-market multiple now sitting under disclosed AI-accelerator revenue, force the next wave of S-1 filings (and existing AI-accelerator + frontier-lab 10-Q footnote schedules) to disclose frontier-lab chip-supply warrant and loan terms as a standard issuer-level itemized exhibit rather than buried among related-party narrative footnotes. The forcing function is that OpenAI's Cerebras warrant is the first publicly-priced data point linking a frontier lab's structured-equity supply contract to an open-market multiple; sell-side and SEC Corp Fin staff comment letters now have a quantitative comparable to press for, which converts what was bespoke disclosure into template language. The most likely shape is an itemized warrant-and-loan exhibit naming counterparty (frontier lab), strike reference (Series-letter peg), share count, coverage clause, and any minimum-revenue or capacity-take obligations; SambaNova's S-1 ships first given its ~$5.1B last-priced round and Aramco Digital + Meta API customer roster, Groq second on its Saudi-anchored vehicle and inference-tier API revenue, Tenstorrent third via its bridge-round disclosure. Bear case is that the SEC permits silence on coverage clauses pending a separate concept release; absent that, Q1 2027 lands the standardised exhibit shape across the cohort.

description.es: Para Q1 2027 el print de pricing por encima del rango del IPO de Cerebras Systems del 6-7 de mayo — $128 por acción (vs rango revelado $115-$125, +2.4% por encima del extremo superior), recaudación de $3.58B elevada a ~$4.12B con el green-shoe ejercido en su totalidad a una capitalización de mercado totalmente diluida de ~$27.2B, el paquete de warrants de OpenAI de diciembre de 2025 de $1B (~33M acciones, ~12% del float, fijado en la referencia Series H) marcado públicamente in-the-money el día del listing, las posiciones ángel de Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo todas cristalizadas a un objetivo de $26.6B → print real $27.2B — combinado con los cronogramas acelerados de presentación confidencial S-1 de SambaNova + Groq del 7 de mayo (60-90 días), la ronda puente IPO de Tenstorrent con Hyundai + Samsung Foundry a >$3B, y un múltiplo de mercado público que ahora se sitúa bajo los ingresos revelados de aceleradores AI, fuerzan a la siguiente ola de presentaciones S-1 (y a los cronogramas existentes de notas al pie 10-Q de aceleradores AI + laboratorios frontera) a revelar términos de warrants y préstamos de suministro de chips de laboratorios frontera como un anexo estándar itemizado a nivel de emisor en lugar de quedar enterrados en notas narrativas de partes relacionadas. La función forzante es que el warrant de OpenAI sobre Cerebras es el primer punto de datos con precio público que vincula un contrato estructurado de suministro de equity de un laboratorio frontera a un múltiplo de mercado abierto; las cartas de comentarios del personal sell-side y SEC Corp Fin ahora tienen un comparable cuantitativo que presionar, lo que convierte lo que era revelación a medida en lenguaje de plantilla. La forma más probable es un anexo itemizado de warrant-y-préstamo nombrando contraparte (laboratorio frontera), referencia de strike (peg de letra de Series), número de acciones, cláusula de cobertura y cualquier obligación de ingreso mínimo o toma de capacidad; el S-1 de SambaNova lanza primero dado su última ronda con precio de ~$5.1B y su roster de clientes API Aramco Digital + Meta, Groq segundo por su vehículo anclado en Arabia Saudita y sus ingresos API de capa de inferencia, Tenstorrent tercero vía la revelación de su ronda puente. El caso bajista es que la SEC permita silencio sobre cláusulas de cobertura pendiente de un release conceptual separado; sin eso, Q1 2027 aterriza la forma de anexo estandarizado a través de la cohorte.

Ang forcing function ay ang OpenAI Cerebras warrant ay ang unang publicly-priced data point na nag-uugnay sa structured-equity supply contract ng frontier lab sa open-market multiple; ang sell-side at SEC Corp Fin staff comment letters ay mayroon na ngayong quantitative comparable na maipipilit, na nag-co-convert sa kung ano ang dating bespoke disclosure into template language. Ang most likely shape ay isang itemized warrant-and-loan exhibit na nagngangalan ng counterparty (frontier lab), strike reference (Series-letter peg), share count, coverage clause, at anumang minimum-revenue o capacity-take obligations; mauuna ang SambaNova S-1 dahil sa kanyang ~$5.1B last-priced round at Aramco Digital + Meta API customer roster, susunod ang Groq sa kanyang Saudi-anchored vehicle at inference-tier API revenue, ikatlo ang Tenstorrent sa pamamagitan ng kanyang bridge-round disclosure. Ang bear case ay pinapayagan ng SEC ang katahimikan sa coverage clauses na naghihintay sa hiwalay na concept release; kung wala iyon, ang Q1 2027 ay lalapag sa standardised exhibit shape sa kabuuan ng cohort.

summary.es: Para Q1 2027 el print de pricing por encima del rango del IPO de Cerebras Systems del 6-7 de mayo — $128 por acción (vs rango revelado $115-$125, +2.4% por encima del extremo superior), recaudación de $3.58B elevada a ~$4.12B con el green-shoe ejercido en su totalidad a una capitalización de mercado totalmente diluida de ~$27.2B, el paquete de warrants de OpenAI de diciembre de 2025 de $1B (~33M acciones, ~12% del float, fijado en la referencia Series H) marcado públicamente in-the-money el día del listing, las posiciones ángel de Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo todas cristalizadas a un objetivo de $26.6B → print real $27.2B — combinado con los cronogramas acelerados de presentación confidencial S-1 de SambaNova + Groq del 7 de mayo (60-90 días), la ronda puente IPO de Tenstorrent con Hyundai + Samsung Foundry a >$3B, y un múltiplo de mercado público que ahora se sitúa bajo los ingresos revelados de aceleradores AI, fuerzan a la siguiente ola de presentaciones S-1 (y a los cronogramas existentes de notas al pie 10-Q de aceleradores AI + laboratorios frontera) a revelar términos de warrants y préstamos de suministro de chips de laboratorios frontera como un anexo estándar itemizado a nivel de emisor en lugar de quedar enterrados en notas narrativas de partes relacionadas. La función forzante es que el warrant de OpenAI sobre Cerebras es el primer punto de datos con precio público que vincula un contrato estructurado de suministro de equity de un laboratorio frontera a un múltiplo de mercado abierto; las cartas de comentarios del personal sell-side y SEC Corp Fin ahora tienen un comparable cuantitativo que presionar, lo que convierte lo que era revelación a medida en lenguaje de plantilla. La forma más probable es un anexo itemizado de warrant-y-préstamo nombrando contraparte (laboratorio frontera), referencia de strike (peg de letra de Series), número de acciones, cláusula de cobertura y cualquier obligación de ingreso mínimo o toma de capacidad; el S-1 de SambaNova lanza primero dado su última ronda con precio de ~$5.1B y su roster de clientes API Aramco Digital + Meta, Groq segundo por su vehículo anclado en Arabia Saudita y sus ingresos API de capa de inferencia, Tenstorrent tercero vía la revelación de su ronda puente. El caso bajista es que la SEC permita silencio sobre cláusulas de cobertura pendiente de un release conceptual separado; sin eso, Q1 2027 aterriza la forma de anexo estandarizado a través de la cohorte.
summary.fil: Bago ang Q1 2027, ang May 6-7 Cerebras Systems IPO above-range pricing print — $128 per share (vs $115-$125 disclosed range, +2.4% sa ibabaw ng upper end), $3.58B raise na itinaas sa ~$4.12B na may green-shoe na ginamit nang buo sa fully-diluted ~$27.2B market cap, ang December 2025 $1B warrant package ng OpenAI (~33M shares, ~12% ng float, struck sa Series H reference) na pampublikong namarkahan in-the-money sa listing day, ang angel positions nina Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo na lahat ay na-crystallize sa $26.6B-target → $27.2B-actual print — kasama ng May 7 SambaNova + Groq accelerated S-1 confidential-submission timelines (60-90 days), ang Tenstorrent Hyundai + Samsung Foundry IPO bridge round sa >$3B, at ang public-market multiple na ngayon ay nakaupo sa ilalim ng inilantad na AI-accelerator revenue, ay pumipilit sa susunod na wave ng S-1 filings (at umiiral na AI-accelerator + frontier-lab 10-Q footnote schedules) na ilantad ang frontier-lab chip-supply warrant at loan terms bilang standard issuer-level itemized exhibit sa halip na ibaon sa related-party narrative footnotes. Ang forcing function ay ang OpenAI Cerebras warrant ay ang unang publicly-priced data point na nag-uugnay sa structured-equity supply contract ng frontier lab sa open-market multiple; ang sell-side at SEC Corp Fin staff comment letters ay mayroon na ngayong quantitative comparable na maipipilit, na nag-co-convert sa kung ano ang dating bespoke disclosure into template language. Ang most likely shape ay isang itemized warrant-and-loan exhibit na nagngangalan ng counterparty (frontier lab), strike reference (Series-letter peg), share count, coverage clause, at anumang minimum-revenue o capacity-take obligations; mauuna ang SambaNova S-1 dahil sa kanyang ~$5.1B last-priced round at Aramco Digital + Meta API customer roster, susunod ang Groq sa kanyang Saudi-anchored vehicle at inference-tier API revenue, ikatlo ang Tenstorrent sa pamamagitan ng kanyang bridge-round disclosure. Ang bear case ay pinapayagan ng SEC ang katahimikan sa coverage clauses na naghihintay sa hiwalay na concept release; kung wala iyon, ang Q1 2027 ay lalapag sa standardised exhibit shape sa kabuuan ng cohort.

detail.description: By Q1 2027 the May 6-7 Cerebras Systems IPO above-range pricing print — $128 per share (vs $115-$125 disclosed range, +2.4% above the upper end), $3.58B raise lifted to ~$4.12B with the green-shoe exercised in full at a fully-diluted ~$27.2B market cap, OpenAI's December 2025 $1B warrant package (~33M shares, ~12% of float, struck at the Series H reference) marked publicly in-the-money on listing day, Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo angel positions all crystallized at a $26.6B-target → $27.2B-actual print — combined with the May 7 SambaNova + Groq accelerated S-1 confidential-submission timelines (60-90 days), the Tenstorrent Hyundai + Samsung Foundry IPO bridge round at >$3B, and a public-market multiple now sitting under disclosed AI-accelerator revenue, force the next wave of S-1 filings (and existing AI-accelerator + frontier-lab 10-Q footnote schedules) to disclose frontier-lab chip-supply warrant and loan terms as a standard issuer-level itemized exhibit rather than buried among related-party narrative footnotes. The forcing function is that OpenAI's Cerebras warrant is the first publicly-priced data point linking a frontier lab's structured-equity supply contract to an open-market multiple; sell-side and SEC Corp Fin staff comment letters now have a quantitative comparable to press for, which converts what was bespoke disclosure into template language. The most likely shape is an itemized warrant-and-loan exhibit naming counterparty (frontier lab), strike reference (Series-letter peg), share count, coverage clause, and any minimum-revenue or capacity-take obligations; SambaNova's S-1 ships first given its ~$5.1B last-priced round and Aramco Digital + Meta API customer roster, Groq second on its Saudi-anchored vehicle and inference-tier API revenue, Tenstorrent third via its bridge-round disclosure. Bear case is that the SEC permits silence on coverage clauses pending a separate concept release; absent that, Q1 2027 lands the standardised exhibit shape across the cohort.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2027年Q1までに、5月6日〜7日のCerebras Systems IPOレンジ上抜け価格決定—1株$128(開示済みレンジ$115-$125に対し、上限を+2.4%上回る)、$3.58Bの調達がグリーンシュー全量行使で~$4.12Bに引き上げられ、フル希薄化後で~$27.2Bの時価総額、OpenAIの2025年12月の$1Bワラントパッケージ(~33M株、フロートの~12%、シリーズH参照ストライク)が上場日にイン・ザ・マネーで公にマーク、Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angeloのエンジェル・ポジションが$26.6Bターゲット→$27.2B実プリントで全て確定—が、5月7日のSambaNova + Groqの加速されたS-1機密提出タイムライン(60-90日)、TenstorrentのHyundai + Samsung FoundryとのIPOブリッジラウンド>$3B、開示済みAIアクセラレータ売上の下に位置する公開市場マルチプルと組み合わさり、次のS-1ファイリングの波(および既存のAIアクセラレータ + フロンティア・ラボの10-Q脚注スケジュール)に対し、フロンティア・ラボのチップ供給ワラントとローン条件を、関連当事者ナラティブ脚注に埋め込むのではなく発行体レベルの項目別エキシビットとして開示することを強制する。フォーシング・ファンクションは、OpenAIのCerebrasワラントが、フロンティア・ラボの構造化エクイティ供給契約を公開市場マルチプルにリンクする初の公的価格付けデータポイントであること;セルサイドとSEC Corp Finスタッフのコメントレターは現在、定量的なコンパラブルを要求できるようになり、これによりベスポーク開示がテンプレート言語へと変換される。最も可能性の高い形状は、カウンターパーティ(フロンティア・ラボ)、ストライク参照(シリーズ・レター・ペッグ)、株数、カバレッジ条項、最低売上または容量引取義務を命名する項目別ワラント・アンド・ローン・エキシビット;SambaNovaのS-1が~$5.1Bの直近価格付けラウンドとAramco Digital + Meta APIカスタマーのロスターから先行、Groqがサウジアラビアアンカーのビークルとインフェレンス層APIレベニューで2番目、Tenstorrentがブリッジラウンド開示で3番目。ベアケースはSECが別個のコンセプト・リリースを保留しカバレッジ条項の沈黙を許容すること;それがなければ2027年Q1にコホート全体で標準化されたエキシビット形状が着地する。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q1 2027 el print de pricing por encima del rango del IPO de Cerebras Systems del 6-7 de mayo — $128 por acción (vs rango revelado $115-$125, +2.4% por encima del extremo superior), recaudación de $3.58B elevada a ~$4.12B con el green-shoe ejercido en su totalidad a una capitalización de mercado totalmente diluida de ~$27.2B, el paquete de warrants de OpenAI de diciembre de 2025 de $1B (~33M acciones, ~12% del float, fijado en la referencia Series H) marcado públicamente in-the-money el día del listing, las posiciones ángel de Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo todas cristalizadas a un objetivo de $26.6B → print real $27.2B — combinado con los cronogramas acelerados de presentación confidencial S-1 de SambaNova + Groq del 7 de mayo (60-90 días), la ronda puente IPO de Tenstorrent con Hyundai + Samsung Foundry a >$3B, y un múltiplo de mercado público que ahora se sitúa bajo los ingresos revelados de aceleradores AI, fuerzan a la siguiente ola de presentaciones S-1 (y a los cronogramas existentes de notas al pie 10-Q de aceleradores AI + laboratorios frontera) a revelar términos de warrants y préstamos de suministro de chips de laboratorios frontera como un anexo estándar itemizado a nivel de emisor en lugar de quedar enterrados en notas narrativas de partes relacionadas. La función forzante es que el warrant de OpenAI sobre Cerebras es el primer punto de datos con precio público que vincula un contrato estructurado de suministro de equity de un laboratorio frontera a un múltiplo de mercado abierto; las cartas de comentarios del personal sell-side y SEC Corp Fin ahora tienen un comparable cuantitativo que presionar, lo que convierte lo que era revelación a medida en lenguaje de plantilla. La forma más probable es un anexo itemizado de warrant-y-préstamo nombrando contraparte (laboratorio frontera), referencia de strike (peg de letra de Series), número de acciones, cláusula de cobertura y cualquier obligación de ingreso mínimo o toma de capacidad; el S-1 de SambaNova lanza primero dado su última ronda con precio de ~$5.1B y su roster de clientes API Aramco Digital + Meta, Groq segundo por su vehículo anclado en Arabia Saudita y sus ingresos API de capa de inferencia, Tenstorrent tercero vía la revelación de su ronda puente. El caso bajista es que la SEC permita silencio sobre cláusulas de cobertura pendiente de un release conceptual separado; sin eso, Q1 2027 aterriza la forma de anexo estandarizado a través de la cohorte.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Bago ang Q1 2027, ang May 6-7 Cerebras Systems IPO above-range pricing print — $128 per share (vs $115-$125 disclosed range, +2.4% sa ibabaw ng upper end), $3.58B raise na itinaas sa ~$4.12B na may green-shoe na ginamit nang buo sa fully-diluted ~$27.2B market cap, ang December 2025 $1B warrant package ng OpenAI (~33M shares, ~12% ng float, struck sa Series H reference) na pampublikong namarkahan in-the-money sa listing day, ang angel positions nina Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo na lahat ay na-crystallize sa $26.6B-target → $27.2B-actual print — kasama ng May 7 SambaNova + Groq accelerated S-1 confidential-submission timelines (60-90 days), ang Tenstorrent Hyundai + Samsung Foundry IPO bridge round sa >$3B, at ang public-market multiple na ngayon ay nakaupo sa ilalim ng inilantad na AI-accelerator revenue, ay pumipilit sa susunod na wave ng S-1 filings (at umiiral na AI-accelerator + frontier-lab 10-Q footnote schedules) na ilantad ang frontier-lab chip-supply warrant at loan terms bilang standard issuer-level itemized exhibit sa halip na ibaon sa related-party narrative footnotes. Ang forcing function ay ang OpenAI Cerebras warrant ay ang unang publicly-priced data point na nag-uugnay sa structured-equity supply contract ng frontier lab sa open-market multiple; ang sell-side at SEC Corp Fin staff comment letters ay mayroon na ngayong quantitative comparable na maipipilit, na nag-co-convert sa kung ano ang dating bespoke disclosure into template language. Ang most likely shape ay isang itemized warrant-and-loan exhibit na nagngangalan ng counterparty (frontier lab), strike reference (Series-letter peg), share count, coverage clause, at anumang minimum-revenue o capacity-take obligations; mauuna ang SambaNova S-1 dahil sa kanyang ~$5.1B last-priced round at Aramco Digital + Meta API customer roster, susunod ang Groq sa kanyang Saudi-anchored vehicle at inference-tier API revenue, ikatlo ang Tenstorrent sa pamamagitan ng kanyang bridge-round disclosure. Ang bear case ay pinapayagan ng SEC ang katahimikan sa coverage clauses na naghihintay sa hiwalay na concept release; kung wala iyon, ang Q1 2027 ay lalapag sa standardised exhibit shape sa kabuuan ng cohort.

nodes.title: Router-only LoRA lands as default MoE fine-tuning recipe by Q4 2026
nodes.description: By Q4 2026 the May 8 router-only LoRA convergence — the Unsloth + Hugging Face joint arxiv preprint reporting 71-78% recovery of full-LoRA-on-experts accuracy at 8-13% of training-step time and 11-16% of peak VRAM across a four-model ablation (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), Unsloth's same-day production recipes for Llama 4 Behemoth single-node tuning, Kimi K2.6 on a 96GB workstation, and Mixtral 8x22B for sovereign-cloud customers, the parallel DeepMind preprint on router-aware advantage decomposition closing the long-context Reinforcement Learning stability gap that previously kept router-only mode out of ultra-long-context training, and Cerebras's CS-4 engineering-sample announcement explicitly naming Mixture-of-Experts router-only training plus ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning as the target workload — together force the router-only adaptation mode out of the Unsloth-specific category and into the default fine-tuning recipe shipped by every major training stack inside the same calendar window. The structural force is that the four-model ablation gives downstream framework maintainers a published parity baseline they can target without re-running the search, and the DeepMind stability proof removes the last operational reason to keep training all expert weights for a router-shaped objective. The most likely shape is a router-only adapter type added as a first-class option in Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, and Meta's torchtune, with default recipe templates targeting at least the Llama, Qwen, and Mixtral families; sovereign-cloud customers and on-prem RTX 6000 Ada workstation tier buyers adopt it first because the VRAM reduction is the only path to single-node tuning of Behemoth-class MoE models. Bear case is a competing scaling-law preprint showing the accuracy gap widens past 200B parameters and forcing a hybrid mode; absent that, Q4 2026 lands router-only as the documented default across the cohort.
